title: Deputy Program Manager
description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced Deputy Program Manager to support the Product Data Systems Support (PDSS) program located at Robins Air Force Base.

Location: Robins AFB, GA

Role & Responsibilities:

The Deputy Program Manager supports the Program Manager in the effective execution and oversight of program activities, personnel, subcontractors, deliverables, and performance requirements. This person works closely with government stakeholders, Peraton leadership, and a multidisciplinary team of subject matter experts to ensure program objectives, contractual requirements, and service level commitments are consistently achieved.

The successful candidate excels in communications, collaboration, critical attention to detail, and the ability to operate in a fast, paced operational and leadership environment.

Additionally, the Deputy Program Manager will:

  • Provide program management support including administrative oversight, timekeeping compliance, financial tracking, cost projections, inventory management, and personnel evaluations.
  • Oversees achievement of operational service level objectives and performance metrics, including effective management of subcontractor performance.
  • Assist in the preparation, review, and submission of Contract Data Requirements List (CDRLs) and other program deliverables.
  • Support workforce planning, personnel development, onboarding, and performance management.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to program personnel, fostering a collaborative, high-performing team environment.
  • Assist in identifying and resolving program risks, issues, and resource constraints to maintain schedule and performance objectives.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), protocols, and technical documentation.

#PDSS

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of a Bachelor's degree and 10 years of relevant professional experience, or 15 years of relevant professional experience with demonstrated leadership or management experience in lieu of a Bachelor's degree.
  • Demonstrated experience in financial and procurement management, human resources, and strategic planning.
  • Demonstrated understanding of financial program performance, including rate calculations, variance reporting, forecasting, and estimate to complete.
  • Experience performing performance monitoring of contracts; including establishing and reporting on contractual service level agreements.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills, exceptional professional attitude, and collaborative management style.
  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • The ability to obtain/maintain a DoD level Secret security clearance.
  • The ability to obtain a Common Access Card (CAC).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated ability to effectively lead a hybrid on-site/remote work team.
  • PLM systems experience.
  • Active DoD level Secret security clearance.
  • Recent DoD CAC (within the past two years).
  • PMP (Project Management Professional) Certification.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

title: Project Coordinator I
description:
Overview

Reporting to a Director, or Manager, the Project Coordinator, Air Force Supply Chain Programs is responsible for supporting procurement operations, supply chain performance, material lifecycle management, DMSMS (Diminishing Manufacturing Sources and Material Shortages) initiatives, and risk mitigation activities across Air Force and Department of Defense programs.

This role serves as a key liaison between Supply Chain, Program Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Contracts, and suppliers to ensure material availability, regulatory compliance, cost control, schedule adherence, and long-term product supportability. The Project Coordinator leverages procurement analytics, supplier management practices, and lifecycle planning methodologies to proactively identify risks and develop solutions that support mission readiness and operational success.

Responsibilities

Procurement Management and Program Support

  • Analyze procurement transactions, purchase requisitions (PRs), purchase orders (POs), and supplier performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for cost savings and process improvements.
  • Monitor open purchase requisitions and purchase orders to ensure timely processing, supplier responsiveness, and on-time delivery in coordination with the Purchasing Department.
  • Support Air Force Program Managers with:
    • Request for Quotation (RFQ) development
    • Pricing and estimating activities
    • Purchase requisition and purchase order processing
    • Sole Source Justification (SSJ) documentation
    • Approved Vendor List (AVL) and Trade Compliance Vendor List (TCVL) administration
  • Track supplier lead times, material availability, and delivery schedules before and after purchase order award.
  • Develop and maintain procurement reports, dashboards, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to support program decision-making and supply chain visibility.
  • Participate in material planning activities through analysis of demand forecasts, inventory levels, supplier capacity, and procurement requirements.

DMSMS and Obsolescence Management

  • Monitor component lifecycles and identify items approaching End-of-Life (EOL), End-of-Support (EOS), discontinuance, or diminishing manufacturing availability.
  • Conduct DMSMS assessments and develop mitigation strategies to minimize program impacts.
  • Evaluate Bills of Material (BOMs) to identify lifecycle risks, sourcing concerns, and supportability issues.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Program Management, and suppliers to identify acceptable replacement technologies and alternate sourcing solutions.
  • Support lifecycle sustainment strategies including:
    • Last-Time-Buy (LTB) planning
    • Inventory assessments
    • Lifecycle forecasting
    • Long-range material support planning
  • Maintain lifecycle management databases, obsolescence tracking tools, and risk mitigation records.
  • Monitor industry, supplier, and technology trends that may affect product supportability or supply continuity.

Supplier Performance and Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain productive supplier relationships to support operational requirements and customer commitments.
  • Assist with supplier evaluations, sourcing initiatives, and supplier performance reviews.
  • Analyze supplier performance metrics including:
    • On-time delivery performance
    • Lead-time compliance
    • Quality performance
    • Procurement cycle times
    • Material shortages and recovery rates
  • Identify supply chain risks and recommend corrective actions to mitigate cost, schedule, quality, and availability impacts.
  • Communicate procurement risks and material constraints to program leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Support contingency planning, alternate sourcing activities, and supplier diversification initiatives to strengthen supply chain resilience.

Data Analytics and Performance Reporting

  • Develop and maintain procurement and supply chain performance metrics.
  • Prepare and present data-driven analyses, forecasts, and recommendations for management review.
  • Create reports related to:
    • Material availability
    • Procurement activity
    • Supplier performance
    • DMSMS risks
    • Obsolescence trends
    • Inventory and demand planning
  • Utilize ERP, MRP, and business intelligence tools to improve procurement efficiency and decision making.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on enhancing supply chain visibility, procurement effectiveness, and program execution.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Contracts, Program Management, and suppliers to resolve procurement and material-related issues.
  • Participate in program reviews, supply chain reviews, integrated product team meetings, and procurement status meetings.
  • Present lifecycle assessments, risk mitigation plans, and procurement recommendations to leadership.
  • Maintain accurate procurement records, supporting documentation, and system data.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, Procurement, Engineering, Finance, or related field.
  • HS or GED required

Experience:

  • Minimum three (3) years of experience in procurement, supply chain management, sourcing, material planning, logistics, procurement analytics, or related disciplines.
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel and supply chain reporting tools.
  • Ability to analyze procurement, inventory, supplier, and operational performance data.

Preffered Experience

  • Experience supporting aerospace, defense, government, electronics manufacturing, or other highly regulated industries.
  • Experience with DMSMS, obsolescence management, and lifecycle planning.
  • Experience with Deltek Costpoint, SAP, Oracle, or similar ERP/MRP systems.
  • Experience using Power BI, reporting platforms, and business intelligence tools.
  • Experience working with product lifecycle management (PLM) systems.

Technical Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of:
    • FAR (Federal Acquisition Regulation)
    • DFARS (Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement)
    • Government procurement processes
    • Defense acquisition and logistics practices
  • Understanding of lifecycle sustainment and supply chain risk management methodologies.

Security Clearance Requirements

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Security Clearance as required by program and customer requirements.
  • U.S. citizenship may be required in accordance with contractual obligations, export control regulations, and government security requirements.
  • Must be able to successfully complete all required background investigations and security screenings.
  • Ability to comply with all company, customer, and government security policies associated with controlled unclassified information (CUI), export-controlled information, and classified materials.
  • Prior experience supporting classified, controlled-access, or secure government programs is preferred.
  • Active Secret Security Clearance is highly desirable.

Preferred Certifications

Supply Chain and Procurement

  • Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM)
  • Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP)
  • Certified in Planning and Inventory Management (CPIM)
  • Certified Purchasing Professional (CPP)
  • Certified Professional Purchasing Manager (CPPM)

Defense and Government Contracting

  • DAU Supply Chain, Acquisition, Logistics, or DAWIA Certifications
  • NCMA Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM)
  • NCMA Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM)

Analytics and Systems

  • Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Certification
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
  • ERP-related certifications (SAP, Oracle, Deltek Costpoint)
  • Project Management Professional (PMP)

Lifecycle and DMSMS

  • DAU DMSMS Certification
  • Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Certification
  • Lifecycle Logistics Certification
  • Reliability and Maintainability Certification

Any combination of education/experience may be substituted for job requirements at the recommendation of the hiring manager and approval of the COO and CEO.

title: Facility Operator
description:
About Us

At SECURE, we lead the way in waste management and energy infrastructure, providing unmatched security and peace of mind to our customers. Our strength lies in our size, extensive network, solid reputation, industry expertise, and a relentless can-do attitude.

With an expansive infrastructure network spanning Western Canada and North Dakota, we deliver essential solutions where they are needed most. Our partnerships focus on safely recovering oil and metals, disposing of liquid and solid waste, recycling materials such as metals, water, and oil, and reclaiming contaminated land to reduce environmental footprints.

SECURE is committed to innovation, helping our customers lower costs, reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, and exceed their business, safety, and environmental goals. We go beyond expectations — mitigating risks, reducing financial obligations, and maximizing value for our clients.

Join SECURE and be part of a team that steps up to make a meaningful difference in the industries we serve and the world we share.

Your Opportunity at SECURE

The Facility Operator position is responsible for the day-to-day safe and customer service-oriented operations of waste treatment, oil treatment and water injection. The Operator will actively assist with standard operating procedures, hazard assessments, safety programs and environment protection. The Operator will be in constant contact with customers and must demonstrate excellent communications skills and a high level of customer service.

This position is located in La Glace, AB.

The Team

The La Glace Facility is a fast paced and exciting facility to learn and grow in. Invest in your future with industry leading benefits package and savings plans. The successful candidate must also display a strong ability to work and communicate within a team environment.

Work Environment

This position is a 12 hour shift with 7 days on and 7 days off, alternating between days and nights.

A Day in The Life

  • Responsible and accountable for the day-to-day operation of the facility
  • Responsible for truck unloading, oil emulsion and water & vac trucks
  • Responsible for oil treating with the treater, cooler or tank treating
  • Participating in waste processing, waste and mud tank operation, shaker & centrifuge operations and solids treating
  • Responsible and accountable for the receipt, terminal storage and transportation of crude oil while adhering to Measurement & Crude Oil Quality compliance
  • Managing ongoing water injection, filter changing and pump maintenance
  • Conducting treatment of solids on the waste pad
  • Conducting boiler operations, testing and steam system operations
  • Ensuring that all corporate compliance programs are adhered to
  • Submitting truck tickets summary, daily plant checklists, and balance and transfers to the office
  • Participates in the Health & Safety Management System (HSMS)
  • Waste plant operation (ensuring solids processing is meeting or exceeding landfill criteria and solids testing)
  • Following water injection SOP’s and best practices to protect the disposal well integrity
  • General maintenance, ensure that the plant is kept clean and safe

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

  • A High School Diploma, General Education Diploma or equivalent
  • A minimum of 3 years operational experience in waste processing and oil treating or water injection
  • Midstream terminal operations experience is considered a strong asset
  • Specialty training in boilers, treaters, pumps (all), repairs, shaker/centrifuge and loader is considered an asset
  • Proven ability to demonstrate strong methods regarding all processes in the plant, including; safety operations, oil treating & blending, waste processing and water disposal
  • Current and valid safety tickets, including H2S Alive, First Aid Level One C, Confined Space Entry, WHMIS and TDG
  • A strong attention to detail, communication skills with the ability to work long hours in a mentally and physically demanding work environment
  • Must be able to document their work, perform and manage cross shift communication and ensure strategic communication with multiple stakeholders
  • Must be able to multi-task and demonstrate excellent decision-making skills with the ability to troubleshoot issues
  • Must demonstrate excellent customer service skills and safe work practices
  • A valid and acceptable Driver’s license and successful completion of Pre-employment testing

What's in it for you

At SECURE, we focus on opportunities for growth and improvement; for our employees, our customers, our partners, and the communities we operate in. We are an energetic team, driven by the needs of our customers, and we care about making a meaningful contribution. We strive to attract, retain, and motivate employees by offering a competitive compensation package that recognizes employee contributions and performance.

In addition to rewarding job opportunities, we offer:

  • Competitive industry wages and compensation programs which include:
  • Employer-paid benefits: health, dental & more
  • Health Care Spending Account
  • Employee Wellness Programs
  • Employee Savings Plan
  • Career progression
  • A competitive employee referral program
  • Industry-leading safety standards
  • Community investment initiatives (Our Stories)

We believe our team’s strength comes from our diversity.

Every SECURE employee has the right to feel safe and welcome. We pride ourselves on being a respectful workplace where all employees have equal access to opportunity and support.

We are a trusted partner. We extend those same efforts outside of the organization through our respectful engagement with our diverse base of stakeholders in the communities in which we operate.

Applicants are not assessed on the grounds of race, national or ethnic origin, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, or physical handicap. Our operations span across Canada and the United States, and we actively seek out a wide range of applicants for both field operations and office roles.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Overview

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, homeland, healthcare, and intelligence sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

LMI is seeking a skilled Systems Engineer to design, integrate, validate, and sustain enterprise IT capabilities across a network of new and existing secure facilities. The Systems Engineer will work across networking, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, applications, data, and operations to ensure that individual components function together as a secure, resilient, and supportable system. This is an execution-oriented role supporting a fast-paced, milestone-driven prototype effort with near-term deliverable commitments. Success requires systems thinking, disciplined technical analysis, effective communication, and the ability to manage requirements, interfaces, dependencies, risk, and lifecycle considerations.

Primary duties include:

  • Enumerate and document the technical baseline across geographically dispersed sites, including systems, services, interfaces, dependencies, security boundaries, and classified and unclassified network enclaves.
  • Translate mission and stakeholder needs into clear, measurable, testable, and traceable system requirements.
  • Develop current-state, transition-state, and target-state system designs that integrate network, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, application, identity, and data capabilities.
  • Define system boundaries, interfaces, data flows, assumptions, constraints, and performance requirements across engineering disciplines.
  • Conduct technical analyses and trade studies addressing capability, interoperability, security, resilience, cost, schedule, risk, and lifecycle impacts.
  • Develop and execute integration, verification, validation, and acceptance plans demonstrating that delivered capabilities satisfy mission and operational requirements.
  • Establish and maintain system configurations, technical baselines, architecture products, interface documentation, and engineering decision records.
  • Coordinate with engineering leads, operators, security personnel, and government stakeholders to identify and resolve cross-domain technical issues.
  • Develop automated methods for system provisioning, integration, testing, configuration validation, monitoring, compliance assessment, and recovery to improve consistency and reduce manual effort.

FOUNDATIONAL SKILLS

  • Systems engineering lifecycle principles and systems thinking.
  • Requirements analysis, decomposition, allocation, and traceability.
  • System architecture, integration, interfaces, and dependency management.
  • Verification, validation, test planning, and acceptance criteria.
  • Network, compute, storage, virtualization, cloud, identity, cybersecurity, application, and data fundamentals.
  • Reliability, availability, maintainability, scalability, resilience, and continuity of operations.
  • Configuration management, change control, technical baselines, and decision analysis.
  • Automation, scripting, configuration management, and infrastructure-as-code concepts.
  • Structured troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, technical documentation, and stakeholder communication.

Location: This position is based in the Washington, DC metro area, with travel to program locations.

Travel: This position requires approximately 25-50% travel to support activities across multiple program locations.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience designing, integrating, testing, or sustaining complex enterprise IT systems, including in classified environments.
  • Demonstrated experience managing system requirements, interfaces, dependencies, configurations, and technical documentation.
  • Experience integrating capabilities across network, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, application, identity, or data domains.
  • Experience engineering capabilities for SCIF or other accredited classified environments, including multi-enclave systems and security boundaries.
  • Working knowledge of the Risk Management Framework (NIST SP 800-37 / 800-53) and experience advising senior leaders.
  • Active Top Secret Clearance (SCI eligibility) required.

Nice to Have:

  • Relevant systems engineering, architecture, or cybersecurity certification.
  • Experience integrating cross-domain solutions (CDS) into enterprise architectures.
  • Experience supporting Special Access Program (SAP) facilities, systems, or environments.
  • Experience designing or standing up network or security operations centers (NOC/SOC), including 24x7 coverage models.

TS/SCI clearance and SAP eligibility are required for this position. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. LMI will only consider applicants with current security clearances. Please note that only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Target salary range: $125,000 - $250,000

Disclaimer:

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

title: Global Product Security Services Lead
description:

title: Lead Kotlin Backend Engineer Amsterdam
description:
Vacature: Lead Kotlin Backend Engineer

  • Wil jij werken aan een platform dat een groenere wereldondersteunt en waarin jouw technische keuzes én jouw begeleiding van mensendirect impact hebben?
  • Wil jij een FP/Kotlin-squad helpen groeien richting technische en professionele volwassenheid, terwijl je zelf actief meebouwt aan een moderne backend?
  • Werk je graag in een omgeving waar engineering persoonlijk is, teams compact zijn en jouw invloed vanaf de eerste dag zichtbaar is?

Dan past deze rol precies bij jou.

Jouw werkgever: een Europees platform met een sterk engineeringhart

Je komt terecht bij een middelgrote, techgerichte organisatie met een platform dat actief is in meerdere Europese regio’s. Achter het platform staat een Kotlin-first engineeringorganisatie die kiest voor duurzame, betrouwbare en hoogwaardige backend-systemen.

Je werkt in een cultuur waar squads compact, betrokken en communicatief sterk zijn. Engineers waarderen vakmanschap, helderheid en samenwerking. De organisatie draait serieuze productieomgevingen, maar blijft klein genoeg voor echte invloed: op hoe teams samenwerken, hoe service evolueren en hoe technisch leiderschap wordt ingevuld.

De organisatie start nu met een nieuwe fase. Na jaren bouwen en opschalen investeert ze in een sterkere technische leiderschapslaag, met nadruk op mensen, teamcohesie en langetermijnkwaliteit. Wanneer jij instapt, help jij deze volgende groeifase vormgeven.

De balans is uitstekend: het bedrijf is remote-friendly, met slechts twee kantoordagen per maand.

Jouw rol: Lead Kotlin Backend Engineer Amsterdam

Vanaf het begin krijg je verantwoordelijkheid die er toe doet. Samen met de andere leads en de VP Engineering bepaal je welke squad het beste aansluit bij jouw stijl van werken en begeleiden.

Sommige squads bestaan uit mid-level engineers die baat hebben bij coaching, structuur en richting. Andere squads zijn senior-zwaar en verwachten van jou vooral technische aansturing, systeemoverzicht en strategisch denken.

In je dagelijkse werk combineer je techniek en leiderschap op een natuurlijke manier.

Je bouwt Kotlin-services, ontwerpt event driven domain flows en scherpt service boundaries aan. Je helpt engineers beter nadenken over architectuur, betrouwbaarheid, domeinlogica en samenwerking. Je doet code reviews, begeleidt technische beslissingen en brengt structuur aan in complexe discussies. Je helpt processen verbeteren en draagt actief bij aan een sterke engineeringcultuur.

Daarnaast zorg je voor duidelijkheid en stabiliteit binnen het team:

Je maakt refinements effectiever, helpt samen met product prioriteiten bepalen en creëert een omgeving waarin engineers zich gesteund voelen en de ruimte hebben om te groeien. Je introduceert teamritmes die rust brengen, samenwerking versterken en zorgen voor consistentie.

Jouw invloed zie je terug in mensen, in cultuur en in de kwaliteit van het platform.

Je ontwikkelt engineers, versterkt team dynamiek en realiseert duurzame verbeteringen door het hele systeem heen.

Dit is een rol voor iemand die twee werelden wil combineren: diepe Kotlin/FP engineering en invloed op mensen en teams.

Wat je meebrengt

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in backend-engineering
  • Ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van gedistribueerde backend-systemen
  • Sterke ervaring met Kotlin, Java of Scala en duidelijke interesse in FP
  • Ervaring met microservices en event driven architecturen
  • Een productgerichte en pragmatische mindset
  • Ervaring met Docker, Kubernetes en cloud native omgevingen
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en emotionele intelligentie
  • Ervaring met het begeleiden en mentoreren van software engineers
  • Vermogen om duidelijkheid, richting en structuur te brengen in een team
  • Ervaring met Arrow, Redis, Ktor en/of Meilisearch is een plus

Wat je krijgt

  • Salaris tussen €85.000 en €100.000, afhankelijk van ervaring
  • Tot 8 procent jaarbonus
  • Remote friendly: grotendeels werken vanuit huis, met slechts twee kantoordagen per maand
  • 25 vakantiedagen
  • Opleidings- en trainingsbudget
  • Goede pensioenregeling
  • Flexibele werktijden en ruime thuiswerkmogelijkheden
  • Reiskostenvergoeding
  • Kwalitatieve hardware, waaronder MacBook-opties
  • Ruimte voor cursussen, meetups, trainingen en seminars
  • Een warme, compacte engineeringcommunity waar jouw leiderschap echt het verschil maakt

Klaar om een Kotlin-squad te leiden waar jouw impact op mensen, cultuur en systemen vanaf dag één zichtbaar is?

title: Quality Lead
description:
Overview

Do you want to work for a caring organisation that believes in people?

Do you want to make a difference?

Would you like to work in an environment where you can use your experience and skills to achieve the best for people?

Change Grow Live North Northmptonshire have an exciting new post and are looking for a Quality Lead to join our team

We are committed to improving the services we provide and therefore we are looking to recruit someone with the same ambition.

The post holder will be integral to ensuring a high-quality service is delivered across all sites in North Northamptonshire.

As part of the service management team, you will be required to undertake a quality improvement and development role, which will include creating and undertaking regular and cyclical audits of all aspects of service delivery, collating areas of best practice, implementing quality improvement plans and evaluating impact. As part of this process you will assist in observed practice, staff coaching, and designing and delivering training and workshop sessions.

You will be instrumental in embedding the CGL learning culture within the service by sharing learning from all incidents and, inclusively with the staff team, implementing actions to reduce likelihood of reoccurrence.In fulfilling these aims the post holder will keep up to date with quality improvement progress across the sector, emerging evidence-based practice and new legislation including regulation.

Covering three hubs in North Northamptonshire this role will move between sites as needed to support teams and guide service development. The role will also support the service with safeguarding and attendance at meeting and providing information to Care Quality Commission and the local coroners office and local safeguarding boards.

Location: Kettering

Hours: Part time, 30 hours per week

Contract Type: Permanent

Responsibilities

About the Role:

  • Be required to improve quality which will include creating and undertaking regular, cyclical audits of all aspects of service delivery and governance.
  • Identify areas of good practice and areas that need improving and formulate robust plans.
  • Implement these plans with all relevant staff, including leaders and front-line staff and will set up evaluation mechanisms to understand ‘what works’; impact of action plans in improving practice.
  • Work with the team to ensure effective observed practice, coaching, and designing and delivering training and workshop sessions.
  • Working with the senior leadership team to co-ordinate integrated quality audits across all areas of service delivery in line with the organisational audit cycle.
  • Support the Designated Safeguarding Lead to ensure that the effective identification, assessment and management of risk and compliance with relevant legislation and policy and procedures are upheld.
  • Ensure effective investigations of all incidents and ensure learning is disseminated appropriately throughout the service.
  • You will collate lessons learned quarterly to collate themes and patterns to feed into the whole service quality improvement plan and contract monitoring reporting.
  • Produce reports in a timely manner in order that the service.improve outcomes for service users.

About You:

Education, Knowledge and Experience:

  • Experience in Social Care and the Drug & Alcohol sector, with strong knowledge of the recovery ethos.
  • Background in project development, change management, and use of quality management systems.
  • Skilled in root cause analysis for serious incident investigations.
  • Proficient in audits and service reviews to drive evaluation and improvement.
  • Experience working within regulated services, including knowledge of CQC regulations and Key Lines of Enquiry.
  • Confident delivering training to diverse groups using coaching and interactive methods.
  • Strong understanding of safeguarding procedures for children and vulnerable adults.
  • Proven ability to analyse and cross-reference data sources to inform conclusions and improvement priorities.
  • Experience in influencing stakeholders at all levels through clear, persuasive communication.
  • Able to evaluate the impact of change, lead teams through improvement processes, and promote CGL’s values through action.

Abilities and Skills:

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, across a range of stakeholders including service users, staff, and partners.
  • Able to work independently and under pressure, with well-developed organisational and time management abilities.
  • Demonstrates empathy, professionalism, and non-judgement in all interactions.
  • Committed to positive outcomes for service users and to equality, diversity, and inclusion.
  • Maintains professional boundaries and works effectively with external agencies.

What We Offer

  • Enjoy a dedicated weekly Wellness Hour, access to our Wellness Hub, and a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme to support your mental and emotional health.
  • We’re committed to your development, with extensive training, funded learning, and pathways into senior or specialist roles.
  • Benefit from transparent pay, a contributory pension scheme, and additional support through our wellbeing resources.
  • Start with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays(pro rata), increasing to the maximum 30 days over five years of service.
  • Join a supportive, values-led team where you’ll feel encouraged and valued from your very first day.
  • Where possible, we’re open to discussing working patterns that help you maintain a healthy work–life balance.
  • Enjoy discounts on shopping, cinema trips, holidays and more, along with our Refer a Friend scheme.

title: Associate Scientist, QC Chemistry
description:
At Alcami, we deliver reliable solutions that unlock the potential of transformative medicines from discovery to commercialization, through trusted partnership with our clients, recognized industry expertise and proven regulatory track record.

Are you interested in joining our team?

Job Summary

The Associate Scientist, QC Chemistry is accountable for driving results in a fast-paced environment by performing analytical routine and non-routine testing in support of pharmaceutical product development or pharmaceutical manufacturing. The Associate Scientist, QC Chemistry may also assist with method development/method validation projects. For this position, UV-Vis, Dissolution, HPLC, GC, Titration, and/or KF based methodologies are commonly employed in the described testing.

On-Site Expectations

  • 100% on-site position.
  • 1st Shift: Monday - Friday, 8:30am - 5:30pm.

Responsibilities

  • Performs one or more of the following techniques: residual solvents, assays (potencies, related substances), dissolution, moisture content, identification, and other various analytical techniques.
  • Maintains working knowledge of routine instrumentation, equipment, and scientific methodologies necessary to perform assigned tasks.
  • Performs assigned tasks carefully and on schedule according to standard operating procedure and supervisor instructions.
  • Analyzes information for technical correctness and accuracy.
  • Complies with applicable GMPs, peer checks information and signs for GMP review. Brings aberrant information to the attention of supervisor.
  • Maintains a safe, clean, and organized work environment free of safety hazards.
  • Suggests improvements for safety, work quality, and productivity.
  • Ensures timely completion and compliance with cGMP and all other relevant company training requirements.
  • Seeks to cultivate mentorship, build leadership skills, and foster a culture of ‘team first’.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemistry or a related field.
  • 0 - 4+ years of related work experience.
  • Prior laboratory experience or work experience in Pharmaceutical, CDMO, or cGMP preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and documentation skills required.
  • Excellent detail orientation and organizational skills required.
  • Excellent problem-solving and basic trouble-shooting ability required.
  • Basic knowledge of Laboratory equipment and safety required.
  • Basic knowledge of Laboratory Documentation is required.
  • Working knowledge of cGMP in a pharmaceutical or regulated environment preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) required.
  • Applies job skills, company policies and SOPs to complete a variety of tasks.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk or hear and smell. The employee is frequently required to stand. The employee is occasionally required to walk; sit and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

title: DevOps Engineer (Development-first) – Team Facturen
description:
Wil jij vooral bouwen, maar wél met eigenaarschap over het hele proces?

Voor een grote, complexe organisatie zoeken we een DevOps Engineer waarbij softwareontwikkeling centraal staat. Je werkt binnen het team Facturen, verantwoordelijk voor een van de meest bedrijfskritische platformen: alles wat met facturatie te maken heeft.

De organisatie bevindt zich midden in een grote cloudtransitie waarbij legacy-systemen worden uitgefaseerd en vervangen door moderne oplossingen in AWS. Development is hierin leidend; analyse, testen en beheer zijn geïntegreerde onderdelen van het werk.

Over de rol

Als DevOps Engineer binnen team Facturen ben je in de eerste plaats developer. Je bouwt en verbetert software die essentieel is voor de dagelijkse operatie. Tegelijkertijd neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit, testbaarheid en stabiliteit van wat je ontwikkelt.

Je werkt in een multidisciplinair DevOps-team met andere developers en engineers. Van het begrijpen van de businessvraag tot het ontwikkelen, testen en live brengen van oplossingen: je pakt het end-to-end op.

Dit is nadrukkelijk geen beheer- of testrol met af en toe development, maar een ontwikkelrol in een DevOps-context.

  • Ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van software binnen het facturatieplatform
  • Bouwen aan cloud-native oplossingen in een AWS-omgeving
  • Meedenken over functionele en technische oplossingen
  • Schrijven van kwalitatieve, goed geteste en onderhoudbare code
  • Samenwerken met collega’s aan analyse, ontwerp en implementatie
  • Bijdragen aan CI/CD, testautomatisering en stabiliteit
  • Meedraaien in DevOps-verantwoordelijkheden (monitoring, livegang, incidenten)

Wat breng jij mee

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau
  • Ervaring of sterke affiniteit met cloudontwikkeling (AWS)
  • Bekend met Agile/Scrum en DevOps-werkwijzen
  • Bereidheid om naast development ook test- en beheertaken op te pakken
  • Analytisch sterk en communicatief vaardig
  • Ervaring met Python
  • Kennis van AWS-diensten
  • Ervaring met CI/CD-processen
  • Ervaring met financiële of facturatiesystemen

Wat je kunt verwachten

  • Werken aan een bedrijfskritisch platform met grote impact
  • Veel ruimte voor technische groei en ontwikkeling
  • Lange termijn perspectief binnen één domein
  • Samenwerking in een volwassen DevOps-team
  • Hybride werken (deels op locatie, deels remote)

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Overview

The First Group Hospitality is a Dubai-headquartered, full-service hospitality management company specialising in hotel operations, asset management, and F&B strategy. With a team of industry veterans and a proven track record, the company delivers tailored solutions that enhance efficiency, optimise revenue, and maximise asset value for investors and hotel owners.

As a trusted third-party hotel management provider, The First Group Hospitality partners with leading global brands to drive operational excellence and long-term profitability, thanks to expertise spanning property performance optimisation, cost management, and guest experience enhancement. Beyond management, The First Group Hospitality develops and operates a dynamic portfolio of upscale hotels, residences, and award-winning restaurants, creating high-value hospitality assets that stand out in the market.

For more information, visit tfghospitality.com

The First Group Hospitality, Exclusive Private Members' Club in Abu Dhabi is seeking a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to support the club’s brand, marketing, events, and member communications. The successful candidate will create high-quality visual content that reflects the club’s luxury positioning and ensures a consistent and sophisticated brand identity across all digital and printed touchpoints.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-quality creative materials for digital, print, social media, events, campaigns, and member communications.
  • Develop marketing collateral including brochures, menus, invitations, presentations, signage, advertisements, and promotional materials.

title: UNAVAILABLE
description:
Overview

As a patient-focused organization, University of Utah Health exists to enhance the health and well-being of people through patient care, research and education. Success in this mission requires a culture of collaboration, excellence, leadership, and respect. University of Utah Health seeks staff that are committed to the values of compassion, collaboration, innovation, responsibility, integrity, quality and trust that are integral to our mission. EO/AA

Retail pharmacists insure safe, effective, and cost-efficient medication therapy is implemented for all patients in their care. This includes preparing medications, participating in the drug distribution process, monitoring drug therapy, providing drug information to patients and providers, providing clinical pharmacy services, solving medication related problems for individual patients as well as in the medication use process, and supervise daily workflow to accomplish daily tasks allotted to the pharmacist and those who report to him or her (e.g., technicians, residents, students, or interns). Clinical pharmacists participate in quality improvement projects to improve clinical care or pharmacy operations. Retail pharmacists must work effectively as a team member, communicate clearly, assertively, and professionally, to all pharmacy customers including patients, their families, and other staff members, and provide superior customer service when interacting with patients, visitors, family members, staff, co-workers, and vendors. Retail pharmacists must be willing to work with trainees in the department (eg, students, interns, residents or new staff).

Corporate Overview: The University of Utah is a Level 1 Trauma Center and is nationally ranked and recognized for our academic research, quality standards and overall patient experience. Our five hospitals and eleven clinics provide excellence in our comprehensive services, medical advancement, and overall patient outcomes.

Responsibilities

Essential Functions

  • Solves problems in the medication use process for patients and the organization.
  • Identifies and engages in organizational and department quality improvement activities to improve patient care, medication use process, and pharmacy operations.
  • Educates and trains residents, students, interns, colleagues and other health care professionals as well as supervises technicians, residents, interns, or trainees in their job tasks.
  • Responsible for the medication use process of preparing and dispensing medications following medication use policy and all laws, regulations, and standards applicable to pharmacy practice.
  • Assesses appropriate drug information and literature resources, and provides effective information to varied audiences including patients, other health care professions, and peers.
  • Operationalizes organizational policy and State and Federal regulations and laws concerning cash handling, billing, inventory control, controlled substances, and other compliance and regulatory functions.
  • May perform the responsibilities of a pharmacist-in-charge, or license holder according to Federal, State of Utah, or other relevant states, or laws and regulations. This includes meeting all of the regulatory and compliance issues for the assigned registered pharmacy.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the job as outlined in the position description.
  • Ability and willingness to train department trainees (eg students, residents, new staff).
  • Ability to assess data regarding the patient's status and provide care as described in the department's policies and procedures manual.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients served on his or her assigned unit.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the principles of life span growth and development and the ability to assess data regarding the patient's status and provide care as described in the department's policies and procedures manual.

Qualifications

Required

  • Demonstrated excellent human relation, effective communication, and computer literacy skills.
  • Additional qualifications may be required depending on area the pharmacist is primarily assigned to work. Examples of additional qualifications could include basic or advanced life-support training, residency training, or certifications.

Licenses Required

  • Current licensure to dispense controlled substances in the State of Utah.
  • Current Pharmacist license in the State of Utah.
* Additional license requirements as determined by the hiring department.

Preferred

Employee must be able to meet the following requirements with or without an accommodation.

This position involves standing for extended periods of time and is not exposed to adverse environmental conditions.

Listening, Manual Dexterity, Pulling and/or Pushing, Sitting, Standing, Walking

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
The Hague, Netherlands (Hybrid - Flexible)

I'm currently partnering with a stealth, privacy-first AI healthtech company that's building the infrastructure needed to unlock sensitive clinical data safely and responsibly.

They're developing technology that enables healthcare and life-science organisations to make better use of clinical data, improving access to clinical trials, supporting real-world evidence, and accelerating medical research.

They're now looking for a Senior Data Engineer to own the trusted clinical-data foundation behind their products, customer workflows and research environments.

This is not simply a pipeline-building role. You'll be working with messy, real-world clinical data from hospital and EHR systems, investigating its quality, semantics and relationships before designing the engineering solutions needed to make that data reliable, reusable and production-ready.

You'll join a small, multidisciplinary team working across data, AI, product, clinical, privacy/security and customer delivery, with significant autonomy and ownership over technically challenging problems.

The Successful Senior Data Engineer will have:

  • A strong senior-level track record of independently owning, shipping and operating production data platforms or pipelines end-to-end.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, including data modelling, complex queries, testing, debugging and maintainable production code.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating ETL/ELT pipelines, with Apache Airflow or comparable orchestration experience.
  • Experience investigating and modelling messy structured and unstructured data before implementing production pipelines.
  • Strong engineering practices around automated testing, code review, version control, documentation, CI/CD and observability.
  • Experience working in cloud-native environments, ideally with Google Cloud; Azure experience is also valuable.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • The ownership, judgement and communication skills required to work effectively in a small, multidisciplinary team.
  • Professional fluency in English and a relevant degree or equivalent practical experience.

Senior Data Engineer Nice to Haves:

  • Experience working with clinical, healthcare or EHR data.
  • Experience with FHIR, HL7, OMOP, openEHR or other healthcare interoperability standards.
  • Familiarity with clinical terminology and coding systems such as ICD, SNOMED CT, LOINC or ATC.
  • Experience with clinical research, clinical trials, registries or real-world evidence.
  • Exposure to LLMs, medical NLP, RAG, embeddings, knowledge graphs or modern AI applications.
  • Experience with Terraform, dbt or Kafka.
  • Experience working in regulated environments or collaborating with Dutch-language customers.

Benefits for the successful Senior Data Engineer:

  • Work on meaningful clinical-data problems that can increase access to clinical trials and accelerate medical research.
  • High autonomy and genuine influence over architecture, engineering standards and delivery practices.
  • A high-spec MacBook Pro and access to leading engineering and AI tools.
  • Flexible hybrid working with significant autonomy.
  • The opportunity to work abroad for two periods of up to two weeks per year, subject to applicable requirements.
  • 25 paid holiday days per year, plus commuting compensation.
  • A dedicated learning and development budget.
  • The opportunity to grow into a Founding Engineer role, with broader technical leadership and ownership.
  • A collaborative, multidisciplinary team working on technology that directly impacts patients, healthcare and medical research.

This is an opportunity for a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys making messy, high-stakes data dependable to take genuine ownership of the data foundation behind an ambitious healthtech company.

title: Skilled Laborers - Gas Ops
description:
About Us

NorthStar Energy Solutions, a Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE:PWR) company, is headquartered in Grand Prairie, TX and operates across the Central Southwest part of the United States. We are leaders specializing in transmission lines, distribution lines, substation construction, foundations, storm damage repairs, and electrical contracting.

Joining our team means being part of an organization that values drive and inclusion. We focus on career development and reward excellence, recognizing each team member's unique contributions. We're at the forefront of powering modern life. Discover how your skills and dedication can make a real difference to us.

About this Role

Northstar Energy Solutions is looking for a Skilled Laborer to support gas construction and maintenance operations, including the installation, repair, and maintenance of natural gas mains, service lines, and related equipment. This role performs hands-on field labor under the direction of crew leaders and foremen, helping ensure safe, efficient, and code-compliant execution of gas construction and maintenance activities.

Location: 3340 Roy Orr Blvd, Grand Prairie, TX 75050Schedule: Monday–Friday, with on-call, overtime, and weekend availability as operational needs require

What You'll Do

  • Assist with the installation, repair, maintenance, and testing of natural gas mains, service lines, valves, and related equipment.
  • Perform excavation, trenching, backfilling, and site restoration in accordance with company and utility standards.
  • Operate hand tools, power tools, and light equipment used in gas construction and maintenance activities.
  • Assist with pipe fusion, joining, tie-ins, and tapping operations under the direction of qualified operators.
  • Locate, expose, and protect existing underground utilities prior to and during excavation.
  • Load, unload, and transport materials, tools, and equipment to and from job sites.
  • Set up and maintain traffic control, barricades, signage, and work zone safety measures.
  • Assist with pressure testing, purging, and leak surveys on gas piping systems.

title: SITEC - Riverbed Systems Engineer - MacDill AFB
description:
Responsibilities

Peraton requires Systems Engineers to support the Special Operation Command Information Technology Enterprise Contract (SITEC) – 3 EOM. This position is located at MacDill AFB in Florida.

The purpose of the Special Operations Forces Information Technology Enterprise Contract (SITEC) 3 Enterprise Operations and Maintenance (EOM) Task Order (TO) is to provide USSOCOM, its Component Commands, its Theater Special Operations Commands (TSOCs), and its deployed forces with Operations and Maintenance (O&M) services to maintain Network Operations (NetOps); maintain systems and network infrastructure; provide end user and common device support; provide configuration, change, license, and asset management; conduct training, and perform Install, Move, Add, Change (IMACs) services. The responsibilities and tasks associated with each requirement play a pivotal role to USSOCOM, the CIO/J6 organization, and ultimately the end-user who operate around the globe 24x7x365.

The Riverbed Systems Engineer serves as the senior technical authority for Riverbed performance monitoring, digital experience management, and network visibility platforms across the enterprise environment. This role is responsible for engineering, administration, optimization, cybersecurity compliance, and lifecycle management of Riverbed technologies excluding SteelHead WAN optimization appliances.

The engineer will operate within and support multiple classified and unclassified environments, ensuring secure, compliant, and highly available performance monitoring capabilities across J6 mission systems.

This position supports operations within the following enclaves:

  • NIPR (Non-classified Internet Protocol Router Network)
  • SIPR (Secret Internet Protocol Router Network)
  • SOCRATES (as defined by the supported command architecture)

The Riverbed SME will manage and support the following suites, as deployed:

  • Riverbed AppResponse
  • Riverbed NetProfiler
  • Riverbed Portal
  • Riverbed Aternity
  • Riverbed NPM+

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Engineering
  • Design and implement secure Riverbed monitoring architectures across NIPR, SIPR, and SOCRATES enclaves.
  • Develop enclave-specific system design documentation and data flow diagrams.
  • Engineer scalable deployments supporting hybrid, virtual, and physical infrastructures.
  • Integrate Riverbed tools with SIEM, ITSM, cybersecurity, and enterprise monitoring platforms.
  • Ensure cross-domain and enclave segmentation compliance.
  • Operations & Administration
  • Provide Tier II/III engineering support and root cause analysis.
  • Administer platform configuration, system health monitoring, and performance tuning.
  • Perform software upgrades, patching, backups, and disaster recovery validation.
  • Maintain role-based access controls (RBAC) and auditing policies.
  • Support configuration management and change control boards (CCB).
  • Proficiency in Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Combine subsystems, resolve compatibility issues, and ensure interoperability
  • Performance Monitoring & Optimization
  • Analyze application, network, and endpoint performance trends.
  • Generate executive dashboards and mission-impact assessments.
  • Develop actionable insights to reduce latency, packet loss, and user-impacting incidents.
  • Tune alert thresholds and monitoring policies to reduce noise.
  • Cybersecurity & Compliance
  • Maintain compliance with DoD cybersecurity standards and STIG requirements.
  • Support ATO lifecycle documentation and security control validation.
  • Coordinate vulnerability scanning, remediation, and patch cycles.
  • Ensure enclave-specific hardening baselines are maintained.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Develop and maintain SOPs, engineering diagrams, and operational runbooks.
  • Provide weekly/monthly operational reports to leadership.
  • Brief senior leadership on system health, trends, and risk posture.
  • Collaboration & Leadership
  • Coordinate with Network, Cybersecurity, Systems, and Application teams.
  • Support incident response and war-room troubleshooting efforts.
  • Provide mentorship to junior administrators and engineers.
  • Serve as the technical liaison between contractor teams and government leadership.
  • Troubleshooting and Support
  • Monitor the health and performance of the monitoring servers themselves, proactively addressing any issues.
  • Investigate and resolve issues related to data collection, ensuring all monitored devices are reporting correctly.
  • Basic to intermediate scripting skills (PowerShell, Bash, Python) for automation of routine tasks.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Min 12 years with HS degree, 10 years with AS/AA degree, 8 years with BS/BA, 6 years with MS/MA, 3 years with PhD
  • DoD 8570 IAT II Certification
  • DoW TS/SCI clearance

title: Senior Construction Engineer
description:
Overview

Shimmick is seeking an experienced Senior Construction Engineer in Palmdale, California, to support the Palmdale Water Reclamation Plant Influent Pump Station Modification project. This project for the Los Angeles County Sanitation District (LACSD) includes upgrades to influent pumping and electrical systems, construction of a new utility building, and associated civil improvements. Backed by over 100 years of expertise and driven by innovation and an entrepreneurial spirit, Shimmick is one of the most dynamic infrastructure builders in the industry. With market leadership in water resources, sustainable transportation, and complex electrical construction, we’re well-positioned to lead during a time of rapid change. As project delivery models, regulatory frameworks, supply chains, and technology continue to evolve, our ability to stay flexible and agile in our construction approach is essential to our success.

Southwest Division

Shimmick’s Southwest Division, headquartered in Irvine, California, focuses on large public owners in Southern California, across water resources, water treatment, transportation and transit markets. Over the past decade, the division has grown tremendously, securing major projects, including the $350 million North City Pure Water Facility in San Diego at the $200 million Groundwater Replenishment System in Orange County.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

Field Engineering & Project Execution

  • Provide technical support to field crews, ensuring accurate interpretation of drawings, specifications, and contract requirements.
  • Oversee layout, surveying, and grade control to maintain project accuracy.
  • Help manage and implement construction methodologies and best practices in collaboration with the superintendent and project team.
  • Reports to and support superintendent in day-to-day tasks.
  • Management of subcontractors scopes to ensure compliance with project specifications.
  • Coordination and interface with other stakeholders which includes inspectors, subcontractors and suppliers.
  • Management of assigned Force Account work.

Quality Control & Safety Compliance

  • Conduct field inspections to ensure work meets Shimmick’s quality standards and project specifications.
  • Work with the Quality Control/Project team to document and resolve non-conformances.
  • Assist in safety audits and enforce compliance with OSHA and Shimmick safety policies.
  • Promote a safety-first culture by proactively identifying and mitigating potential hazards.

Scheduling & Cost Management

  • Assist in developing, updating, and maintaining project schedules.
  • Track material quantities, labor hours, and equipment utilization to support cost control efforts.
  • Identify and help resolve potential project delays or budget overruns.

Communication & Coordination

  • Work closely with the Project Team which includes project manager, engineers, superintendent and foremen to facilitate smooth execution.
  • Prepare and track RFIs (Requests for Information), submittals, daily reports, and as-built documentation.
  • Participate in daily and weekly construction meetings to discuss project progress and challenges.
  • Serve as a liaison between the field and office, ensuring seamless communication and issue resolution.

Technology & Documentation

  • Utilize construction management software such as Bluebeam, AutoCAD, Procore, Microsoft Office Packages, CMiC etc.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field + 4 years of relevant heavy civil experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Established water/wastewater treatment plant construction project experience.
  • Experience in heavy civil construction with an understanding of construction methods, means, and materials.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to interpret plans, specifications, and technical documents.
  • Knowledge of OSHA regulations and safety standards.
  • Effective leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work in outdoor and high-paced field environments.

Additional Information:

  • Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.
  • This position does not include sponsorship for a United States work authorization.

The salary range for this position is between $112,000 - $135,000 per year depending on experience and/or education.

title: Vice President of Property Technology
description:
Why us?

Sage Hospitality Group is set to hire a Vice President of Property Technology to join us.

As part of Sage Hospitality Group, we passionately strive to be the best and create excellence in everything we do. We believe in enriching lives one experience at a time. More than a slogan, we empower our employees to make positive impacts on the communities in which we live and work. We are looking for independent thinkers. Those who harness their entrepreneurial spirit so that it breaks preconceived notions. We’re not afraid to forge our own path. After all, it’s what industry leaders do. That’s why we welcome risk takers and creative spirits alike. No matter your daily role, Sage recognizes that your success is about more than the work you do—it’s really about who you are, which is why we invest in your personal and professional growth. We hope you consider joining us!

Job Overview

The VP of Property Technology has full oversight for technology within the four walls of our hotels, restaurants, and spas. We use third-party MSPs for 24x7 IT break-fix support, so this role is less support and more project management, brand compliance, capital planning, Operating Expense budgeting, vendor management, coordination of property transitions/openings/construction/renovations, new property due diligence, and strategic direction for the Property Technology function. The ideal candidate is someone who has the technical skill to go on a site visit solo and come up with a transition checklist, the project management skills to manage complex system upgrades/installations including vendor coordination and management, and the political savvy to work with other VPs at Sage to represent IT interests in the broader scope of hotel/restaurant operations. Further, the ideal candidate should feel confident explaining IT expenses, IT vendor decisions, and IT architectures to property owners, asset managers, and major hotel brands.

The VP of Property Technology will collaborate with VPs of Operations, VPs of Operations Finance, hotel and restaurant General Managers, property owners and asset managers to ensure the successful funding and operation of technology solutions at Sage-managed properties.

Responsibilities

  • Accountability for the operation of all property technology solutions
  • Collaboration with VPs of Operations and VPs of Operations Finance on annual property budgets
  • Project management and ownership for all IT activities for a small portfolio of hotels
  • Stay abreast of all brand guidance (e.g., mobile key, associate alert systems) for major hospitality brands such as Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, IHG, Wyndham and Choice
  • Stay abreast of hospitality technology trends, vendors and cost-efficient solutions
  • Serve as point of escalation for all technology vendor relationships, including MSP partners
  • Serve as technical expert in conversations with business development leaders and current and prospective property owners and asset managers
  • Advocate for technology solutions that are cost-efficient, reliable, scalable, secure and accurate
  • Direct timely and effective management of IT related projects including system upgrades, server replacements, network infrastructure initiatives, etc.
  • Manage all hardware/software selection, maintenance, upgrade, and end-of-life planning
  • Research and offer technical solutions for friction/pain points at properties

  • Research and recommend system upgrades for property and above-property technology platforms
  • Ability to analyze complex technical information and findings, and present it to leadership in a cost and benefit framework
  • Provide effective project management on enterprise-wide initiatives pertaining to IT

OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES

  • All other duties as assigned, requested or deemed necessary by management.

Provide coaching and career development to a team of property technology associates. Most importantly, keep the team’s technical skills relevant through continuous learning, training, certifications, conferences and networking with other hospitality companies.

­2-5 direct reports with a full team size of 5-10, not including consultants and third-party MSPs

description:

NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals (NPH) is dedicated to providing unparalleled service to our patients, team members, physicians, and families. With locations in Indiana, Michigan, Texas, Ohio, and Arizona, we are expanding access to our unique model of care across the United States. Join NPH and become part of a team that is daring to do things differently and making a lasting difference in the lives of our patients, families, and communities every day.

Overview

Medical Behavioral Hospital of Clear Lake a part of NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals, is currently searching for a Discharge Planner to join our Social Services team to support our patients at our hospital in Clear Lake, TX. title: Senior Software Engineer Backend
description:
At TicketSwap, we’re on a mission to become the experience marketplace every fan loves. With over 20 million users across 42 countries, we’re building a safe, fair, and easy way for fans to buy and sell tickets to live events around the world. Technology plays a central role in how we solve problems for fans. From scaling our platform and improving event creation to building safer ticketing flows, we’re constantly working on products that make live experiences more accessible and trustworthy.

We’re built by fans, for fans. That means we care deeply about creating products that genuinely help people, and we believe the best ideas come from curious, collaborative teams who enjoy building together. Right now, we’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer Backend (PHP) to join our Engineering team in Amsterdam.

Ready to help shape the future of live events? Keep reading

What You’ll Do

As a Backend Engineer at TicketSwap, you’ll work on the systems that power millions of safe ticket transactions worldwide. You’ll join a cross-functional product team alongside frontend, mobile, product, and design colleagues to build scalable features and improve the core marketplace experience. You’ll have ownership, room to experiment, and the opportunity to see your work reach fans almost immediately.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Build and improve backend services and APIs that power our platform

  • Develop new product features used by millions of fans across web and mobile

  • Help scale and maintain a reliable, secure, and high-performing marketplace

  • Work with PHP, Symfony, MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, GraphQL, AWS, and Kubernetes

  • Contribute to our event-driven architecture and asynchronous systems

  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers across disciplines

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code

  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving engineering standards

  • Help improve developer experience, tooling, and platform reliability

  • Contribute ideas that simplify complex technical or product challenges

  • Continuously learn, experiment, and share knowledge with the team

  • Some of the projects we’re currently working on:

  • Expanding support for more ticket file types as the ticketing industry evolves

  • Improving SecureSwap integrations to make events safer and easier to configure for partners

  • Rebuilding and improving event creation flows across the platform

About You

We know great engineers come from different backgrounds and experiences. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t tick every box.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer

  • Strong experience with PHP and relational databases like MySQL

  • Experience with frameworks like Symfony is a strong plus

  • Comfortable working with Git and modern development workflows

  • You care about code quality, testing, and maintainability

  • You enjoy solving real user problems through technology

  • You’re curious, proactive, and open to learning new things

  • You enjoy collaborating in cross-functional teams

  • Experience with React, mobile development, AWS, Kubernetes, or DevOps tooling is a bonus

  • You’re based in the Netherlands, have an EU passport, or already hold a valid visa to work here

  • Please note: we don’t offer relocation support for this role

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Work on products used by millions of fans around the world

  • Join a high-talent, international team that values ownership and collaboration

  • Ship meaningful work fast and see the impact directly

  • Collaborate in an environment where ideas matter more than hierarchy

  • Learn from experienced engineers who care deeply about quality and innovation

  • Help shape the future of live events and ticketing

Practical Details

  • Full-time role

  • Hybrid working setup

  • Based in Amsterdam

  • No relocation package provided

  • This role sits within Function Group 7 or 8, depending on experience and seniority level. We’re open to considering both high mid-level and senior Backend Engineers

Excited to join us?

Research shows that women and people from traditionally underrepresented groups often apply only when they meet every requirement. We’d much rather hear from someone who’s excited about the role and motivated to grow.

At TicketSwap, we welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If this role feels like a good fit for you, we’d love to hear from you

title: Medical Laboratory Technician
description:
Overview

QuarterLine (QL), a Planned Systems International (PSI) company, is seeking dedicated and experienced Medical Laboratory Technician (MLT) candidates to provide high-quality laboratory support at Madigan Army Medical Center (MAMC), Joint Base Lewis-McChord (JBLM), WA. The HCW provides laboratory support by receiving, reviewing, accessioning, processing, and preparing patient specimens for laboratory testing.

The ideal candidate will be dependable, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced military medical environment while maintaining accuracy, professionalism, and patient confidentiality.

This position requires a healthcare professional who can meet all applicable government qualification, credentialing, security, and onboarding requirements while working under a personal services arrangement.

  • Duty Location: Madigan Army Medical Center, Joint Base Lewis McChord, Tacoma, WA 98431. No Telework allowed.
  • Duty Hours: Shifts will be Monday through Sunday to include holidays and weekends
    • Two 10-hour shifts: 1200-2230 and 2200-0830
    • One 8-hour shift: 1200-2030 Tuesday – Saturday
    • One 10-hour shift: 1000- 1830 Saturday
    • One 8-hour shift: 1000 – 1830 Saturday

Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities

  • Receive, inspect, label, accession, and process specimens from Madigan and other DHA laboratories.
  • Enter specimens and laboratory requests into the Laboratory Information System (LIS) and MHS Genesis.
  • Verify specimen integrity, collection timing, labeling, containers, and suitability for testing.
  • Prepare and distribute specimens to the appropriate laboratory sections or for transport/mail-out.
  • Process blood, urine, and other biological fluids in accordance with established procedures.
  • Prepare biological waste for proper disposal.
  • Provide general support to Medical Laboratory Technicians (MLTs) and Clinical Laboratory Scientists (CLSs), including communicating specimen requirements with clinical departments.
  • Perform venipuncture on service members when required during aircraft incidents.
  • Greet patients, determine eligibility and testing priority, and verify laboratory orders.
  • Maintain strict compliance with HIPAA, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), PPE requirements, and Joint Commission standards.
  • Perform all duties in a safe, timely, professional, and quality-focused manner.

Minimum Requirements

  • Experience: A minimum of one (1) year qualifying experience in the past two years as a Medical Laboratory Technician.
  • Legal Authorization to Work in the United States: The contract worker performing under this contract must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Certification(s):
    • Certified Phlebotomy Technician (CPT) certification from a nationally recognized certifying organization.
    • Basic Life Support (BLS) from the American Heart Association or the American Red Cross. Certification cards must display the American Heart Association or the American Red Cross. Web-based (on-line) classes are not acceptable by the Government.
  • Degree/Education: High School Diploma or equivalent; AND Graduate from a medical laboratory technician training program accredited by the National Accrediting Agency for Clinical Laboratory Sciences (NAACLS) or the Accrediting Bureau of Health Education Schools (ABHES) or educational program acceptable to the American Medical Technologist (AMT).
