title: Data Engineer
description:
Ben jij de engineer die ook het product bedenkt, of de product owner die het liefst zelf codeert?

Een dataclub in opbouw. Dus jouw aanpak telt.

We zoeken niet iemand die instapt in een team dat zijn vorm allang heeft gevonden. Ons Data-team bestaat sinds 2025 en groeit hard, met de ambitie om uit te bouwen naar een team van honderd-plus professionals. We zijn nog volop aan het bouwen: hoe zetten we GenAI en agentic AI verder neer, welke opdrachten passen bij ons, en hoe zorgen we dat we van elkaar blijven leren. Daar hebben we jouw ervaring voor nodig.

Je bouwt datapipelines en AI-oplossingen op het Databricks-platform (Lakeflow, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) en in Azure, met een stevige focus op GenAI en agentic AI: van RAG en embeddings tot AI-agents die daadwerkelijk iets doen. Je werkt met een hoge mate van vrijheid en stuurt zelf op een bruikbaar product, met oog voor zowel productvisie als de techniek erachter. Je haalt zelf de requirements op bij de klant, adviseert over wat technisch en zakelijk haalbaar is, en houdt daarbij governance, privacy en compliance (denk AVG, EU AI Act) in het vizier.

En daarnaast bouw je met ons mee

Denk aan het meedenken over onze GenAI-aanpak, het opzetten van een aanpak voor AI-governance binnen het team, of het inspireren van collega's en klanten met nieuwe ideeën en technologieën. Heb je daar zelf ideeën over? Graag zelfs.

  • Vast dienstverband bij Just Good People, ook tussen opdrachten in
  • €2.000 opleidingsbudget per jaar, te besteden aan jouw ontwikkeling
  • De mogelijkheid van een leaseauto (vanaf 32 uur), ook privé te gebruiken
  • Een hecht en snelgroeiend Data-team dat je vanaf dag één erbij betrekt

Wie zoeken we?

  • Ervaring met Databricks (Lakeflow, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) en Azure, met een sterke focus op GenAI en agentic AI (RAG, embeddings, AI-agents)
  • Sterk in Python, PySpark en SQL, en het bouwen van robuuste datapipelines
  • Je combineert productvisie met de techniek: je bouwt niet alleen, je denkt ook mee over wat een klant nodig heeft
  • Verstand van data governance, privacy en compliance (AVG, EU AI Act)

Standplaats Bussum, we zoeken de opdracht dicht bij waar jij woont.

title: System Security Engineer Cyber-Supply Chain Risk Management
description:
Opportunity

PeopleTec is currently seeking a System Security Engineer Cyber-Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM) to support our Huntsville, AL location.

The candidate will serve as a System Security Engineer Cyber-Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM) within a Project Management Office (PMO) within PAE Fires and will be responsible for providing technical support to the program's Chief Engineer and the Technical Chief. The candidate will secure the software supply chain by analyzing third-party code, dependencies, and build processes for vulnerabilities and malicious logic before integration across the system lifecycle (design, development, acquisition, integration, testing, fielding, and sustainment). The candidate will prepare and present C-SCRM findings, reports, and improvement plans to senior management and stakeholders. Will work within a multidisciplinary security and engineering team to achieve program goals. Perform other tasks as assigned by the Chief Engineer and/or Technical Chief.

The candidate will be required to interface with internal PMs across PAE Fires and external organizations to include HQDA, ASA(ALT), JIATF 401, ATEC, AMCOM, and others for coordination and synchronization of C-SCRM technical and programmatic objectives.

Duties:

  • Provide technical support and security engineering in C-SCRM across the system lifecycle (design, development, acquisition, integration, testing, fielding, and sustainment).
  • Mandate and manage Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) for all procured and open-source software.
  • Perform deep-dive vulnerability analysis and code provenance checks on third-party libraries.
  • Establish Software Composition Analysis (SCA) and Static Analysis (SAST) requirements within vendor onboarding.
  • Develop and maintain the Consolidated Program Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), Third-Party Software Vulnerability Reports, and Supplier Secure Software Attestation Forms.
  • Ensure compliance with defense and industry standards by managing C-SCRM processes effectively.
  • Interface with internal teams and external organizations to coordinate C-SCRM objectives and strategies.
  • Prepare and present C-SCRM findings, reports, and improvement plans to senior management and stakeholders.
  • Conduct strategic planning and coordination to support program objectives.
  • Provide technical expertise to support peer engineers within the Technology Security, Program Protection, Cyber Security, and Technical Management teams.
  • Use digital tools and methodologies to analyze supply chain risks, manufacturer/supplier relationships, and foreign ownership and controlling influence.
  • Perform other tasks as assigned by the Chief Engineer and/or Technical Chief.

Qualifications

Required Skills/Experience:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience. Additional education may be substituted for years of experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in C-SCRM, particularly within defense or aerospace industries.
  • Knowledge of SPDX/CycloneDX, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), SAST/DAST, VEX, and FIPS 140-3 validation.
  • Must meet minimum DoDI 8140.03 Defense Cyber Workforce qualification requirements in one of the following work roles: 622 (Secure Software Assessor) at the "Intermediate" level, or 652 (Security Architect) at the "Intermediate" level.
  • Strong knowledge of industry standards and defense requirements.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to lead and work within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Previous experience working in a U.S. Government Program Office (required).
  • Travel: 25%
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen
  • An active DoD Secret clearance is required to perform this work. Candidates are required to have an active Secret clearance upon hire, and the ability to maintain this level of clearance during their employment.

Education Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline

Desired Skills:

  • Top Secret clearance preferred
  • DoDI 8140.03 qualification at the "Advanced" level for work role 622 (Secure Software Assessor) or 652 (Security Architect)

title: Spiritual Health Practitioner
description:
Salary

The salary range for this position is CAD $38.88/Hr. - CAD $55.89/Hr.

Job Accuracy Posting Flag

The hours of work, including start and stop times, days off, work area and work site may be subject to change consistent with operations requirements and applicable provisions of the Collective Agreement and statutes. **Testing may be required. ***A criminal record check may be required

Summary

Reporting to the Director of Spiritual Health and Pastoral Care (SHPC), the Spiritual Health Practitioner works in collaboration with the interdisciplinary teams on assigned clinical units. The Practitioner’s role is to assess spiritual needs and provide comprehensive spiritual care and emotional support to patients, families and health care staff in a manner that is appropriate to belief systems and cultural diversity.Position attends and participates in program based care team meetings and collaborates with spiritual/cultural representatives and clergy in the community. Provides spiritual and emotional support to staff during times of crisis, mentors and supports volunteer visitors who provide ministry to patients/residents and provides support as a preceptor to Clinical Psychospiritual Education students. Supports patients, residents and their families who are considering, or who are engaged in, end of life conversations. Participates in sharing on-call and/or back-up on-call duties, as required, and is available to respond to organizational emergencies.

What You Bring

Education, Training and Experience

  • Master’s degree in Theology, Public and Pastoral Leadership, Spiritual Practices, or other relevant theological/spiritual studies from an accredited institution.
  • Clinical Psychospiritual Education (CPE) with two advanced units.
  • Preferably certified as a spiritual health practitioner with CASC/ACSS.

Skills and Abilities

  • Demonstrated ability to engage counselling theories, interventions, and intentional supportive activities to support patients, residents, and their families, and the ability to quickly identify the appropriate spiritual health practice in order to meet expressed or unexpressed needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage in crisis intervention as required, such as attending Code Blues or other critical incidents.
  • Ability to navigate electronic medical record (Cerner), pagers, and other communication channels.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to support all expressions of spirituality without imposing personal religious beliefs.
  • Demonstrated ability to approach spiritual health issues in a person-centered manner with insight, discernment and flexibility.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively handle stressful situations with sensitivity, compassion, gentleness, caring and approachability.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in accordance with Providence Health Care’s Mission, Vision and Values.
  • Demonstrated ability to work as a member of an interdisciplinary team.
  • Ability to work flexible hours.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize work and activities.
  • Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: $38.88 - $55.89 CAD per hour, depending on experience
  • Comprehensive benefits: Eligible employees receive a robust medical and dental benefits package, including 4 weeks paid vacation starting.
  • Pension plan: Work towards a comfortable retirement through employer-matched contributions to one of Canada's strongest pension plans!
  • Meaningful impact: Your dedication and expertise will directly impact the lives of patients, including many from marginalized communities, helping contribute to the public healthcare system we're privileged to have here in BC.
  • Growth opportunities: We welcome individuals at all stages of their career, offering opportunities for professional development and growth.
  • State-of-the-art facilities: The new St. Paul’s Hospital and health campus will be the most innovative approach to the delivery of integrated care in B.C. and Canada, designed to appropriately address the future health needs of patients, families and our communities. From hospital care to primary and community health solutions, the new St. Paul’s Hospital and health campus will continue to lead innovations in care, research, and teaching. The new St. Paul’s Hospital is expected to open in 2027.
  • Inclusive culture: We respect the diversity, dignity and interdependence of all persons. We value the cultural richness that our diverse workforce brings to the care of our equally diverse population of patients and residents.

Your Day to Day:

  • Assesses, and provides comprehensive spiritual and emotional support through counseling and supportive presence at times of anxiety, loss, death, and other spiritual and existential distress, to inspire strength, courage and hope to patients/residents/families according to their stated beliefs and practices.
  • Promotes the on-going spiritual well-being of patients/residents through listening, prayer and group support such as Memorial Services, spirituality groups, Study of Sacred text and Hymn Sing.
  • Attends and participates in program based care team meetings, rounds, huddles, case conferences, family meetings, ethics consults, and other meetings as required.
  • Receives referrals from all disciplines and responds in a timely manner. Creates and implements follow up plans as required. Makes referrals to other disciplines, when appropriate, based on the needs of patients and residents.
  • Consistently documents in patient/resident medical records where spiritual assessments and significant interventions are recorded to ensure other members of the interdisciplinary care team are properly informed.
  • Collaborates with spiritual/cultural representatives and clergy in the community, when requested by patients and residents and supports religious/spiritual leaders and faith specific volunteer visitors in their ministry.
  • Provides spiritual and emotional support to staff during times of crisis, by active listening, supportive presence for spiritual enrichment, and at times, conducting rituals/memorials/ debriefing when there has been death of a patient/resident/staff member.
  • Maintains daily record of spiritual care activity offered to patients/residents and staff and submits these on a timely basis, as required.
  • Mentors and supports volunteer visitors who provide ministry to patients/residents through religious/spiritual visits and participation in group events.
  • Provides support as a preceptor to Clinical Psychospiritual Education students, including on-site orientation, ongoing support, coaching conversations, and providing feedback to the student and educator.
  • Plans and participates in facility-wide celebrations, such as Worship Services and Memorial Services for individuals or groups.
  • Encourages staff awareness of, and respect for, different expressions of spirituality through in-services and one-on-one conversations. Encourages staff to be aware of the strength that a patient/resident can experience through their beliefs and practices.
  • Is aware of the sensitivities of MAiD requests within Catholic Health and responds within these expectations, to provide support to patients, residents and families.
  • Participates in sharing on-call and/or back-up on-call duties, as required. Available to respond to organizational emergencies (Code Orange, Psychosocial Disaster Response Team, etc.) and act as a liaison during crisis intervention.
  • Participates in Spiritual Health and Pastoral Care team activities, including team meetings, Spiritual Health Awareness Week, retreats and huddles.
  • Provides all spiritual health support in accordance with the expectations of Catholic Healthcare principles and Health Ethics Guidelines. Participates in an organization’s clinical ethics discussions/reviews.
  • Engages in research projects and opportunities both within and outside of the department.
  • Performs other related duties as required.

Who we are:

Providence is a non-profit healthcare provider with over fifteen sites, including a large tertiary hospital in the heart of Vancouver’s beautiful and vibrant Downtown, a smaller community hospital in the idyllic Mount Pleasant neighborhood, one of the largest referral centres for rehabilitation in British Columbia, and five long-term care facilities, as well as other clinics.

As a leading teaching and research organization, and the provincial referral center for Cardiac, HIV/AIDS, and Renal Care, we provide services ranging from acute and long-term care to leading substance use and addiction treatment supporting some of BC’s most marginalized communities. Guided by the motto “how you want to be treated”, delivering exceptional patient and family-centered care is our mission.

Customer Advisor

Part Time - 20 hours per week

3 Month Fixed Term Contract

B&Q weston-super-mare

title: F5 Network Engineer
description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an F5 Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for the implementation, configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of F5 technologies supporting our network infrastructure. You will work closely with network and infrastructure teams to ensure reliable and secure application delivery across the Customer’s Data Centers and MAN/WAN sites. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented engineer with strong troubleshooting skills, the ability to manage multiple priorities, and a commitment to maintaining the performance, availability, and security of the network environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Deploy, license, and configure F5 BIG-IP LTM hardware.

  • Maintain Virtual servers,Pools,Nodes,Custom monitors and Persistence profiles

  • Manage SSL offloading, SSL bridging, and secure cipher suite configurations.

  • Author, optimize, and troubleshoot custom iRules (TCL-based) to handle:

    • Advanced traffic steering

    • URI redirects

    • Header manipulation

    • Specialized security workarounds

  • Manage the lifecycle of SSL/TLS certificates, including:

    • CSR generation

    • Certificate deployment

    • Automated renewal cycles on BIG-IP devices

  • Perform deep-packet and L3-L7 diagnostics for:

    • Complex application delivery issues

    • High latency

    • Routing issues

    • SSL handshake failures

  • Utilize advanced tools such as:

    • Wireshark

    • tcpdump

    • F5 iQuery

    • F5 Analytics

  • Execute TMOS operating system upgrades, hotfixes, and backup restorations using UCS/SCF configuration archives.

  • Design and test failover mechanics in High Availability (HA) topologies, including:

    • Device Service Clustering (DSC)

    • Active/Standby setups

  • Utilize F5 iControl REST APIs for programmatic control and monitoring.

  • Recommend enhancements to improve systems availability and performance.

  • Offer recommendations for procedural upgrades.

  • Provide network administration and support for a campus-wide area network infrastructure.

  • Maintain experience with:

    • TCP/IP protocol suite

    • IP subnets and masking

    • Routing protocols

  • Work in Local Area Network (LAN) and Wide Area Network (WAN) environments.

  • Design, configure, and troubleshoot Routing and Switching systems.

    • Cisco expertise required.

  • Maintain security and ensure compliance with security policies and procedures.

  • Provide on-call support for off-hours data center escalations.

  • Perform regular scheduled out-of-hours maintenance window support.

  • Maintain and manage network IP address management (IPAM)

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 5 years with a Bachelor’s degree or 9 years with a HS Diploma
  • 5 years of hands-on experience in the implementation and administration of complex, multi-location, multi-vendor, converged voice/data networks in a geographically distributed environment
  • Must have in-depth hands-on experience on F5 Load Balancers in real world complex environments
  • Hands-on experience in administering Cisco routers & switches including but not limited to Nexus 9xxx, Catalyst 9000, Cisco ONS, Cisco ACI and DNA Center. Juniper MX routers and EX switches. Infoblox DDI appliances
  • Good understanding of network principles and the OSI model
  • Experience managing networks, internal and external DNS, and the associated IP infrastructure
  • Experience working in a Data Center
  • Experience administering and configuring monitoring tools for proactive alerting and trends analysis
  • Experience in working with support ticketing systems, managing assigned tickets, as well as providing appropriate follow-up
  • Experience with creating and maintaining documentation
  • Experience with the use of Data Center inventory management tools
  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required agency clearance

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

title: Program Manager
description:
Overview

We're Hiring: Program Manager

Location: Swedesboro, NJEmployment Type: OnsiteDepartment: Adult Day Program

Are you looking to build a career as a caregiver? Do you want to make a difference in the lives of autistic, intellectually, and developmentally challenged individuals? If yes, working at Bancroft may be right for you. As a Program Manager within our Gloucester Day Program in Swedesboro, NJ you’ll empower the people we serve while supporting the Bancroft mission, vision and core values.

Bring Out the Best in You and Those We Serve

Bancroft’s Lakeside Campus for people with autism, intellectual and developmental disabilities fosters a stable environment where each individual can realize their best life. Direct Support Professionals help those in our care to reach their highest potential, while gaining experience and learning new skills.

The current hiring range for this position is: $31.46-$32.10 per hour. Plus additional incentives.

Bancroft is a leading service-provider for children and adults with autism, other intellectual or developmental disabilities or those in need of neurological rehabilitation.

We are looking for Direct Support Professionals that are passionate about providing quality care in a positive and empathetic manner. Our Direct Support Professionals must have a strong desire to work with autistic, intellectually and/or developmentally disabled individuals.

Position Summary:

Manages the overall operations, activities, and staff of assigned program site within direct area of responsibility.

Responsibilities

Essential Responsibilities:

1. Provides supervision and oversight to direct reports within direct areas of responsibility:

o Provides ongoing leadership, advice, training, and guidance to direct reports regarding the daily care, instruction, and safety of persons served at specific program site as outlined in the Individual Program Plan (IPP), Annex A and/or program descriptions;

o Ensures proper staffing levels and work distribution within assigned program site in accordance with levels of supervision, Annex A, and/or program descriptions;

o Conducts regular staff meetings and attends program management meetings to promote a constant flow of information, open discussions, knowledge sharing, and to keep staff well-informed;

o Attends various internal management meetings, external conferences, Interdisciplinary (IDT) and/or Trans-Disciplinary (TDT) meetings, family conferences, etc., to both obtain and share information;

o Manages the ongoing job performance of direct reports; develops and communicates performance goals, completes performance evaluations within established timeframes; provides feedback, develops and takes action on performance improvement plans, and determines and implements disciplinary action as needed;

o Appropriately delegates work responsibilities;

o Supports the professional development and career growth of direct reports by identifying and providing ongoing training and certification attainment in accordance with state licensing regulations and any accreditation standards, as applicable within area of responsibility.

2. Manages the overall operations, activities, and overall environment of the program site within direct areas of responsibility and for all shifts, if applicable:

o Follows established Bancroft policies and procedures, and maintains compliance with Division of Developmental Disabilities (DDD) regulations, Health Insurance Portability & Accountability Act (HIPAA) regulations, DDD Supported Employment/Day Program (SE/DP) Manual standards (if applicable), Department of Labor (DOL) regulations (if applicable), Department of Human Services (DHS) 1047 regulations (if applicable), Commission on Accreditation of Rehabilitation Facilities (CARF) standards, and applicable state/local/federal regulations at all times;

o Ensures adherence to all established policies and procedures within the Operations manual and Bancroft’s Policies and Procedures manual;

o Within area of responsibility, complies with state regulations and accreditation standards and Bancroft’s quality standards for safety, security, cleanliness, and comfort;

o When applicable, provides on-call and rotational support to effectively manage a 24 hour/7 day a week program for persons served;

o When applicable, ensures the 24 hour/7day a week management and oversight of program site, staff, and persons served by maintaining a flexible work schedule and by personally providing coverage for all shifts, as needed;

o Dependent upon specific program, may conduct treatment integrity checks for program staff to ensure the provision of quality care for persons served;

o Monitors all direct costs incurred and efficiency of spending for program site and persons served within area of responsibility. Contributes in ensuring that program site operates within the established fiscal budget and may provide input to management for annual budget preparation for program site;

o Assists in and/or develops work schedules in an effort to reduce unnecessary costs and unanticipated variances to established budget.

3. Working in conjunction with program management and the Human Resources Department, actively participates in the applicant hiring and termination process. Interviews and screens applicants to identify qualified candidates, appropriately explains job content and performance expectations to applicants, and provides hiring and termination recommendations.

4. Aids in the resolution of problematic, more sensitive, or more complicated situations while actively encouraging the independence of the person served within his/her abilities. Exercises appropriate judgment in addressing specific situations. Responds with immediate, effective solutions and/or promptly notifies program management.

5. Completes daily, monthly, and quarterly paperwork; e.g., monthly summaries, risk management reports, Outcome Measurement Systems (OMS) reports, inspection checklists, attendance and billing records (where applicable) etc., for submission to program management and to ensure compliance with all applicable regulations and accreditation standards.

6. Reviews required paperwork completed by direct reports for accuracy and submits to program management in accordance with established timeframes. Ensures the maintenance of all documentation as required by state regulations and as determined by program management and/or Nursing Department for the assigned site; e.g., daily logs, monthly progress reports, daily goal reports, assessments, daily financial transactions, Medical Administration Records, behavioral data sheets, internal reports, etc., as applicable within specific program site.

7. Within area of responsibility (and working with Nursing Department, where applicable), ensures the overall integrity of behavior and/or medical records and files for persons served; i.e., files are complete, accurate, and up-to-date, for timely review by internal and external auditors, insurance companies, etc.

8. Develops, coordinates, and monitors the IPP, IDT and/or TDT process. Ensures the timely implementation of appropriate treatment plans for each person served within specific program site.

9. If applicable, evaluates prospective persons served at screening meetings and recommends appropriate staffing levels to ensure a maximum level of individual care.

10. Within area of responsibility, reviews consults from medical and therapeutic consultants for persons served, ensures implementation of care plan and adherence to medical orders, etc.

11. Actively participates in special projects related to behavioral treatment, clinical outcome, and research activities, as necessary or as required.

12. Actively participates in the development and implementation of performance improvement systems for assigned program site to ensure an overall efficient and cost-effective operation.

13. Maintains effective communications with persons served, parents, guardians, other family members, healthcare personnel, own manager and coworkers across programs and functions, neighbors, surrounding communities, etc. Operates in accordance with the Confirmation of Understanding or Plan of Care for each person served regarding programs and treatment, healthcare, religious and sexual preferences (if applicable), ethnic and cultural support, recreational and socialization activities, physical fitness and healthy living, family visits and involvement, and disagreements and grievances.

14. Serves as an advocate on behalf of persons served in a variety of situations.

15. Monitors the usage of transportation vehicles assigned to specific program site. Ensures the ongoing routine maintenance and cleanliness of assigned vehicles through the daily completion and review of logs.

16. Follows state-approved emergency procedures and Bancroft-approved crisis intervention techniques for each person served at specific Program site.

17. Serves as a role model to persons served by projecting a positive self-image of professionalism, appearance, courtesy, conduct, honesty, fairness, confidentiality, personal integrity, and a respect for the fundamental rights, dignity, and privacy of others.

18. Provides direct care to persons served at specific program site, as necessary.

19. Performs other related management duties as assigned or as necessary. Remains flexible and adaptable in work schedules and work assignments as defined by program needs.

20. Abides by the Bancroft Code of Ethics, Mission Statement, and Vision Statement in promoting ethical behavior, establishing relationships and providing guidance in decision-making situations.

21. Remains current with required training certifications, meets state-regulated licensing and regulatory accreditations, and adheres to mandatory requirements.

22. Maintains effective verbal and written communications with colleagues, those served, and their family members and/or guardians when applicable.

23. Willingly and effectively cooperates with Bancroft, The Department of Human Services, The Division of Developmental Disabilities (DDD), and other licensing or state agency or local municipalities in any inspections and investigations, upon request.

24. Maintains a safe and respectful environment, free of abuse, neglect, or exploitation; does not allow weapons, threats, bullying or intimidation.

25. Reports any violations to the appropriate individual as soon as the incident occurs.

26. Maintains levels of supervision as defined in behavior plans; e.g., Individual Program Plan (IPP), Individual Rehabilitation Plan (IRP), Individual Education Plan (IEP), Individual Service Plan (ISP), etc., when applicable.

27. Demonstrates Bancroft’s core values of RESPECT in the performance of position responsibilities.

Qualifications

Education & Experience:

An incumbent in this position who has graduated from an accredited college with a BA in Occupational Therapy, Physical Therapy, Speech/Language Pathology, Social Work, Recreation, Art, Dance, Music, Physical Education, Nutrition, Sociology, Special Education, Rehabilitation Counseling, or Psychology AND possesses at least one year of experience working with individuals with developmental disabilities or brain injuries.

High School diploma or equivalent required with two-three years in the Human Services or related field. Prior management experience and a strong desire to work with neurologically-challenged individuals. BA in a related field plus one year of related experience preferred.

EEO Statement

Bancroft stands strong against racism and hate of all kinds and supports actions leading to respect, equality, fairness and peace. We advocate for and embrace an inclusive and just world. One world. For everyone. We work with heart, respect and collaboration. We are communicators, listeners, problem solvers, partners and collaborators. Bring your authentic self to our team.

Bancroft is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and supports diversity, equity and inclusion in its hiring and employment practices, so that every team member can feel a true sense of belonging, and maximize their unique potential. To this end, all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Junior Systems Engineer
description:

Barrios Technology is an engineering solutions partner with more than 45 years of experience supporting NASA and the commercial space industry. We deliver innovative engineering, software, and technology integration services nationwide. Barrios fosters a people-focused culture that values creativity, diversity, professional growth, and a healthy work–life balance.

Our team is positioned to contribute to the future of space exploration, with opportunities to support a variety of commercial space programs involving NASA, Intuitive Machines, Axiom Space, Lockheed Martin, and others.

Responsibilities

The Junior Systems Engineer will:

  • Apply engineering principles and techniques to requirements validation, product development, product integration, requirements verification, system validation, and hardware/software product deployment
  • Perform concept trade studies, requirements management, test & verification, and modeling an analysis as required
  • Create and/or evaluate designs to ensure they meet customer satisfaction and engineering principles
  • Establish and lead working relationships with customer counterparts, requirement owners, and commercial teammates' key personnel to promote mission success
  • Support engineering activities such as requirements identification, development, verification, and tracking
  • Develop processes and strategies to support cross-functional teams supporting spacecraft engineering or operations
  • Provide technical systems knowledge during major project milestones and project reviews
  • Perform all other assigned duties

This includes both field-focused technical assessments and the development of supporting engineering and programmatic documentation. The ideal candidate has experience with research, development, test, and evaluation (RDT&E), and can bridge the gap between emerging capability and mission utility.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Define requirements for the systems and products required by users and other stakeholders, including communications, sensor and surveillance technologies. This includes documenting the user and stakeholder requirements for the desired systems or products and iteratively reviewing and refining the requirements as additional details are known. This also includes transforming the user requirements into technical requirements in the context of planned customer use, environments, and identified system characteristics.

    Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Establishing project requirements baselines and further analyzing requirements to identify deficiencies and cost drivers.
  • Decomposing high-level functions identified through requirements analysis into lower-level functions and employ tools such as functional block diagrams, functional flow diagrams, time lines, and control/data flow diagrams to document the requirements.

  • Documenting analysis outcomes in a Functional Requirements Document, Constraint Evaluation Analysis Report, Cost Benefits Report, or Trade Studies Report.

  • 5+ years of experience in applied engineering, technology evaluation, or systems development
  • Familiarity with DHS or DOD acquisition processes, including SELC and test planning
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and technical writing skills

  • U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain a CBP Background Investigation (BI) is required; active CBP BI preferred.

With 5+ years of hands‑on claims experience, you will lead thorough investigations, guide claim strategy, and ensure fair, timely resolutions. Patient Care:• Preparing and positioning patients for procedures.• Assists physician with instrumentation during procedures including the collection of specimens, cultures, and biopsies.• Ability to handle pressure and think quickly to address the needs of the patient and nursing unit. • Assists with off shift GI cases being on-call as needed. Assists in emergency procedures in an inpatient setting• Assists with advanced procedures such as ERCPs.• The endo tech will be able to assist with greeting patient and driver. They will instruct the driver on the process and take the patient to the admit room, so they can dress for the procedure.• The endo tech, under the direct supervision of the RN, will assist with patient discharge. Identifies functional problems with equipment, performs basic troubleshooting of equipment, requests equipment repairs and maintains repair records.

High School Diploma or equivalent

Experience:

Patient care in hospital setting, basic ECG. Knowledge of basic medical terminology and strong communication skills.

CPR upon hire

Preferred

Prior endoscopy or gastrointestinal disorders knowledge.

CNA,MA,EMT, Surgical Technician, or Endoscopic Technician Certificate.

title: Senior Java Backend Engineer — AI‑Driven Microservices (Hybrid WFH)
description:
Vacature: Senior JavaBackend Engineer Utrecht

  • Wil je het engineeringsniveaunaar het volgende niveau helpen tillen, binnen een tech-organisatie intransitie, waar jou software duizenden processen per dag foutlooslaat draaien?
  • Lijkt het je gaaf om in een domein te werken waar betrouwbaarheid,schaalbaarheid en fouttolerantie letterlijk cruciaal zijn?
  • Wil je je tanden zetten in non-triviale backendvraagstukken als schaalbaarheid,event-driven architecturen, data consistency en AI-integratie?
  • En zeg jij ja tegen een salaris tot €90.000, een premievrij pensioen,jaarlijks werken in het buitenland en 3 dagen thuiswerken?

Lees dan verder!

Jouw werkgever:Middelgroot techbedrijf in transitie naar next-gen platform met ernorme impactin Nederland

Dit middelgrotetechbedrijf uit Utrecht ontwikkelt een multi-tenant platform datfungeert als ruggengraat voor essentiële processen die miljoenenNederlanders raken. Denk aan enorme datastromen, striktebetrouwbaarheidseisen en 24/7 beschikbaarheid. Hier krijg je dus echtvoldoening uit je werk, wetende dat de software die jij schrijft zo’n impactkan hebben.

Het nieuwe platform staater: volledig van scratch gebouwd, modern opgezet en zonder legacy. Debasis is live, de eerste klanten draaien, en nu begint het echte werk: opschalen,doorontwikkelen en performance optimaliseren. Dit is jouw kans om aan een funderingte bouwen die de komende decennia meegaat. Hier kun je mega veel impacthebben!

Het technische managementis in handen van mensen met een achtergrond bij een van de meest prestigieuzeengineering consultancyclubs van Nederland. Je werkt dus niet alleen met capableengineers, maar met mensen die best practices, DevOps-denken en cleancoding vanzelfsprekend vinden. Hier werk je dus met de beste technischemensen, waar de best practices van moderne software engineering anno2025 de standaard zijn. Hierdoor kun je ongelofelijk productief zijnen continu jouw toegevoegde waarde aanscherpen!

Jouw rol: Senior JavaBackend Engineer Utrecht

Je valt direct met jouwneus in de boter, binnen een van de agile development teams, met een devopsmentaliteit. Samen kunnen jullie ongelofelijk veel impact maken waar deorganisatie decennia op voortbouwt.

In deze rol werk je met Java21,Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, Docker en AWS-services aan schaalbare microservicesen event-driven systemen die enorme hoeveelheden events verwerken. Je denktactief mee over domeinmodellering, API-design en data consistency binnendistributed systems.

De komende jaren staanvolledig in het teken van opschalen, performance verbeteren en nieuwefeatures bouwen. AI speelt daarin een grote rol. Enerzijds gebruikje AI-tools om je werk slimmer te maken: unit tests genereren, edgecases opsporen, code reviews versnellen of snel prototypes neerzetten.Anderzijds help je AI integreren in het platform zelf, bijvoorbeeld vooranomaly detection, optimalisatie van datastromen of slimme automatisering voorklanten. Zo maak je impact met AI op twee fronten: je eigen productiviteitén de toekomst van het platform.

Als Senior Java BackendEngineer vergroot je hier ook je circle-of-influence. Je helpt standaardendefiniëren, zorgt dat clean code en testautomatisering de norm zijn,en tilt collega’s naar een hoger niveau met jouw ervaring. Zo maak jeniet alleen impact op de codebase, maar ook op het team en de toekomst van hetplatform.

Groeimogelijkheden:

Gezien de organisatie intransitie is, en er continue investeringen zijn, zou je hier op termijn kunnendoorgroeien naar tech lead.

Wat wordt gevraagd

  • Minimaal 5 jaarervaring met Java backend development
  • Ervaring met Java11+(bij voorkeur Java17 of 21) en Spring Boot
  • Kennis van cloudomgevingen(AWS is een pre) en containerization (Docker)
  • Begrip architectuurdesign is een grote pre (microservices, event-driven etc.)
  • Ervaring met CI/CDen testautomatisering is voor jou vanzelfsprekend
  • Interesse in AI-toepassingenis een sterke plus
  • Ervaring in mentorship of coaching van anderecollega’s

Wat wordt geboden

  • Salaris tussen de€80.000 en €90.000 afhankelijk vanervaring en impact
  • Premievrijpensioen (100% bijdrage werkgever)
  • 3 dagen per week thuiswerken + flexibele werktijden

  • MacBook ofLenovo naar keuze
  • Opleidingsbudget+ conferentiebezoek

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Voor één van onze opdrachtgevers in de energiesector in Nederland is We ARE Renewables op zoek naar een Senior Data Engineer.

Als Data Engineer bij de klant werk je aan een modern dataplatform en vertaal je complexe datastromen naar betrouwbare, schaalbare oplossingen. Je bouwt mee aan dataproducten die direct bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, een toekomstbestendig energienetwerk en de verdere professionalisering van de dataorganisatie van de klant. In deze rol pak je niet alleen technische vraagstukken aan, maar begeleid je het team ook op het gebied van kwaliteit, standaardisatie en doorontwikkeling.

  • Je werkt met moderne Azure-technologie, zoals Databricks en uiteindelijk Microsoft Fabric.
  • Je krijgt alle ruimte om te leren, te innoveren en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.
  • Je hebt directe impact op de betrouwbaarheid en toekomstbestendigheid van het energienet.
  • Je krijgt als senior de ruimte om inhoudelijk leiding te geven, collega’s te begeleiden en de techniekpraktijk verder te versterken.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Data Engineer bouw jij aan een modern Azure dataplatform dat cruciaal is voor de energietransitie. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert schaalbare datapipelines en dataproducten op Databricks. Daarnaast neem je een leidende rol in de verdere professionalisering van het team.

In deze rol werk je end-to-end aan dataproducten: van het ontsluiten van databronnen en datamodellering tot het beschikbaar stellen van data voor rapporten en dashboards. Je weet de bedrijfsinformatiebehoefte te vertalen naar robuuste en toekomstbestendige oplossingen en levert aantoonbare waarde met dataproducten die dagelijks binnen de klantorganisatie worden gebruikt.

Naast je technische taken speel je een belangrijke rol in de ontwikkeling van collega’s. Je coacht data engineers, helpt junior collega’s groeien in hun expertise en draagt actief bij aan kennisdeling binnen het team. Je ontwikkelt documentatie, standaarden en werkmethoden die ervoor zorgen dat oplossingen overdraagbaar en beheersbaar blijven. Daarbij fungeer je als inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor architecten, analisten, Product Owners en BI-specialisten.

Je bent de natuurlijke drijvende kracht achter complexe technische uitdagingen en neemt waar nodig de rol van tech lead op, waarbij je richting geeft zonder de samenwerking uit het oog te verliezen. Dit sluit aan bij de opdracht waarbij coaching, technische oplossingen, dataproducten, documentatie en het tijdelijk vervullen van een tech lead rol centraal staan.

Je komt te werken in het Staven Data Delivery Team. Het team werkt vanuit de vestigingen in Utrecht en de Coolse Poort in Rotterdam. Samen ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en beheren van dataproducten die organisatiebreed worden ingezet.

Je werkt nauw samen met het BI Team Finance. Hierdoor blijft u dicht bij de gebruikers van uw producten en ziet u direct welke impact uw werk heeft op de dagelijkse besluitvorming binnen de organisatie.

Vakmanschap staat centraal in het team. Je helpt elkaar groeien, deelt actief kennis en investeert volop in coaching en ontwikkeling. Tegelijkertijd geniet je van een gezonde dosis competitie. Het Data Delivery Team staat bekend om de heftige pingpongwedstrijden tijdens BRP’s, waarbij net zoveel passie getoond wordt als bij het bouwen van dataproducten.

Belangrijkste vereisten

  • Hoger professioneel of universitair werk- en denkniveau.
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Data Engineer of in een vergelijkbare rol.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met Databricks, SQL, Python en moderne Azure-dataplatforms.
  • Ervaring met datamodellering, inclusief Data Vault en dimensionale modellering.
  • Ervaring met het gehele ontwikkelproces van databronextractie, modellering en het beschikbaar maken van data voor dashboards en rapporten.
  • Ervaring met dashboarding en samenwerken met BI-teams.
  • Ervaring met CI/CD, Git en software-engineeringprincipes.
  • Ervaring binnen Agile-, Scrum- en SAFe-omgevingen.
  • Ervaring binnen grote en complexe organisaties.
  • Ervaar coaching, mentoring en onboarding van junior data-ingenieurs.

title: Digital & Innovation Project Coordinator
description:
Around the world, SYSTRA’s specialists plan, design, integrate, test, commission, project manage and deliver mass transit and mobility solutions that are relied on by more than 50 million people every day.

For more than 60 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their transport infrastructure with sustainability, accessibility and innovation at the heart of our designs. With over 10,300 colleagues globally and around 1000 in the UK & Ireland we are growing significantly and seeking out the very best talent to join the SYSTRA signature team and be part of leading the way in infrastructure design.

Context

The Digital and Innovation Project Coordinator will be the main liaison between the Head of Innovation, internal and external stakeholders and development teams. The candidate needs to be confident dealing with a wide variety of stakeholders and able to adapt their communication, coordination, and leadership style to each situation.

Experience of facilitating workshops and meetings is a pre-requisite for this role, combined with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

The post-holder will have the personal and professional skills to build and maintain meaningful and supportive relationships across teams in order to support successful project delivery. They will be comfortable working in a role that combines project oversight, delivery support, governance, coordination, and direct management of selected projects.

Missions/Main Duties

Definition

Clearly and thoroughly identify the scope of project(s) and innovation activity by:

  • Working collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders, at all levels within the organisation, to define and achieve mutual understanding of project scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, and success measures.
  • Supporting the Head of Innovation and project leads in shaping ideas, project briefs, and delivery approaches into clear and practical scopes.
  • Listening for, uncovering, and resolving misunderstandings or disagreements about scope, responsibilities, timescales, priorities, or delivery expectations.
  • Ensuring all relevant stakeholders and resources understand the scope, intended outcomes, and any constraints or assumptions.
  • Helping to ensure that innovation activity is translated into deliverable and appropriately governed project activity.

Planning

Work with the team to identify and schedule all the work required to fulfil the scope:

  • Understand what constitutes an end-to-end, proportionate, cross-functional delivery plan and involve stakeholders as appropriate to create a valid and achievable plan.
  • Support the planning of project(s) in sufficient detail to ensure integration of activities, dependencies, governance requirements, stage gates, milestones, and key decision points.
  • Be able to identify delivery risks and discuss the likely impacts to scope, quality, budget, or timing where accelerated timescales or constrained resources are proposed.
  • Obtain approval of plans through effective communication, ensuring understanding of the implications for resources, budgets, deliverables, and delivery dates.
  • Support the preparation and maintenance of realistic budgets, forecasts, and project resource assumptions where applicable.
  • Ensure that non-people resources such as systems, digital tools, equipment, access requirements, or other delivery needs are identified so that plans are realistic and affordable.
  • Support the planning and readiness of Digital Products through relevant Group IT Stage Gate Processes.

Resourcing

Identify resourcing needs in line with the project plan:

  • Ensure all necessary cross-functional resources are identified and that resource requirements are understood across business, operational, digital, technical, and support teams.
  • Support the identification of resource constraints, competing priorities, and dependencies, ensuring these are highlighted and escalated where required.
  • Communicate to ensure that all resources understand their roles, responsibilities, deliverables, and expected timescales, and escalate where commitment or clarity is lacking.
  • Support and coordinate project teams to achieve the desired results, often using matrix management and collaborative working across functions.
  • Ensure effective liaison with third-party suppliers, delivery partners, and internal stakeholders involved in project activity.
  • Work with the Head of Innovation and other leads to ensure innovation projects are appropriately supported and resourced in line with delivery needs.

Execution and Control

Day-to-day management and support of project delivery:

  • Support responsibility for project time, cost, quality, governance, and reporting activities, in line with business processes, internal procedures, and applicable delivery controls.
  • Directly manage selected digital, innovation, process improvement, or business change projects, particularly those of low to medium complexity.
  • Produce reports in line with internal governance and project requirements, ensuring accurate and timely updates on status, progress, risks, issues, and decisions.
  • Ensure application of effective risk, issue, dependency, and change management across project(s), instigating mitigation actions and escalating matters where required.
  • Ensure effective communication with project teams, internal and external stakeholders, partners, suppliers, and customers as appropriate.
  • Monitor proposed changes to project parameters, such as scope, budget, schedule, governance, or resource assumptions, and ensure these are reviewed and managed appropriately.
  • Monitor the quality of project deliverables and ensure project objectives and agreed outcomes are being met.
  • Conduct project meetings, workshops, checkpoint reviews, and attend programme or governance meetings where required.
  • Establish effective working relationships with key stakeholders, gatekeepers, sponsors, project leads, and delivery teams.
  • Solve problems creatively, while also working analytically and in a structured way to overcome issues.
  • Support the development of practical project delivery guidance, templates, and processes for innovation activity where existing guidance is limited or evolving.
  • Provide support, motivation, and practical guidance to colleagues involved in project delivery.
  • Ensure that projects comply with internal governance, organisational policy, information management, data protection, and any relevant statutory or regulatory requirements applicable to the project.
  • Support budget monitoring, forecasting, and financial tracking for allocated projects, ensuring concerns are identified early and raised appropriately.
  • Maintain oversight of Digital Products progressing through Group IT Stage Gate Processes, ensuring appropriate documentation, approvals, actions, and readiness are in place at each stage.
  • Escalate issues, delays, governance gaps, or risks to the Head of Innovation and other senior stakeholders in a timely and clear manner.

Profile/Skills

Knowledge and Skills

  • Proven experience of supporting or delivering projects to time, cost, and quality, ideally within digital, innovation, business change, process improvement, or transformation environments.
  • Experience of working in a project support, project coordination, project management, or delivery role with responsibility for monitoring plans, actions, risks, issues, and reporting.
  • Experience of supporting governance processes and applying structured project controls in a practical and proportionate way.
  • Experience of identifying delivery issues and risks and taking appropriate action, including timely escalation where required.
  • Takes responsibility for promoting self-development, maintaining CPD, and undertaking identified training and learning to maintain current proficiency and awareness of emerging technologies, methods, and best practice.
  • Flexible, with the ability to adapt to shifting priorities, demands, and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Successful experience of translating analysis, ideas, or emerging requirements into practical implementation and delivery activity.
  • Facilitation and workshop experience.
  • Experience of different project delivery approaches, for example agile, waterfall, or hybrid methods.
  • Understanding of project governance, reporting, assurance, and stage gate processes.
  • Experience of supporting digital products, digital delivery, technology-enabled change, or innovation-related activity would be desirable.
  • Well-developed planning and organisational skills, including scope, scheduling, action tracking, and milestone management.
  • Risk and issue management experience.
  • Budget monitoring and cost control support experience.
  • Experience of coordinating resources and stakeholders, including within matrix-managed environments.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Effective influencing and negotiation skills.
  • High level of IT literacy, with proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, SharePoint, MS Project, and other project or collaboration tools as required.
  • Experience with Agile Project Management

Behaviour / Competency

  • Analytical thinking: ability to tackle issues and problems in a logical, structured, and step-by-step way.
  • Concern for accuracy: desire to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality in work delivered.
  • Results orientation: ability to maintain focus on delivery, deadlines, and practical outcomes while supporting others to achieve agreed objectives.
  • Communication skills: ability to communicate clear, concise, and accurate information in written and verbal formats to a range of audiences.
  • Creativity and innovation: willingness to challenge assumptions and support the development of practical, effective, and innovative solutions.
  • Influence and persuasion: ability to work constructively with others to gain support, alignment, and commitment.
  • Interpersonal skills: ability to understand and respond appropriately to other people’s perspectives, concerns, and priorities.
  • Relationship building: ability to build and maintain effective working relationships and networks across the organisation and with external stakeholders where required.
  • Planning and coordination: ability to organise activity effectively, maintain oversight of multiple priorities, and ensure actions are progressed.
  • Judgement and escalation: ability to recognise when issues need to be resolved directly and when they need to be escalated appropriately.

Safety

SYSTRA Ltd and its employees subscribe to the six key Industry Safety Rules.

  • Commitment (Safety is the first consideration in everything we do, if it isn't safe, we don't do it).
  • Leadership (Safety begins at the top - we walk the talk and set a visible example).
  • Openness (Safety is openness - information is shared and investigation conclusions are open to all parties).
  • Reporting (Safety is knowledge - we report every incident and take immediate remedial action).
  • Responsibility (Safety is everyone's responsibility - we learn from mistakes and will not tolerate negligence).
  • Measurement (Safety needs a common measure - we shall use lost time, accidents and other appropriate measures).

Working environment

SYSTRA provides a range of flexible working options, including hybrid working, balancing the benefits of working from home with time in our modern, well-equipped offices. A minimum of 3* days each week should be spent in a SYSTRA office or client site (pro-rated for part time colleagues). For further details please read the Professional Standards policy. *This maybe varied, dependent upon client and project requirements if required. Employing a diverse range of people,

SYSTRA is committed to providing a truly inclusive work environment and has a programme of activities to support the wellbeing of all colleagues. Opportunities to be involved with these programmes are available to all.

Workplace Type

Hybrid

title: Permanent Installation Sales Engineer
description:
Overview

Permanent Installation Sales Engineer

Remote | Commercial Building Access & Façade Access Systems

About the Role

Sky Climber is looking for a growth-minded Permanent Installation Sales Engineer to help expand our Permanent Installation business across assigned territories. This is a technical, consultative sales role for someone who can understand customer challenges, evaluate building access applications, and position Sky Climber’s engineered façade access solutions as the smarter, safer, and higher-value choice.

The ideal candidate brings a strong technical foundation, commercial curiosity, and the drive to win by creating better solutions—not simply by competing on price. You will work with contractors, architects, engineers, consultants, property managers, and building owners to understand project requirements, compare options, explain tradeoffs, and deliver proposals that clearly communicate Sky Climber’s value versus competitive alternatives.

This role reports directly to the Permanent Installation Business Unit Manager.

This is a strong opportunity for a motivated technical sales professional who wants to grow with a specialized business, influence project outcomes, and become a trusted resource in the commercial building access market.

What You’ll Do

  • Act as a trusted technical sales advisor for Sky Climber’s permanent installation product portfolio, including powered platforms, monorails, davit systems, rooftop anchorages, and related access equipment
  • Build consultative relationships with new and existing customers by understanding project needs, site conditions, safety requirements, budget priorities, and long-term ownership expectations
  • Prospect and pursue opportunities in both new construction and existing building retrofit markets
  • Review drawings, specifications, contract documents, and customer requirements to identify compliant, practical, and differentiated façade access and window washing system solutions
  • Partner with Engineering, Project Management, Customer Support, Operations, and Sales leadership to develop technical solutions that balance safety, compliance, performance, cost, manufacturability, and customer value
  • Develop clear, professional proposals and value-based comparisons that help customers understand why Sky Climber’s solution is the best fit for their project
  • Lead technical and commercial scope clarification, including specification review, alternates, exclusions, pricing assumptions, and solution tradeoffs to support successful project execution
  • Conduct product presentations, technical demonstrations, and customer training that translate product features into customer benefits, risk reduction, lifecycle value, and improved project outcomes
  • Support installation and inspection activities when necessary
  • Manage bid qualification paperwork and project documentation requirements
  • Follow up on contracts, purchase orders, project approvals, and customer communications
  • Represent Sky Climber at industry events, trade associations, customer meetings, and networking functions
  • Support implementation of company marketing and sales initiatives
  • Prepare for and participate in regular sales meetings and business reviews
  • Maintain accurate sales activity reporting and pipeline management
  • Use structured problem-solving to address technical questions, objections, competitive threats, and customer concerns throughout the sales process
  • Increase win rate by offering better engineered solutions, responsive technical support, disciplined follow-up, and differentiated product offerings versus competition

title: Caster
description:
Overview

Wieland - Creating Value for Generations!

Wieland is a global leader in copper and copper alloy manufacturing, processing, and distribution. We provide a large product and service portfolio including power, automotive, ammunition, coinage, construction materials, refrigeration, electronics and many other industries. To us, metal is more than material.

Wieland's Cultural Values

Wieland’s culture is what makes for a fun and rewarding place to work! As a company, we benefit daily from our employees' knowledge and abilities. With our cultural vision, we place our core values at the heart of everything we do: safety, ambition, optimism, reliability, ownership, diversity, & respect.

Wieland is hiring a Caster. The Caster is responsible for the mixing, melting, skimming, and pouring of metal within all specified temperature, alloy, and other quality standards. This role works as part of a team with other Casters to perform work safely and efficiently. Casters will also perform maintenance as required and administrative duties as assigned.

This role is located in East Alton, IL and will be fully on-site.

Starting Pay: $37.00/hour

Schedule: Afternoons, Midnights

Pay Schedule: Bi-weekly

Responsibilities

Caster Responsibilities:

  • Work in alignment with Wieland’s core values and abide by the 8 Golden Rules of Safety.
  • Remove dross, slag, or impurities from the molten metal using a ladle or spoon.
  • Make necessary additions to the molten metal in the furnace to ensure the chemistry follows the company’s standard as displayed on the operating procedures.
  • Continually monitor furnace performance and temperature to ensure an overheat situation does not occur.
  • Read schedules and work orders to determine proper setups, temperatures, and settings for cast materials.
  • Pour molten metal into ladles, molds, and furnaces.
  • Operate/Utilize a gantry crane to charge materials into the melting furnaces or perform other tasks as needed.
  • Smooth and clean the inner surfaces of molds, using brushes, scrapers, air hoses, or grinding wheels, and fill imperfections with refractory material.
  • Maintain inventories of materials.
  • Ensure all equipment is maintained and operated per Wieland policies and health and safety regulations; report service requests as needed.
  • Collaborate with the maintenance department to complete tasks to minimize downtime.
  • Work with team members to achieve department goals.
  • Adhere to Wieland and OSHA safety procedures and job-specific safety practices, and report issues to the Supervisor, Safety, or HR.
  • Follow daily procedures, work instructions, control plans, and protocols outlined during orientations and training.
  • Attend meetings and refresher courses to ensure proper equipment operation.
  • Perform general laborer tasks as required.
  • Maintain daily housekeeping of the work area.
  • Perform routine inspections of products as needed.
  • Carry out additional duties as assigned.

Caster Qualifications:

  • Adherence to health and safety regulations, including consistent use of protective gear.
  • Competency in reading a tape measure, micrometer, and vernier caliper.
  • Ability to work to a high standard of accuracy within a timely manner.
  • Problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot machine quality issues.
  • Capability to stand, balance, walk, and reach for extended periods.
  • Ability to frequently stoop, bend, twist, or crouch.
  • Ability to climb stairs to and from work areas frequently.
  • Dependable and consistent attendance.
  • Ability to lift up to 60 pounds occasionally.
  • Manual dexterity for handling and manipulating items.
  • Strong judgment and ability to ask questions when needed.
  • Attention to detail and consistent alertness to ensure safety.
  • Prioritization of safety in all tasks.
  • Ability to stoop, reach, kneel, twist, and walk while handling products.
  • Vision abilities, including close vision, color vision, and focus adjustment.
  • Excellent teamwork and interpersonal skills.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Metals manufacturing experience preferred.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Three years of manufacturing experience preferred.

Qualifications

Joining Wieland’s team gives you…

  • Benefits - Including Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life & more!
  • Retirement Savings - 401(k) contribution + match.
  • Work/Life Balance - Paid Vacation & Holidays.
  • Growth Opportunities - We have over 9,000+ employees worldwide and 40+ locations in North America alone. Growth opportunities are limitless!
  • Wellness Programs – Wieland encourages participation in our unique and personalized approach to wellness, where you are eligible to earn healthcare premium discounts as well as HSA employer contributions based on your status within the program.
  • Sustainability- Wieland continues to break ground with eco-friendly solutions and push the barrier in sustainability for future generations.

Wieland is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. Come join Wieland today and help us continue to build a global corporation we are all proud to belong to.

title: Community Health Worker - HIV and Infectious Disease Care Coordination
description:
Overview

With compassion and commitment, Community Health Workers embody the Legacy mission of making life better for others. They do this by supporting and educating patients on how to navigate the healthcare system, conducting outreach, and actively participating in the development of individual patient goals. Our Community Health Workers are advocates not only for our patients, but also for the health and well-being of the entire community.

This position is for a Community Health Worker that will focus on the needs of Legacy’s Infectious Disease population, including HIV and patients with Hepatitis C. This position will work across our outpatient clinics, addressing the needs of this patient population wherever the patient may receive care.

Responsibilities

  • Supports individuals, families, and communities in connecting to and navigating the healthcare system.

  • Collaborates with a multidisciplinary team to help patients stabilize and improve their overall health.

  • Acts as a bridge between the community and health/social service systems.

  • Serves patients with complex medical, mental health, and/or substance use needs.

  • Brings expertise and/or experience in public health and working with local communities.

  • Often shares language, cultural background, socioeconomic status, or life experiences with the population served.

  • Builds trusting relationships as a frontline public health worker and community advocate.

  • Facilitates access to care and improves the quality and cultural responsiveness of service delivery.

  • Meets patients in a variety of settings, including clinics, hospitals, homes, and community locations.

Qualifications

Education:

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Community Health Worker training preferred.
  • College Degree or any combination of equivalent education and experience preferred.

Experience:

  • Two years’ experience in healthcare, community-based outreach, social work, mental health, disability care, or education.
  • “Lived experience” with local health, education, human services, childcare, or disability services organizations preferred.
  • Experience with documenting for billable services in an electronic health record preferred.
  • Bi-lingual language skills preferred.

Knowledge /Skills:

  • Cultural knowledge and sensitivity to the population being served. Intended to represent the population they serve while being culturally competent.
  • Demonstrates sensitivity to cultural and individual differences in communities.
  • Basic medical knowledge including the ability to recognize social and medical risk factors and chronic disease conditions.
  • Comfortable working with people with mental illness.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with patients, listening to, implementing, and advocating for their treatment suggestions.
  • Excellent English written and verbal skills.
  • Ability to motivate others.
  • Ability to engage and work collaboratively with others, including patients, patient families, clinical team members and community resources.
  • Demonstrated self-motivation and the ability to work independently.
  • Ability to work with people from diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • Ability to openly address and acknowledge issues of substance use and mental illness.
  • Keyboard skills and ability to navigate electronic systems applicable to job functions.

Licensure

  • Valid driver’s license required.
  • Community Health Worker (CHW) certification required.
  • BLS for Healthcare Provider certification from the American Heart Association required.

Pay Range

USD $27.12 - USD $38.77 /Hr.

Our Commitment to Health and Equal Opportunity

Our Legacy is good for health for Our People, Our Patients, Our Communities, Our World. Above all, we will do the right thing.

If you are passionate about our mission and believe you can contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply—even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can grow and succeed.

Legacy Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits unlawful discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion or creed, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Java Backend Engineer: Real-Time, Scalable Systems (Hybrid)
description:
Vacature: Java Developer Soest

  • Wil jij met jouw codedirect bijdragen aan een duurzamer Nederland?
  • Krijg jij energie van backend-software waar real-time datastromendoorheen lopen en betrouwbaarheid cruciaal is?
  • Zoek je een rol waarin je technisch wordt uitgedaagd én actief kunt doorgroeienrichting senior niveau?
  • En zeg jij ja tegen een salaris oplopend tot €80.000, 30 vakantiedagen,hybride werken, het bezoeken van conferenties als J-Fall en Devoxx?

Lees dan verder.

Jouw werkgever: Inhousetechorganisatie uit Utrecht met echte maatschappelijke impact

Je komt terecht bij een technologiegedrevenorganisatie uit de omgeving Utrecht die werkt aan de digitaleinfrastructuur achter de energietransitie in Nederland. De software diehier gebouwd wordt, vormt de ruggengraat van essentiële processen rondomenergievoorziening en duurzaamheid. Niet zichtbaar voor consumenten, maar deste belangrijker onder de motorkap.

Wat dit interessant maaktvoor jou als Java developer: de technische uitdaging zit in schaal,real-time verwerking en betrouwbaarheid. Dagelijks worden grotehoeveelheden events verwerkt via event-driven architecturen. Systemenmoeten altijd beschikbaar zijn en foutloos functioneren. Dat vraagt om doordachtearchitectuur, sterke Java-kennis en goede engineeringprincipes.

Alles wordt volledig inhouseontwikkeld. Je werkt samen met ervaren backend engineers die veel waardehechten aan kwaliteit, testbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid. Geen haastwerkof consultancy-ritme, maar de tijd en ruimte om software goed neer te zettenen hier de komende jaren op voort te bouwen.

De cultuur is volwassen,stabiel en gericht op duurzame groei. Je kunt hier genieten van een uitstekendeworklife balance maar tegelijkertijd wel technisch uitdagen werk doen. Zo zijner flexibele werktijden, werk je 3 dagen vanuit huis, is er eenmogelijkheid tot leaseauto, krijg je 30 vakantiedagen (5 meer dangemiddeld), goed pensioen en net zo belangrijk: ruim opleidingsbudget.

Jouw rol:Java Developer Soest

Als Java Developer Soestkom je te weken in één van de agile DevOps-teams, met ieder haar eigenfocus. Samen met collega’s bouw aan complexe, grootschalige systemen diecruciaal zijn voor de energietransitie. Vanaf dag één draai je mee opimpactvolle trajecten: van het bouwen van nieuwe event-driven services vanscratch tot het refractoren van bestaande modules met Java 21/SpringBoot/AWS die flink moeten schalen. Je krijg hier echt een varatie aanuitdagingen.

Daarnaast kun je gemakkelijkdoorstromen naar andere teams met eigen uitdagingen en stacks, zodat jejezelf technisch breed blijft ontwikkelen. Of je nu energie krijgt van performancetuning, distributed architecture of code cleanliness,er ligt hier genoegop je te wachten en kun je lekker veel groeien!

Doorgroeimogelijkheden

Je staat er niet alleenvoor. Je werkt nauw samen met zeer ervaren engineers die je actiefbegeleiden op inhoud: architectuurkeuzes, performance, testen encloud-design. Tegelijk krijg je voldoende autonomie om ownership te nemen overonderdelen van het platform en zelf technische beslissingen te maken. Zo kun jesnel doorgroeien naar Senior-niveau, en voor degene die verder willen,zelfs naar Architect of Manager.

Wat wordt er gevraagd?

  • 2+ jaarprofessionele ervaring in JVM
  • Ervaringmet Java 11+, Kotlin en Spring Bootis een plus
  • Ervaringmet Docker en/of Kubernetes containersis een plus
  • Hetwerken in een cloud-omgeving (AWS, Azure oid), is niet geheel nieuw voorjou
  • Interessein event-driven architectuur en distributed systemsis een plus
  • Solidebasis in test-automation & CI/CD pipelines is een plus
  • Technische BSc of MSc is een plus

Wat wordt er geboden?

  • Salaristussen €52.000 & €70.000 bruto per jaar
  • + €10.908 mobiliteitsvergoeding per jaar OFauto vande zaak
  • 3 dagen thuiswerken (goedeworklife balance)
  • Keuzeuit 40, 36 of 32 uur per week
  • Gegarandeerdejaarlijkse inflatiecorrectie
  • 30 vakantiedagen (5 meer dangemiddeld)
  • Pensioen: 80% betaald doorwerkgever
  • Ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget
  • Thuiswerkvergoeding + laptop + telefoonvergoeding
  • Veelinterne en externe Java en of Kotlin meetups mogelijk
  • Groei snel door naar Senior-niveau

Wil jij als Java Developer Soest, bouwen aan systemen die er écht toe doen, terwijl je inhoudelijk grotestappen zet richting senior niveau?
