title: Director, Affinity Programs
description:
Overview

The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association (WFAA), the private fundraising and alumni relations organization for the University of Wisconsin–Madison, is seeking a Director of Affinity Programs to join the Alumni Relations & Engagement team!

The Director of Affinity Programs will serve the Alumni Relations and Engagement division as the strategic lead and people leader working within engagement program portfolios focused on building affinity. This position will co-lead the development of data-informed strategies to build affinity, pride and community among alumni, donors and stakeholders with the university and WFAA. This individual will lead portfolio teams to design engagement initiatives in support of the affinity strategic business area plan and will work with WFAA and campus partners to deliver tactics that will engage key audiences. In addition, they will supervise professional and part-time staff and serve as a lead on cross-functional teams and initiatives. This is a hybrid position that will require you to work weekly in our Madison, WI office location.

Who is WFAA?The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association is a private, nonprofit corporation that encourages individuals and organizations to make gifts to the university and to connect with the UW. In 2014, the UW Foundation merged with the Wisconsin Alumni Association® to better serve a growing population of UW alumni and donors. We believe that private support grows out of good relationships between campus leaders, faculty and program staff who need support, and the alumni and friends who want to invest in UW–Madison. We provide important engagement opportunities to link UW–Madison alumni to each other and to their alma mater, building a strong community of Badgers.

Diversity and Inclusion:

Just as the university community benefits from differing viewpoints, perspectives, and experiences, inclusion and diversity are imperative for the success of our mission. WFAA values people and the differences that they bring to the organization, and creates an environment in which all staff members and constituents feel respected and have opportunities to thrive.

Essential Functions

Program Leadership and Strategy

  • Supervise and lead full and part-time staff on Affinity Team, including leading cross-functional portfolio teams to set strategies aligned with business area plan outcomes; budgeting; and overseeing the execution of tactics in the plans.
  • Coach and support portfolio leads team members in the management of priorities and workflow, ensuring effective planning and execution of activities.
  • Identify resource gaps and problem-solve solutions for maximum return.

Program Development and Delivery

  • Provide leadership for the design and delivery of engagement strategies that serve to establish and grow affinity with constituents through engagements with UW/WFAA.
  • Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and at times serve as project lead
  • Intentionally solicit feedback and participation from alumni and donors in the development of engagement strategies.
  • Collaborate with the Associate Vice President for Engagement Programs, and other program directors to ensure consistency across teams in approach to planning, execution, and intended outcomes.

Team Leadership

  • Supervise and develop professional and part-time staff across affinity portfolio program staff to ensure consistency in approach and execution, across portfolio teams and staff members. Hold team members accountable to expectations, fluencies, and best practices.
  • Motivate, inspire, and coach teams that foster a shared vision and demonstrate organizational values.
  • Provide ongoing feedback and recognition as well as regular performance appraisals.
  • Guide and train team on best practices and tools to track engagement and affinity outcomes.
  • Participate and help guide team efforts in annual divisional business area planning for affinity portfolios.

Administration

  • Demonstrate fluency, proficiency and effectively use organizational processes and technology tools, including WFAA’s CRM, 4WARD.
  • Lead the development of program portfolio budgets in alignment with organizational priorities and oversee effective stewardship of organizational resources in collaboration with the Finance department.
  • Respond promptly and positively to internal and external information inquiries.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 5 + years of experience in alumni or donor relations, educational institutions, non-profit or fundraising environment or related area.
  • Experience supervising and managing professional staff and collaborating with volunteers.
  • High degree of proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook) is essential.

Other Qualifications:

  • Knowledge or experience with project management tools and processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute a strategic engagement plan with a team.
  • Experience planning and executing large and small-scale events and engagement activities.
  • Familiarity with marketing and communications practices, including use of social media.
  • Excellent analytical, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Experience managing a team and advising students and/or volunteers.

At WFAA, we are dedicated to creating an inspiring, creative, and respectful work environment for our employees. We offer competitive pay and an outstanding benefits program, including a generous 10% 401k contribution after just one year of service! Join us and be part of a team that values your growth and well-being. Click here to learn more about our employee benefits!

*The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association is an Equal Opportunity Employer *The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association (advanceuw.org) is the “doing business as” name of the merged organization comprising the University of Wisconsin Foundation (supportuw.org) and the Wisconsin Alumni Association (uwalumni.com). Its legal corporate name is registered as the University of Wisconsin Foundation.

title: Senior Java/Kotlin Backend Engineer for AI-Native Platform
description:

Je komt terecht bijeen jonge, ambitieuze productorganisatie in Rotterdam die bouwt aan eeneigen softwareplatform. Geen consultancy, geen detachering, maar een team datvolledig focust op één product en de lange termijn.

Wat deze clubonderscheidt, is de technische richting die ze nu inslaan.   • Een afgeronde BSc of MSc in Computer Science is een pre

Wat wordt ergeboden?

  • Een salaris tussen de €70.000 en €84.000 bruto per jaar
  • Solide pensioen
  • Reiskostenvergoeding
  • Werk vanuit een mooi kantoor in Rotterdam (1 dag per week thuis)
  • Werken bij een startup opgericht door gevestigde naam
  • Krijg je kans om veel te leren en experimenteren

Wil jij als Senior Java Kotlin Developer Rotterdambouwen aan een platform waar AI geen buzzword is, maar een integraal onderdeelvan het ontwerp?

description:

Preferred

Carrying, Lifting, Listening, Pulling and/or Pushing, Reaching, Sitting, Speaking, Standing, Stooping and Crouching, Walking

title: Post Doc - Open Rank: Implementation Science
description:
Overview

Jumpstart your professional career in implementation science working with national innovators at the University of Massachusetts Chan Medical School’s Center for Accelerating Practices to End Suicide (CAPES https://www.umassmed.edu/capes/).

Fellows will primarily work with Edwin Boudreaux, PhD https://profiles.umassmed.edu/display/130048.

Opportunities with other UMass Chan faculty include:

Rachel Davis-Martin, PhD https://profiles.umassmed.edu/display/18147553

Lourah Kelly, PhD https://profiles.umassmed.edu/display/36076065

Dan Mullin, PsyD, MPH, https://profiles.umassmed.edu/display/129980

and others are also available based on career aspirations of the fellow.

About UMass Chan Medical School:

University of Massachusetts Chan Medical School and its clinical partner, UMass Memorial Health, is a thriving academic health care system located in Worcester MA, about an hour’s drive west of Boston or north of Providence, and about 3.75 hour drive from NYC. The environment provides a highly supportive home for fellows, with opportunities to collaborate with leading researchers and engage in meaningful clinical work.

Responsibilities

This fellowship will focus on using best practices to translate evidence-based suicide prevention interventions into clinical practice across a range of healthcare settings. Fellows will participate in ongoing research and grant submissions, will complete pilot projects, have opportunities for publications and presentations using new and existing datasets, and will prepare mentored research grants (e.g., F32 or K99 to NIH, American Foundation for Suicide Prevention postdoctoral fellowship or early career awards, or other postdoctoral level awards). Current active research includes funding through NIMH, NIDA, SAMHSA, and others. Projects focus on implementing empirically supported treatments for suicide risk screening and prevention, substance abuse, and other behavioral health screening. Leveraging technology and health informatics to promote implementation is a cross-population theme. The fellow will have ample opportunity for additional training and experiences with Population and Quantitative Health Sciences’ Division of Health Informatics and Implementation Science. Applicants with strong methodological, statistical, and quantitative experience are desirable. Individuals with doctoral degrees in psychology, public health, epidemiology, health sciences, health services research, or related fields are welcome to apply.

Fellows will have opportunities to engage in working with healthcare systems on improving their suicide care pathways and will have opportunities for providing training and education across a range of settings, including within the medical school, graduate school of nursing, and residency programs both at UMass Chan and with other Universities.

Qualifications

How to Apply:

A doctoral degree is required in psychology, public health, epidemiology, health sciences, health services research, or related fields. Individuals with a concentration or any prior training in implementation science or health services research are encouraged to apply, though this training is not a required. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the positions are filled. Send detailed letter of interest that specifies the fellowship(s) of interest and summarize relevant experiences and career goals, curriculum vitae, and three letters of reference as indicated below. In addition, you must also apply via the UMass Chan Medical School’s Human Resources website: https://www.umassmed.edu/jobs/

c/o Carolyn Kelly carolyn.kelly@umassmed.edu

Edwin D. Boudreaux, PhD

Professor, Executive Vice Chair for Research, Dept. of Emergency Medicine

Professor, Departments of Psychiatry and Population and Quantitative Health Sciences

Director, Center for Accelerating Practices to End Suicide (CAPES)

UMass Chan Medical School

55 Lake Ave North

title: Restaurant Supervisor
description:
About Heritage Hotels & Resorts

Heritage Hotels & Resorts is New Mexico’s premier locally owned hospitality group, built on a deep respect for culture, place and people. Our luxury hotels and award-winning restaurants are rooted in authentic storytelling, exceptional service and community pride. We care for our guests, our team and our neighborhoods with the same intention. If you enjoy leading service teams and creating exceptional dining experiences, we invite you to grow with us.


At Heritage Hotels & Resorts, we believe great spaces are built by people with vision, craft, and heart. As the new owners of Old Martinez Hall, we are reinvigorating one of Taos' most historic buildings and bringing back its significance as a cultural gathering place. Join us as we assemble a team to help bring it back to life.


Located in Taos, New Mexico, Old Martinez Hall is undergoing a thoughtful transformation that honors its legacy while introducing a new era of curated experiences. From live music and performances to elevated food and beverage moments and intimate cultural programming, this project is designed to be intentional, immersive, and unmistakably Taos.


Why This Role Matters

We are seeking a Restaurant Supervisor who understands just how powerful great hospitality can be. This role matters because you are the driving force that keeps service running smoothly, energizes the team, and sets the tone for an exceptional guest experience. You help create a culture where service feels effortless, genuine, and memorable, ensuring every guest leaves excited to return. By supporting the front-of-house staff, guiding the flow of the dining room, and championing high standards, you play a key part in transforming everyday meals into standout moments. This is an opportunity to lead with positivity, inspire a team, and make a real impact on the success and spirit of the restaurant.


What You’ll Do

  • Maintain a high level of positive and professional interaction with employees, coworkers and guests.
  • Follow all company safety and security policies and procedures.
  • Maintain professional appearance in compliance with uniform and grooming standards.
  • Lead and support front-of-house staff to ensure smooth, efficient, and guest-focused service Assist with training, coaching, and developing team members to uphold service standards
  • Oversee daily floor operations, including table assignments, pacing, and guest flow
  • Monitor guest satisfaction throughout service and address concerns promptly and professionally

title: Operational Excellence Leader II (Lean Six Sigma Black Belt)
description:

The Operational Excellence (OPEX) & Lean Six Sigma Black Belt role is responsible for leading high‑impact improvement initiatives that eliminate waste, reduce process variability, and enhance business performance across the organization. Operating with a strategic mindset, this role leverages advanced analytical techniques, Lean methodologies, and Six Sigma tools to drive measurable results. The Black Belt partners with Master Black Belts, Process Owners, and cross‑functional teams to foster a culture of continuous improvement, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and customer value.

Develop and mentor yellow and green belts. • Manage complex, high‑visibility projects and collaborate across sectors to drive enterprise‑wide operational excellence. • Manage multiple high‑complexity projects simultaneously using disciplined project management approaches.

Strategic & Analytical Strengths• Advanced capability in statistical analysis, root‑cause identification, data interpretation, and decision‑making. • Ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear insights for diverse audiences.

Skilled in engaging and influencing groups unfamiliar or hesitant about continuous improvement. • Strong communication abilities across executive leadership and frontline employees; able to make technical concepts accessible. • Builds constructive relationships and works collaboratively across all levels of the organization. Translates technical concepts into accessible language.Builds trust quickly with diverse groups.

Project & Problem‑Solving Skills• Persistent, curious, and committed to eliminating root causes—not treating symptoms.Maintains composure under pressure and adapts quickly when obstacles arise.• Strong prioritization, governance discipline, and multitasking capabilities

title: SITEC - TACLAN Systems Administrator - MacDill AFB
description:

Peraton requires Systems Administrators to support the Special Operation Command Information Technology Enterprise Contract (SITEC) – 3 EOM. This position is located at MacDill AFB in Florida.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Heb jij ervaring met het schrijven van code om data te ontsluiten? Houd je van data wrangling, het uitpluizen van databronnen en het verwerken van data tot een leesbare en bruikbare vorm? Krijg jij een kick van dat moment waarop de data moeiteloos een data lake instroomt – dag in, dag uit, elk uur opnieuw – op basis van de code die jij zorgvuldig hebt geschreven? Dan is deze functie als Data Engineer precies wat je zoekt!

Voor meerdere enterprise klanten bouwen wij data connectors om data vanuit diverse bronnen te laten stromen, met gebruik van state-of-the-art technologieën en cloud providers zoals Azure. Maar wij zijn platform- en tool-agnostisch en deinzen niet terug voor technische uitdagingen. Wat al deze oplossingen gemeen hebben, is dat de data een essentieel onderdeel vormt van de business value chain en gebruikt wordt in een productieomgeving. Dat betekent dat datakwaliteit, continuïteit en een soepele datastroom cruciaal zijn – uiteraard met monitoring om verstoringen op te sporen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Bouwen van data connectors of verwerkingsoplossingen met Python, Spark of andere programmeertalen.

  • Definiëren van validatietests binnen de datapijplijn.

  • Inrichten van monitoring en alerts, zodat verstoringen of fouten in de datastroom direct zichtbaar zijn.

  • Bij incidenten neem jij het voortouw om de oorzaak zo snel mogelijk te achterhalen en op te lossen, met minimale impact voor de eindgebruikers.

  • Contact houden met eindgebruikers en je oplossingen valideren, met oog voor continue verbetering.

  • Samen met het team ben je verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen, deployen, onderhouden en optimaliseren van de datastroomoplossing.


Je krijgt bij ons de ruimte om je op de best mogelijke manier te ontwikkelen, onder persoonlijke begeleiding van ervaren data engineers en architecten van Itility. Via onze eigen Itility Academy kun je verschillende trainingen volgen om zowel je technische als je soft skills te ontwikkelen. Daarnaast organiseert onze data community tech hours waarin we kennis delen, oplossingen en tools demonstreren, en samen specifieke certificaten behalen.

Naast een goed salaris ontvang je extra's zoals:

  • 26 vakantiedagen

  • 115 euro onkostenvergoeding

  • Leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding

  • 50% bijdrage aan ziektekostenverzekering

  • 60% bijdrage aan pensioenregeling

  • Bonus gebaseerd op jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en gezamenlijke successen

  • Laptop en telefoon

  • Itility Academy - training in hard en soft skills

  • Hybride werken

  • Gebruik van gym op kantoor

Dit ben jij

Je bent vertrouwd met de scrum/agile manier van werken en met softwarepraktijken die een professionele datastroom mogelijk maken.

Verder vragen we het volgende:

  • Je hebt een hbo- of wo-diploma.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen van scripts voor data-inname en -verwerking.

  • Ervaring met Microsoft Azure Data Factory en Fabric of Databricks is een pré.

  • Ervaring met datamodelbeheer en dashboarding (bijvoorbeeld met PowerBI) is een pré.

  • Je hebt 2 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring.

  • Je hebt een goede kennis van SQL, Python en Spark, en een basiskennis van het uitrollen van datasolutions in containeromgevingen (zoals Kubernetes).

  • Je bent een teamspeler en beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels.

  • Idealiter heb je al gewerkt met dataplatformen en data lakes binnen een enterprise-omgeving.

title: Qa Coordinator
description:
Our Company

StepStone Family & Youth Services

StepStone Family & Youth Services provides trauma informed, youth centered services to children and families involved in foster care. The Quality Assurance Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting program quality, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement to help ensure youth and families receive safe, consistent, and high quality services.

We are seeking a detail oriented and organized Quality Assurance Coordinator who is passionate about maintaining high standards of care and supporting teams through trauma informed, strengths based, and family centered practices. This role is ideal for a professional who values accuracy, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

The Quality Assurance Coordinator is responsible for monitoring documentation and program records, conducting quality reviews and audits, tracking compliance requirements, identifying areas for improvement, and supporting corrective action efforts. This position works closely with program leadership and staff to ensure services and documentation align with agency policies, licensing requirements, accreditation standards, and applicable state and regulatory guidelines.

Responsibilities

  • Present feedback to management regarding areas that need improvement.
  • Ensure all clients receive a return call within 24 hours of calling.

StepStone Family and Youth Services, an affiliate of BrightSpring Health Services, provides the full spectrum of support to children in need of alternative, safer, and more positive living environments with residential and family services. title: Business Analyst - Digital Assets
description:
Overview

Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity. With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors. Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

Institutional: Immerse yourself in the best-in-class institutional-grade technology, working alongside industry experts and gaining exposure to various asset classes, such as equities, options, fixed income securities, and advanced trading, research, and management technology.

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated Analyst to join our Digital Asset team and support the onboarding and lifecycle management of institutional clients. This role will serve as a key liaison between Sales, Compliance, Operations, Risk, Legal, and external clients to ensure timely and efficient onboarding of new relationships across digital asset trading, custody, financing, and related products.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, process-driven, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment that combines the rigor of traditional financial markets with the rapidly evolving digital asset ecosystem. Experience supporting futures, derivatives, or prime brokerage onboarding is preferred but not required.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Client Onboarding & Relationship Management

  • Coordinate end-to-end onboarding for institutional clients including hedge funds, asset managers, proprietary trading firms, corporates, family offices, and other financial institutions.
  • Manage client onboarding workflows from initial engagement through account activation and trading readiness.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for onboarding-related inquiries and documentation requests.
  • Track onboarding progress and maintain accurate status updates for internal stakeholders.

KYC, AML & Compliance Coordination

  • Collect and review client documentation required for KYC, AML, sanctions screening, tax verification, and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with Compliance and Risk teams to facilitate customer due diligence reviews and approvals.
  • Assist clients in resolving onboarding deficiencies and documentation gaps.
  • Ensure all onboarding records are maintained in accordance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

Operational & Product Enablement

  • Coordinate account setup across trading, custody, settlement, financing, and reporting platforms.
  • Work with Operations and Technology teams to support platform access, account configuration, wallet setup, and connectivity requirements.
  • Facilitate operational readiness for new products and services.
  • Support onboarding of clients across spot, custody, financing, lending, and future product offerings.

Process Management & Reporting

  • Maintain onboarding trackers, metrics, and management reporting.
  • Monitor onboarding cycle times and identify operational bottlenecks.
  • Assist in developing scalable onboarding procedures and documentation.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives focused on automation and client experience enhancement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales, Product, Compliance, Risk, Legal, Treasury, Operations, and Technology teams.
  • Assist in launches of new products, jurisdictions, and service offerings requiring onboarding support.
  • Contribute to special projects related to digital asset infrastructure, custody, clearing, or client lifecycle management.

Qualifications

To land this role you will need:

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting, or a related discipline.
  • 1-3 years of experience in client onboarding, operations, middle office, compliance, account management, or related financial services functions.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting institutional clients within capital markets, brokerage, prime brokerage, digital assets, fintech, or banking environments.
  • Familiarity with KYC, AML, sanctions screening, and client due diligence processes.
  • Understanding of digital assets, cryptocurrency markets, custody, settlement, or blockchain technology.
  • Experience with futures, derivatives, clearing, or FCM onboarding processes.
  • Exposure to CRM, onboarding workflow, or case management systems.

Skills & Attributes

  • Strong client service mindset.
  • Ability to work effectively across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Analytical and problem-solving orientation.
  • Self-starter who thrives in a rapidly evolving environment.
  • Intellectual curiosity about digital assets and financial markets.
  • Ability to balance risk, compliance, and client experience considerations.

What Success looks Like

  • New clients are onboarded efficiently with minimal operational friction.
  • Strong partnership with Compliance and Risk to navigate onboarding requirements.
  • Accurate and timely communication with internal stakeholders and clients.
  • Continuous improvement of onboarding processes and client experience.
  • Contribution to the scalable growth of the firm's digital asset business.

Subject to business performance and recommendations of management, this role may be eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan. title: Technical Project Manager - Senior
description:
Responsibilities

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe and connected.

We’re looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission — you’ll define it.

Project Manager – Surveillance & Radar Systems

Shape the Future of Air Traffic Management with Peraton

Join a team dedicated to protecting the safety, efficiency, and integrity of U.S. air travel. At Peraton, we partner with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to support and modernize the systems that keep the National Airspace System (NAS) operating safely and efficiently.

Peraton is seeking dynamic, technically focused Project Managers to join our team of talented and diverse professionals. In this role, you will provide leadership across critical Surveillance and Radar Systems initiatives, guiding planning, prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and execution to ensure program objectives are achieved.

Whether you are leading multidisciplinary engineering teams, coordinating safety and validation activities, or supporting major FAA modernization initiatives, your work will have a direct impact on the systems relied upon by millions of passengers, aviation professionals, and communities every day.

This is an opportunity to bring your project leadership expertise to a mission where the work you do truly matters.

Work Location

  • Preferred location: Herndon, VA
  • Work arrangement: Primarily on-site; remote work options may be considered based on candidate qualifications and program requirements.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead the planning and execution of multidisciplinary workstreams supporting Surveillance and Radar Systems and related engineering activities.
  • Establish priorities, coordinate resources, and ensure work remains aligned with program objectives, schedules, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Lead and motivate high-performing teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and a culture focused on mission success.
  • Engage with stakeholders to understand requirements, manage expectations, communicate priorities, and provide clear and timely program updates.
  • Monitor program performance, schedules, and delivery metrics to identify risks, remove roadblocks, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with product owners, system vendors, developers, FAA facilities, engineering teams, and leadership to maintain alignment and deliver mission value.
  • Develop and maintain roadmaps, status reports, action items, and program documentation to provide visibility and support informed decision-making.
  • Identify emerging challenges and opportunities, develop mitigation strategies, and help teams navigate complex technical and organizational issues.
  • Support change management and communications to facilitate the successful adoption of new technologies, processes, and tools.
  • Promote effective cross-functional collaboration while ensuring deliverables meet program, technical, quality, and mission requirements.

Why This Role Matters

The National Airspace System is one of the world’s most sophisticated and mission-critical infrastructures, and the systems supporting it must perform reliably every day.

As a Project Manager supporting Surveillance and Radar Systems, you will help lead the people, processes, and technology behind critical aviation capabilities. Your leadership will help teams respond to evolving requirements, manage complex initiatives, reduce risk, and deliver solutions that strengthen the safety, efficiency, and readiness of the nation's airspace.

At Peraton, you won’t just manage projects—you’ll help shape the future of air traffic management.

Qualifications

Position Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree with 8 years of experience, Master’s with 6 years, Associate’s with 10 years, or HS diploma/equivalent with 12 years of relevant experience.
  • Proven project leadership experience supporting Surveillance and/or Radar Systems, including surface surveillance, sensor data feeds, multi-sensor fusion, primary/secondary radar, SSR, ASR, or similar systems.
  • FAA Technical Operations (TechOps) experience required, with demonstrated experience maintaining and supporting mission-critical NAS systems.
  • Direct experience with FAA Technical Services Operations Group (TSOG) or as an Airway Transportation Systems Specialist (ATSS) supporting NAS infrastructure.
  • Hands-on technical experience with airport surface surveillance/radar systems, including architecture, hardware, software, system interfaces, maintenance, troubleshooting, and performance analysis.
  • Experience coordinating site and facility activities, including installation, modification, system acceptance, and field deployment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience working with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive alignment, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in dynamic, mission-critical environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • FAA TechOps, TSOG, or ATSS experience, with SMR/ASDE experience highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting FAA NextGen, NAS modernization, or federal aviation programs.
  • Experience managing federal modernization programs or large-scale enterprise initiatives.
  • Familiarity with FAA standards, facility directives, and compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge of risk management, budgeting, and program governance.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

title: Principal Archaeologist
description:
Overview

NV5 is seeking a full-time Principal Archaeologist/Investigator for Cultural Resources Management work in New Mexico. The successful candidate will report to NV5’s Cultural Resource Program in Alpharetta, Georgia; however, the position has location flexibility and remote work may be possible dependent on candidate experience and qualifications. New Mexico experience is required: the successful candidate must be listed on or eligible for listing as a Principal Investigator on the New Mexico State Historic Preservation Office’s SHPO Directory of Qualified Supervisory Personnel.

This position will complete various types of reports, such as Management Summaries, Archaeological Resource Identification/Survey Reports at the Phase I, II, and III level of investigation, Assessment of Effects, historic contexts, etc., for a variety of clients in the transportation, energy, land development, and municipal sectors. The archaeologist will conduct research, field surveys, and data recovery initiatives to assist in the identification and evaluation of archaeological sites and will complete project tasks within deadlines and budgets. The Project Archaeologist reports to the Senior Archaeologist (Principal Investigator).

The successful candidate with be listed on or eligible for listing as a Principal Investigator on the New Mexico State Historic Preservation Office’s SHPO Directory of Qualified Supervisory Personnel.

Responsibilities

The most frequent and essential work activities include:

  • Conduct Section 106 and/or due diligence assessments for infrastructure and energy projects, as required, including fieldwork/survey, archaeological resource identification and evaluation, and project effects assessment. Evaluations would include field assessments, use of background documentation (i.e. property records and archival research, county surveys, maps, site files, context studies, etc.), delineation of site boundaries using GIS mapping, and photography.
  • Complete or assist with additional Section 106 tasks, including leading or assisting with consultation (i.e. supporting project consulting parties’ meetings or public meetings, etc.) and project mitigation (i.e. developing data recovery plans and undertaking data recovery efforts, etc.).
  • Conduct artifact analysis and curation efforts.
  • Complete other archaeology-related tasks as needed; other tasks could include preparation of proposed avoidance and/or minimization measures for the continued preservation of National Register-listed or eligible archaeological resources.
  • Manage the performance of individual projects and coordinate with a variety of colleagues, clients, agencies, and the public.
  • Maintain effective and successful communication with project team, co-workers, and clients.
  • Assist in business development and marketing efforts, focusing on the development of NV5’s archaeological practice in the southwestern and southeastern United States.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Professional archaeological experience in New Mexico required
  • Master’s degree in anthropology, archaeology, or a closely related field
  • Current standing or eligibility for Register of Professional Archaeologists (RPA) or qualified archaeologist under the Secretary of the Interior’s Professional Qualifications for Archaeology (36 Code of Federal Regulations, CFR Part 61
  • Listed on or eligible for listing as a Principal Investigator on the New Mexico State Historic Preservation Office’s SHPO Directory of Qualified Supervisory Personnel.
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license
  • Be eligible for and able to respond to federal and state permitting requirements
  • Experience as an archaeological field director or project manager a plus

Preferred knowledge, skills, and abilities:

  • Experience with Microsoft Office and ArcGIS software
  • Proficiency in utilization of GPS equipment to assist with site boundary delineations
  • Experience as an archaeological field director or project manager a plus
  • Experience in U.S. regions beyond New Mexico a plus
  • DOT and/or energy-related (FERC and/or Corps-regulated pipelines, transmission lines, etc.) experience a plus
  • Experience in conducting Native American consultation a plus

Work environment and physical demands of this position

The characteristics described below are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of this position. When properly requested and when feasible (without undue hardship to the organization), reasonable accommodation will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

  • Work will be in both field and office settings with some opportunities to be exposed to adverse environmental conditions.
  • Fieldwork will involve long-term standing and frequent walking as well as include common hazards at project sites.
  • Must be able to carry, lift and push/pull up to 30 pounds frequently and up to 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Must have the ability to see, smell, hear, talk, climb, balance, stoop, kneel and twist, crouch, crawl, reach, grasp, sit, stand, and walk.
  • As-needed weekend, overtime work, and overnight work and travel will be required. Travel will typically be in southwestern and southeastern U.S.
  • Additional physical duties may be required as necessary.
  • Office work will include working with fingers by picking, pinching, typing and grasping often with repetitive motion.
  • Must have visual acuity for viewing a computer screen, the ability to talk, hear and sit for extended periods of time.

The pay range for this position is $ per year. Base pay offered may be higher or lower depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location of the candidate. Restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered.

All local employment laws apply. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via the NV5 careers site.

NV5 offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, PTO, 401(k) and professional development/advancement opportunities.

NV5 provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. NV5 complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

The Aggies capped a historic final season in the Mountain West by capturing nine combined regular-season and tournament titles in 2025–26, with five teams advancing to postseason play. This tradition of excellence extends to the classroom, where 232 student-athletes earned academic honors, and to the community, where USU ranked second nationally in Division I service hours, with nine teams placing in the top 10 for community service.

Utah State is dedicated to fostering a community where all individuals feel respected, valued, and supported and where diversity of thought and culture are cultivated. We seek to recruit, hire, and retain people from all walks of life who will champion excellence in education, research, discovery, outreach, and service. We believe that promoting a strong sense of community and belonging empowers and engages all members of USU to thrive and be successful. Forbes recognized our commitment to employees when they named Utah State the best employer in Utah in 2023. Learn more about USU.

title: Claims Specialist
description:
You Matter

  • Make a difference every day in the lives of the underserved
  • Join a mission driven organization with a people first culture
  • Excellent career growth opportunities

Join us and find a career that supports:

  • Caring for overlooked, underserved, and vulnerable patients
  • Autonomy in a warm team environment
  • Growth and training

Perks and Benefits

In addition to comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, paid time off, and 401k, we foster a work, life balance for team members and their family to support physical, mental, and financial wellbeing including:

  • DailyPay, receive your money as you earn it!
  • Tuition Assistance and dependent Scholarships
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) including free counseling and health coaching
  • Company paid life insurance
  • Tax free Health Spending Accounts (HSA)

Why Us

Now is your moment to make a difference in the lives of the underserved.

If there is one unifying characteristic of everyone on our team, it is the deep desire to make a difference by helping society's most vulnerable and often overlooked individuals. Every day we have the distinct honor and responsibility to show up with non-judgmental compassion to provide hope and healing to those who need it most. For those whose calling it is to serve others, now is your moment to join our mission to provide quality care to every patient with compassion, collaboration, and innovation, to live our mantra to “Always Do The Right Thing!”, and to collectively do our part to heal the world, one patient at a time.

Wellpath sees hundreds of thousands of unique individuals in their facilities month over month and a very large percent of those individuals receive direct clinical care, which includes lives saved by Narcan.

We offer ongoing training and development opportunities for licensed and unlicensed healthcare team members, and have best in class clinical resources for training, education, and point of care support.

How you make a difference

The Claims Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of medical claims in accordance with established rules, coding standards, payer guidelines, and regulatory requirements. title: DFM - CNC Machining (5-axis Milling Estimators)
description:
As a 5-Axis Milling Estimator, you play a critical role in ensuring complex machined parts are manufacturable, accurately scoped, and aligned with production capabilities before they reach the shop floor. You perform in-depth Design for Manufacturability reviews, evaluate machining strategy using Fusion 360 CAM, and communicate clearly with customers regarding required adjustments or optimization opportunities. This role bridges customer intent and production execution, helping maintain quality, efficiency, and consistency across our CNC machining operations.


Why SendCutSend?


SendCutSend is an on-demand manufacturing company specializing in custom sheet metal and CNC machining. We serve more than 150,000 engineers, fabricators, and businesses across the U.S. and Canada. We operate out of six facilities located in Nevada, Kentucky, and Texas.

We value people who are collaborative, innovative, and committed to detailed high-quality work. We’re scaling fast and building the future of manufacturing. If you’re excited to join the team and grow with us, we want to hear from you!


What you’ll do

  • Review incoming CNC machining orders to evaluate manufacturability, feasibility, and production alignment
  • Perform detailed DFM checks for complex multi-axis machined parts
  • Modify or optimize customer files using Fusion 360 CAM as needed to meet production standards
  • Evaluate machining strategy, toolpaths, workholding approach, and risk areas prior to release
  • Communicate clearly with customers regarding manufacturability concerns and recommended adjustments
  • Partner with Support, Programming, and Production teams to ensure customer objectives and operational goals are aligned
  • Support continuous improvement of DFM workflows, documentation standards, and estimating processes
  • Maintain accuracy and consistency in technical reviews while meeting volume and turnaround expectations

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of direct experience programming 5-axis CNC mills using Fusion 360 CAM
  • Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English
  • Strong understanding of machining strategies, toolpath optimization, feeds and speeds, and workholding methods
  • Ability to evaluate part geometry and identify manufacturability risks
  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to customers
  • Experience working cross-functionally with programming and production teams
  • Strong computer proficiency and comfort working within digital production systems
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple reviews in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of CNC milling experience in a production environment
  • Experience estimating machining time or quoting complex parts
  • Familiarity with high-mix, low-volume production workflows
  • Exposure to automation or workflow optimization within CAM systems
  • Prior experience in a customer-facing technical role

Essential Physical Requirements

  • Employee must establish and maintain a dedicated, safe, confidential, and ergonomic home workspace.
  • Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to use a computer, phone, and other standard office equipment for remote work.

Work Environment

  • This role is a work from home position in a fast paced, collaborative environment that requires consistent communication, organization, and coordination across multiple remote teams.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer ID71007
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to build and maintain backend services and frontend interfaces that surface, validate, and resolve issues in data coming from ETL pipelines, data lake outputs, and ML model results for a large-scale marketing analytics platform. You will develop REST APIs in Python using FastAPI or Flask, build responsive React and TypeScript frontends, manage PostgreSQL schemas and migrations, and leverage AI-assisted development tools with the critical judgment to push back on shortcuts that compromise long-term maintainability. You will work in an environment where requirements are often ad hoc and underspecified, taking ownership of defining the problem, gathering context, identifying constraints, and shaping practical solutions before implementation.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Build and maintain scalable backend services (REST APIs) and responsive frontend interfaces (React/TypeScript).
- Build the interfaces and services that surface, validate, and resolve issues in data coming from the data lake, ETL pipelines, health-check logic, or model outputs — without necessarily owning pipeline architecture.
- Package and manage applications using Docker.
- Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) to move fast during implementation — while critically evaluating AI-generated output and pushing back when it isn't the right long-term solution.
- Drive conversations directly with engineers to clarify both functional and non-functional requirements, rather than defaulting to whatever "just works" in the short term.
- Work daily alongside engineers over Slack and Google Meet.

MUST HAVES
- 5–7 years of full-stack software development experience.
- Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI or Flask) and TypeScript/React.
- Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL) and database migrations.
- Comfortable with REST APIs; able to work with and migrate away from legacy GraphQL where needed.
- Demonstrated experience building or maintaining data-heavy applications (large datasets, performance-sensitive queries at the application layer).
- Practical, hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools, paired with the critical judgment to challenge AI output when it compromises long-term maintainability.
- High comfort level working entirely in a Mac/Linux terminal environment (Bash, Makefiles).
- Strong soft skills (mandatory, not a bonus): the ability to hold and defend a technical opinion — challenging a stakeholder's or a tool's proposed "quick fix" with sound reasoning in pursuit of a solution that scales and is maintainable long-term, while still being pragmatic enough to ship.
- Comfort with ambiguity (mandatory): work is frequently ad hoc and underspecified. This role requires defining the problem — gathering context, identifying constraints, and framing the work — before solving it, rather than waiting for a specification. Experience limited to well-specified work executed through agent workflows is not a fit.
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Exposure to object-storage-backed data lakes and serverless query engines (S3 + Athena, or comparable — Trino/Presto, BigQuery, Spark SQL).
- Familiarity with DAG-based task orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Step Functions), or the ability to pick it up quickly.
- Data engineering exposure — experience building or maintaining ETL pipelines, advanced SQL (complex queries, data validation, optimization).
- Caching/NoSQL systems (Redis, DynamoDB).
- Monorepo tooling or modern package managers (Nx, Poetry, UV).
- Familiarity with AWS Bedrock or similar AI/LLM SDKs.
- Experience with marketing data structures, campaign management APIs, or digital advertising metrics.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Growth without limits: build your skills through mentorship, internal TechTalks, challenging projects, and a dedicated annual learning budget
- Competitive compensation: get recognition that reflects your skills and impact, with regular performance and compensation reviews
- Flexibility: work 100% remotely with flexible hours that support focus, autonomy, and a healthy work rhythm
- Meaningful, modern projects: build impactful products using modern technologies alongside global teams and leading brands
- Collaborative culture: join a supportive environment with zero micromanagement where ideas are welcomed and contributions are recognized
- Well-being & support: access local well-being programs and people-focused support tailored to your location

title: System Security Engineer AT and Supply Chain Risk Management
description:
Opportunity

PeopleTec is currently seeking a System Security Engineer AT and Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) to support our Huntsville, AL location.

The candidate will serve as a System Security Engineer AT and Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) within a Project Management Office (PMO) within PAE Fires and will be responsible for providing technical support to the program's Chief Engineer and the Technical Chief. The candidate will protect critical program hardware, firmware, and microelectronics against reverse engineering, unauthorized exploitation, and supply chain threats across the system lifecycle (design, development, acquisition, integration, testing, fielding, and sustainment). The candidate will prepare and present anti-tamper and SCRM findings, reports, and improvement plans to senior management and stakeholders. Will work within and/or lead a multidisciplinary team to achieve program goals. Perform other tasks as assigned by the Chief Engineer and/or Technical Chief.

The candidate will be required to interface with internal PMs across PAE Fires and external organizations to include HQDA, ASA(ALT), JIATF 401, ATEC, AMCOM, and others for coordination and synchronization of anti-tamper and SCRM technical and programmatic objectives.

Duties:

  • Provide technical support and security engineering in anti-tamper and SCRM across the system lifecycle (design, development, acquisition, integration, testing, fielding, and sustainment).
  • Advise on the design, implementation, and verification of Anti-Tamper (AT) architectures and countermeasures across manufacturer, vendor, and supplier organizations for assigned programs.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of Program Protection Plans (PPP) and author Anti-Tamper Plans (ATP) aligned with DoD requirements.
  • Implement comprehensive Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) protocols for critical components and trusted suppliers.
  • Conduct hardware vulnerability assessments, counterfeit part prevention audits, and secure silicon/ASIC/FPGA provenance tracking.
  • Coordinate with the DoD Anti-Tamper Executive Agent (ATEA) for milestone reviews and validation testing.
  • Develop and maintain Anti-Tamper Evaluation & Verification Reports, the Program SCRM & Counterfeit Prevention Plan, and the Hardware Assurance & Bill of Materials (BOM) Risk Assessment.
  • Ensure compliance with defense and industry standards by managing anti-tamper and SCRM processes effectively.
  • Interface with internal teams and external organizations to coordinate anti-tamper and SCRM objectives and strategies.
  • Prepare and present anti-tamper and SCRM findings, reports, and improvement plans to senior management and stakeholders.
  • Conduct strategic planning and coordination to support program objectives.
  • Provide technical expertise to support peer engineers within the Technology Security, Program Protection, Cyber Security, and Technical Management teams.
  • Use digital tools and methodologies to analyze supply chain risks, manufacturer/supplier relationships, and foreign ownership and controlling influence.
  • Perform other tasks as assigned by the Chief Engineer and/or Technical Chief.

Qualifications

Required Skills/Experience:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience. Additional education may be substituted for years of experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in anti-tamper and SCRM, particularly within defense or aerospace industries.
  • Knowledge of DoD Directive 5200.47E (Anti-Tamper), DoDI 5200.44 (Trusted Systems/SCRM), NIST SP 800-161, Cryptographic Key Zeroization/Encapsulation, Secure Boot/TrustZone, FPGA/ASIC Bitstream Protection, and IDEA-STD-1010.
  • Strong knowledge of industry standards and defense requirements.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to lead and work within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Previous experience working in a U.S. Government Program Office (required).
  • Travel: 25%
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen
  • An active DoD Secret clearance is required to perform this work. Candidates are required to have an active Secret clearance upon hire, and the ability to maintain this level of clearance during their employment.

Education Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (or related technical discipline)

Desired Skills:

  • Top Secret clearance preferred

title: Director, Strategy
description:
Responsibilities

The Director, Pursuit Strategy is a senior individual contributor on Peraton's Growth Strategy & Intelligence team. This role sits at the intersection of competitive intelligence and bid execution - consuming finished intelligence products, translating them into win arguments and competitive positioning, and delivering pursuit strategy support to Peraton's highest-priority opportunities.

This is not a capture management role. It is a strategy role. The Director, Pursuit Strategy does not run bids or act as a deputy capture resource - they make bids winnable by providing a clear assessment of capture competitiveness and coaching teams to proactively mitigate ongoing pipeline risk management through capture excellence activities and practices.

The role operates as the primary strategy partner to capture teams on Business Priority 0 and 1 (BP 2 as bandwidth allows) pursuits. It reports directly to the Senior Director, Growth Strategy & Intelligence and works in close coordination with support teams like Corporate Intelligence, Pricing & Estimation, Talent Acquisition, Procurement, and others.

Key Responsibilities

Pursuit Strategy & Win Argument Development

  • Develop win arguments for Tier 0/1 pursuits using the PerWINS six-element framework: customer objective, challenge, solution, benefit, proof point, and follow-through
  • Translate competitive intelligence products into actionable win themes, competitive positioning, and section-level strategy guidance
  • Deliver gate intelligence packages to capture teams no later than 5 business days before each gate review
  • Assess probability of win (pWin) at key pursuit milestones; document rationale and update as conditions change
  • Develop and maintain competitive positioning narratives for priority pursuits across assigned mission cluster

Capture Strategy and Capture Excellence Facilitation

  • Facilitate a variety of growth intelligence and capture engagements (strategy workshops, solutioning sessions, Black Hat and White Hat reviews, etc.) for Tier 0/1 pursuits
  • Support independent quality assessment for recompete programs (e.g. mid-course reviews and growth-driven program reviews) providing a strategic bridge between Sector delivery resources and Growth teams

Growth Intelligence Integration

  • Operate as the primary consumer and translator of growth intelligence and capture engagement outputs into pursuit strategy artifacts
  • Co-own growth intelligence requirements development with the CI/CA team for assigned pursuits
  • Provide structured feedback to the CI/CA team on intelligence gaps and collection priorities based on active pursuit needs, and maintain focus on consistent application and continuous improvement of customer/competitive understanding

Capture Methodology Execution

  • Develop deep understanding of and apply Peraton’s agile capture methodology to pursuit strategy work; ensure strategy artifacts reflect correct quality level expectations at each gate
  • Support capture teams with independent assessment of capture health and readiness to bid relevant to strategy and competitive positioning
  • Participate in agile capture management calibration cycles; flag methodology gaps or field-level friction to the VP, Growth Strategy & Intelligence
  • Serve as a senior advisory resource for capture teams on Peraton capture practices

Win/Loss & Debrief Participation

  • Participate in post-award debriefs for Tier 0/1 pursuits within assigned cluster
  • Synthesize debrief findings into actionable strategy lessons; contribute to win/loss pattern analysis
  • Maintain a running competitive landscape view for assigned mission cluster based on debrief data, market signals, and CI products

Qualifications

  • 16+ years of experience in federal government contracting, with direct experience in capture strategy, competitive analysis, or pursuit strategy roles
  • Senior practitioner level understanding of capture methodologies (Shipley, Lohfeld, or comparable system) and a demonstrated track record supporting and winning large-scale federal pursuits (>$100M TCV)
  • Experience facilitating or participating in Black Hat reviews, competitive assessments, or structured win strategy sessions to diverse technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills - ability to produce executive-quality strategy artifacts under tight pursuit timelines and present confidently to C-level executives
  • Must hold and maintain a TS security clearance (clearance level dependent on portfolio requirements)

Desired Qualifications

  • Familiarity with pWin and/or PTW modelling, proposal management, staffing, and other associated capture support functions as a practitioner or manager
  • Experience working or supporting large, complex GovCon prime opportunities ($1B+ TCV)
  • Expertise in the use of AI/automation tools in a capture or strategy context
  • SCI eligibility or ability to obtain SCI eligibility.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Housing Services - CCSNW: This position is responsible for leading CCSNW’s Housing Services including permanent supportive housing (PSH) and scattered-site housing. This position ensures the development of services and grant opportunities as well as oversees the daily operations for CCSNW (Snohomish, Skagit, and Whatcom Counties). The position is responsible for ensuring the delivery of quality, person-centered housing services that promote stability, health, safety, dignity and the long-term well-being for residents. The Housing Director is responsible for ensuring fiscal integrity of the Housing programs and provide leadership across housing operations, supportive services, property and landlord partnerships, compliance, quality assurance, staff development, and program performance. Working collaboratively with senior leadership and internal and external partners, this position ensures that housing programs operate effectively, meet contractual and regulatory requirements, and reflect best practices in supportive housing. This includes leading the transformation of CCSNW housing programs by ensuring services are designed in a way that helps and supports the “whole” person; accomplishing this by working on the integration of behavioral health and Substance Use Disorder (SUD) services into the CCSNW housing programs. The Director of Housing Services is responsible for ensuring all housing leadership staff are trained and are following day-to-day procedures, including updates on agency policies, compliance, and contractual changes.

Responsibilities

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Upholds and models the Mission, Insights, Key Action Steps and Principles of Leadership for CCSWW.
  • Supervises, evaluates the performance of, and hold accountable the following leadership positions:
    • Associate Director of Housing – CCSNW
    • CCSNW Housing Operations Director
    • Skagit Housing Director
    • Housing Program Managers
  • Provide leadership and direction for existing and new staff throughout the CCSNW Housing Services Programs.
    • Lead the transformation of housing programs to provide a whole-person, client-centered service model that addresses housing stability while recognizing the interconnected needs of residents, including behavioral health, SUD recovery and case management services including when applicable physical health, employment opportunities, benefits (SSDI, Medicaid, etc.), community program connection(s) leading to long-term self-sufficiency.
    • Develop and implement strategies to integrate behavioral health and substance use disorder services into CCSNW housing programs by strengthening partnerships, coordinating care across disciplines, supporting trauma-informed and harm-reduction practices, and ensuring staff have the training, tools (e.g. motivational interviewing, de-escalation, etc.), and guidance needed to respond effectively to complex client needs.
  • Maintains professional knowledge and expertise necessary to perform in the functional areas of Housing administration and management.
  • Ensure fiscal solvency of programs:
    • Work with the CCSNW Finance Director on annual housing budgets and develop management reports for ongoing fiscal monitoring.
    • Review monthly revenue/expenditure reports and ensure that expenditures are within budgeted levels.
    • Participates in procurement of funds through contact renewal and grants.
    • Establish and monitor key indicators.
  • Contract Compliance & Reporting:
    • Ensure program compliance with all licensing, contract requirements and outcomes.
    • Ensure that program operation and documentation comply with contracts, auditing and all other applicable standards.
    • Develop and conduct ongoing program-auditing processes to ensure that program standards are maintained throughout the service area and across programs.
    • Responsible for collecting, compiling, and dispersal of all program reports as required.
    • Ensure program goals and outcomes are implemented to meet contract requirements.
  • Attend community and other program related meetings as required:
    • Establish working relationships with community agencies such as WorkSource Development Council, Housing Authorities, Snohomish County Human Services, etc.

    • Develop strategies for increased housing opportunities.

  • Perform other work-related duties as assigned.
  • IRIS/HMIS – The leader is expected to develop proficiency in maintaining accurate client records in IRIS/HMIS, the client tracking software application used by programs throughout the agency. Proficiency includes entry of data into the client record, the editing of information as needed, and the printing of reports within IRIS/HMIS.

This position requires the employee to work in an environment where there may be exposure to blood, bodily fluids, and other potentially infectious materials. Other exposures could include cleaning supplies, chemicals involved in pest control, paint, and other materials used in building maintenance. Working conditions may include interruptions and interactions with angry persons.

PeopleTec is currently seeking a Mid-Level Test Engineer/Analyst to support our Huntsville, AL location.

We are seeking a motivated test engineer/analyst to join a well-established team supporting the development, test, and fielding of a tactical missile defense system. The selected candidate will work in an AVMC laboratory environment with real-time hardware-in-the-loop (HWIL) systems, tactical software and hardware, and digital representations of complex missile defense systems.

This is a full-time, on-site position at a Government customer location. The selected candidate will support multiple technical efforts involving missile defense performance analysis, modeling and simulation (M&S), post-flight reconstruction, integration, and risk-reduction activities.

Duties:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining analysis tools supporting missile defense system and algorithm performance assessment

  • Performing complex analysis of missile defense system behavior, test data, and algorithm performance

  • Developing and maintaining test cases to support software integration and system integration activities

  • Supporting real-time HWIL testing using tactical software, hardware, and digital system representations

  • Applying systems engineering principles, concepts, and methods to analyze technical problems and develop practical solutions

  • Analyzing, documenting, and communicating test results through software and hardware test reports

  • Developing system requirements that support required system functionality

  • Supporting performance analysis, M&S, post-flight reconstruction, integration, and risk-reduction efforts as assigned

  • Preparing reports and briefings that clearly communicate complex system behavior, technical findings, risks, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Collaborating with Government customers, engineers, analysts, and test personnel across multiple concurrent efforts

Qualifications

Required Skills/Experience:

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant engineering, analysis, test, or systems engineering experience

  • Direct operational or test experience with the **Integrated Battle Command System (IBCS)**

  • Proficiency in data manipulation and analysis, data visualization, signal and data processing, electromagnetics, and/or systems engineering using MATLAB or similar tools

  • Ability to identify and analyze technical problems, conduct research, summarize results, and develop appropriate recommendations

  • Ability to develop and contribute to technical reports and briefings for a broad range of audiences

title: Web Architect & Data Platform Engineer
description:
At uniQure, we are delivering on the promise of gene therapy and delivering hope for patients facing urgent unmet medical needs. Every role in our organization carries profound purpose; whether you're in research, operations, access, or support, your contributions impact patients. We're seeking passionate professionals who thrive in high-stakes environments, uphold rigorous quality standards, and share our relentless commitment to transforming the lives of patients. Join us in making the impossible possible, where your expertise becomes a catalyst for life-changing treatments.

Position Overview

As Web Architect & Data Platform Engineer, you own the technical architecture of uniQure's websites and web applications and act as uniQure's data platform engineer. You do not need to build the websites yourself — external agencies handle the day-to-day build work — but you set the technical direction, act as the agencies' primary sparring partner on architecture, technology choices, and best practices, and hold them accountable for delivering maintainable, secure, and performant work. Once an agency's work is delivered, you review it, guide the agency toward proper development practices, and are hands‑on enough to fix smaller issues yourself rather than waiting on a change request.

On the data side, you will develop and maintain uniQure's Data Platform, built on Microsoft Fabric, including its Lakehouse layers. You will build and maintain data pipelines using Spark, Python and SQL to turn data from across the business into reliable, reusable assets. Occasionally build Power BI reports directly for the business where needed.

Beyond the data platform and web architecture, you will act as a general application engineer within IT, working on data and process integration and scripting work across the organization. Building and maintaining data integration pipelines with an architectural mindset, connecting systems and data sources.

AI is a core part of this role. You will use AI tools to develop faster and more effectively across web, data and application engineering work. A solid understanding of how these AI tools and models actually work is important.

You will also review, refactor and harden code written by colleagues, agencies, vendors, or generated with AI, so that it is production ready and coherent with uniQure's existing architecture — this applies as much to the websites and portals delivered by external agencies as it does to internal data and integration work.

The Web Architect & Data Platform Engineer will be positioned in the IT team of uniQure. You will align with our Architects and our Application Management team to fulfill needs of our colleagues, and you will be the main internal point of contact for the external agencies responsible for building and maintaining uniQure's websites. Further you will have direct contact with the relevant business departments where the need for Data Analytics or web development comes from.

Key Result Areas (major Duties, Accountabilities And Responsibilities)

  • Build out the Data Platform on Microsoft Fabric, so uniQure's data is captured, structured, and usable in the Lakehouse.
  • Bring new data sources into Data Platform as new systems or business questions come up, without creating one-off, unmaintainable pipelines.
  • Step in on Power BI report building when a business team needs a hand getting a report off the ground.
  • Build and maintain the integrations that connect various internal systems. Take on integration, scripting, and automation work across IT, wherever a gap between systems needs bridging.
  • Bring an architectural view to how new applications and integrations fit into uniQure's existing systems, rather than solving each request in isolation.
  • Own the technical architecture and roadmap for uniQure's websites and web applications, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across every site built by external agencies.
  • Act as the primary technical sparring partner for uniQure's web development agencies, reviewing proposed architecture, technology stack, and implementation approach before and during development.
  • Manage and guide the agencies delivering website work, holding them to proper development practices — code quality, performance, accessibility, and security — and to uniQure's architectural standards.
  • Perform hands-on fixes and small changes to live websites once agency work is delivered, without needing to route every minor change back to the agency.
  • Use AI tools as part of daily development work, understanding how they work well enough to use them effectively, driving efficiency not only to your own work but company as a whole.
  • Review, refactor, and harden code written by colleagues, vendors, or AI tools before it reaches production.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for external suppliers on integration, portal, and website work, checking their delivery is sound and fits uniQure's architecture.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience with Python, SQL, JS, and modern web technologies (e.g. HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks).
  • Experience with, or strong interest in, data engineering and integrations.
  • A strong, hands-on background in full-stack web development and web architecture, with the ability to evaluate, challenge, and guide the technical choices made by external agencies.
  • Experience managing or closely directing external agencies or vendors on website or software development projects.
  • Clear problem-solving skills and an architectural way of thinking about how systems connect.
  • Experience in an international organization.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, or other cloud data platforms (Azure, Databricks, Synapse).
  • Power BI report building experience.
  • Experience with Workato, or similar tools, for integrations.
  • Broader Azure experience beyond Fabric (e.g. Azure DevOps, App Services, Storage).
  • Familiarity with using AI coding tools (e.g. Copilot, Claude Code) in real development work.
  • Experience reviewing code from others, including vendors or external developers.
  • Experience with content management systems (e.g. WordPress, Umbraco, Sitecore) or headless CMS/website hosting platforms.
  • Familiarity with web performance, SEO, accessibility (WCAG), and security best practices (e.g. OWASP) for public-facing websites.
  • Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices for web application delivery.
  • Five or more years of experience in IT and business, Pharmaceutical or Biotech industry.
  • Excellent analytical, strategic conceptual thinking, and execution skills.
  • Well organized and detail oriented.
  • Ability to multi-task.
  • Experience managing SoX and/or GxP compliant systems.
