title: Criminal Justice Sessional Recovery Coordinator
description:
Overview

Change Grow Live (CGL) are a charity dedicated to the belief that we can make a difference to our Service Users lives.

Our core values are ‘Be open, be compassionate and be bold’ and our teams apply these daily offering support and respect in a safe environment, treating each user as an individual and working with them to find the right treatment and care options.

Recovery Intervention Service Ealing (RISE) is an integrated end-to-end treatment and recovery service which offers a wide range of pharmacological and psychosocial interventions to Ealing residents 18 years and over to their families and significant others who are experiencing issues with drugs and/or alcohol use. RISE is a consortium, with CGL being the lead contractor, and includes Central and North West London NHS Mental Health Trust (CNWL) and two service user led organizations and Build on Belief (BOB).

An exciting opportunity has arisen within Change Grow Live Ealing RISE for an enthusiastic, dedicated and outcome focused Criminal Justice Recovery Worker to join our successful Criminal Justice team on a Sessional basis.

We’re looking for a committed professional to support individuals with substance use needs. Many of our clients face additional challenges such as neurodevelopmental conditions, learning disabilities, unstable housing, poor health, safeguarding concerns, and limited support networks.

You’ll manage a dedicated caseload and work flexibly across the community, offering assertive outreach and in-reach support in diverse settings — from GP surgeries and mental health services to substance misuse hubs and supported accommodation.

This is a flexible, hands-on role suited to someone resilient, empathetic, and motivated to drive change where it matters.

Contract Type: Sessional

Hours: Ad Hoc / 0

Location: Ealing

Responsibilities

About the role:

  • Supporting service users from point of entry into the service and through their treatment/recovery journey
  • Providing screening, assessment, and recovery planning and onward referral
  • Reducing drug and alcohol related harm to service users and the wider community
  • Promoting carer, service user and community involvement
  • Providing advocacy for access to partnership services
  • Working with service users to support social (re)integration, enabling them to lead meaningful and purposeful lives: promoting recovery, resilience, peer support and self-determination
  • Research, design and prepare subject matter and materials for groups / pods.
  • Deliver structured content within group settings to service users at various stages of recovery.
  • Engage with debriefing and evaluations with co-facilitators after groups/pods have taken place, reviewing progress and identifying concerns with service users.
  • Tailor specific workshops around the needs of the service users, such as: anger management, sleep disorders, relationships, etc

About you:

  • Have a strong understanding of substance misuse issues and experience of working within a similar field.
  • Experience of working with groups/pods and managing group dynamics, such as conflict or challenging behaviour.
  • Be an excellent communicator, both verbal and written with good IT skills.
  • Proactive and able to work on own initiative with excellent time management and prioritising skills.
  • Have a good working knowledge of mental health interventions, services, and good practice.
  • Be a supportive team player with strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work in partnership with a wide range of professionals, agencies, and internal/external stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage change successfully in a way that prioritises the needs of service users.
  • Understand the importance of information governance processes and commit to follow and apply all necessary safeguards.
  • Seek out learning opportunities to improve and broaden your professional knowledge and skills and to contribute and oversee the learning and development of others.

title: Travel Management Specialist
description:
Opportunity

PeopleTec is currently seeking a Travel Management Specialist to support our Huntsville, AL location.

The Travel Management Specialist will serve as a senior specialist in analyzing Defense Travel System (DTS) and official Government travel support to the Portfolio Acquisition Executive Fires (PAE Fires) Payroll and Travel Office to include supporting the final travel document reviews for multiple O6 Project Offices within the Program Management Executive (PME) for both Offensive and Defensive Fires. The position will be responsible for reviewing travel authorizations and vouchers, identifying discrepancies, maintaining traveler information, verifying compliance with the Joint Travel Regulations (JTR), Dept of Army travel policies, PAE Fires business rules, and providing recurring customer support to both civilian and military PAE Fires personnel that are involved with travel.

Duties:

Travel Authorization Review

  • Review DTS travel authorizations for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable Federal, DoD, Army, and Joint Travel Regulations.
  • Review travel dates, destinations, itineraries, purpose of travel, and estimated expenses.
  • Verify that required supporting documentation and Exception to Travel (ETP) are attached to travel authorizations.
  • Review transportation arrangements, including airfare, rail, POV mileage, rental vehicles, taxis, rideshare, parking, and tolls.
  • Review lodging selections and identify potential lodging rates or authorization issues.
  • Review requests for actual expense reimbursement and required supporting justification.
  • Verify and identify missing, incomplete, or potentially incorrect LOAs and coordinate corrections with appropriate Government personnel.
  • Identify discrepancies and return travel authorizations to travelers for correction when appropriate.
  • Conduct quality-control reviews before authorizations proceed to Government Approving Officials (AO).

Travel Voucher Review

  • Review DTS vouchers for accuracy and completeness prior to Government certification.
  • Compare actual travel expenses against the approved travel authorization.
  • Review lodging expenses and receipts for accuracy and completeness.
  • Review transportation expenses and supporting documentation.
  • Review rental vehicle, fuel, parking, toll, taxi, rideshare, and other reimbursable expenses.
  • Review meals and incidental expenses (M&IE) for accuracy.
  • Review travel dates and actual itinerary against the approved authorization.
  • Verify required receipts and supporting documentation are uploaded to DTS.
  • Verify that the appropriate LOA is present and properly associated with the voucher.
  • Identify discrepancies between authorization and voucher information.
  • Return deficient vouchers to travelers for correction and resubmission.
  • Maintain records of recurring voucher deficiencies and trends.

Traveler Profile Management and Lines of Accounting/Cross Org Management

  • Review and maintain traveler profiles in DTS.
  • Verify traveler contact information, organizational information, and other required profile data.
  • Identify outdated, incomplete, or inaccurate traveler profile information.
  • Assist travelers with updating profile information.
  • Coordinate required profile changes with DTS administrators and appropriate Government personnel.
  • Support traveler profile updates resulting from organizational realignments, personnel transfers, onboarding, and other organizational changes.
  • Verify that required Lines of Accounting are included in DTS travel authorizations and vouchers.
  • Identify missing, inactive, incomplete, or potentially incorrect LOAs.
  • Coordinate LOA discrepancies with designated Government financial, budget, resource management, or FDTA personnel.

Customer Service and Traveler Assistance

  • Provide professional customer service to PAE Fires military and civilian travelers.
  • Respond to traveler questions concerning DTS authorizations, vouchers, receipts, profiles, and supporting documentation.
  • Assist travelers in understanding and correcting identified deficiencies.
  • Coordinate complex or unresolved issues with the PAE Fires Payroll and Travel Office.
  • Communicate effectively with travelers, Authorizing Officials, Certifying Officials, DTS administrators, and other Government personnel.
  • Track customer inquiries and unresolved issues as required.
  • Conduct quality-control reviews of completed travel authorizations and vouchers.
  • Identify recurring errors and deficiencies across PAE Fires organizations.
  • Monitor travel documents for completeness, accuracy, and timely processing.
  • Identify potential duplicate claims, unsupported expenses, and documentation deficiencies.
  • Conduct periodic sampling of completed travel documents as directed.
  • Document review findings and corrective actions.
  • Recommend improvements to travel processing procedures and internal controls.

Travel Tracking and Reporting

  • Maintain travel tracking tools and databases for assigned travel documents.
  • Track authorization and voucher status from initial review through completion.
  • Monitor outstanding and aging travel documents.
  • Track documents returned to travelers for correction.
  • Maintain records of identified deficiencies and corrective actions.
  • Prepare recurring travel status reports and management metrics.
  • Identify trends and provide recommendations to improve travel processing.

Policy and Procedure Support

  • Stay current on applicable Federal, DoD, Army, and Joint Travel Regulations and PAE Fires travel procedures.
  • Assist with developing traveler training materials and job aids.
  • Assist the PAE Fires Payroll and Travel Office with internal travel reviews and audits.
  • Identify potential compliance issues and elevate them to appropriate Government personnel.
  • Maintain documentation supporting completed reviews.
  • Assist with identifying corrective actions resulting from audits or quality-control reviews.

Organizational Transition Support

  • Assist with DTS travel support during organizational realignments and transitions.
  • Support traveler profile updates associated with personnel transfers and organizational changes.
  • Support DTS administration during Transfer of Function activities and other PAE Fires organizational transitions.
  • Assist with identifying travelers who require updates to profiles, routing, LOAs, or other travel-related information.

Security and Information Protection

  • Protect Personally Identifiable Information (PII), financial information, and other sensitive Government information.
  • Follow applicable Army, DoD, and Federal cybersecurity and information protection requirements.
  • Maintain confidentiality of traveler and financial information.

Qualifications

Required Skills/Experience:

  • 3-5 years MINIMUM of related travel reviewer experience with the Defense Travel System
  • Extensive hands-on experience utilizing the Defense Travel System (DTS) and an in-depth working knowledge of the Joint Travel Regulations (JTR).
  • Proven ability to perform and thrive in a highly dynamic, fast-paced work environment supporting a high OPTEMPO military or government organization.
  • Prior experience supporting an Army Project Office or similar command-level organization.
  • High degree of professionalism and strict attention to detail, specifically regarding financial accuracy and regulatory compliance.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, SharePoint) and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to clearly brief leadership and effectively assist travelers across all ranks and grades.
  • Travel: Less than 10% in the Continental United States (CONUS)
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen
  • An active DoD Secret clearance is required to perform this work. Candidates are required to have an active Secret clearance upon hire, and the ability to maintain this level of clearance during their employment.

Education Requirements:

  • High School diploma and DTS experience in a DoD program/project office environment is required.

Desired Skills:

  • Demonstrated ability to resolve complex travel routing, funding, and ticketing issues under tight deadlines.
  • Dependable self-starter with strong interpersonal skills, capable of multitasking and prioritizing assignments effectively both independently and within a team environment

Overview

People First. Technology Always.

PeopleTec, Inc. is an employee-owned small business founded in Huntsville, AL that provides exceptional customer support by employing and retaining a highly skilled workforce.

Culture: The name "PeopleTec" was deliberately chosen to remind us of our core value system - our people. Our company's foundation was built on placing our employees and customers first. title: Application Integration SME
description:
Responsibilities

Technica Corporation is seeking highly skilled Application Integration SME who is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining data integration pipelines that connect Microsoft Dataverse and the Power Platform with internal and external systems. This role focuses on ensuring reliable, secure, and performant data migration and integration across cloud and on-premises environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain data integration and migration pipelines between Dataverse/Power Platform and disparate source and target systems (on-premises, cloud, and SaaS)
  • Build and orchestrate ETL/ELT processes using Azure Data Factory, SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), and Power Apps/Power Platform Dataflows
  • Develop and support integration flows using Power Automate, including scheduled, triggered, and event-driven workflows
  • Design, consume, and expose REST APIs and web services to enable bi-directional data exchange between Dataverse and external systems
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot the On-Premises Data Gateway to enable secure connectivity between cloud services and on-premises data sources
  • Perform data profiling, cleansing, mapping, and transformation activities to ensure data quality and integrity throughout migration and integration processes
  • Develop and maintain error handling, logging, alerting, and monitoring for all integration pipelines to ensure reliability and rapid issue resolution
  • Collaborate with solution architects, functional consultants, and business stakeholders to gather integration requirements and translate them into technical designs
  • Document data flows, integration architecture, mapping specifications, and operational runbooks
  • Participate in data migration planning and execution for new Dataverse implementations, including extraction, transformation, validation, and load activities
  • Optimize integration performance, including throughput, latency, and API/service protection limits within Dataverse and connected systems
  • Support testing efforts including unit, integration, and user acceptance testing for data migration and integration solutions
  • Apply security and compliance best practices for data in transit and at rest, including credential/secrets management and role-based access control
  • Provide production support and troubleshooting for integration failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues
  • Stay current with Microsoft Power Platform, Dataverse, and Azure integration service updates and recommend improvements to existing solutions

The position would be located at a government facility in Washington, D.C. and require work to be performed onsite. Any hybrid work schedule would require customer approval. The government has established policies for on-site vs hybrid work which varies across divisions and contracts. Where allowed, remote work must be coordinated with the team lead and/or government POC, ensuring there is zero interruption with the delivery of our services.

The annual base salary range for this position is $107,000 – $143,000. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. Technica considers factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, location, as well as market and business considerations when extending an offer.

Requirements

  • Active Top-Secret with SCI and CI Poly eligibility
  • Bachelor’s degree in IT Technology or related field or equivalent education and/or experience.
  • 8 years of related experience
  • 5 years of experience in data engineering, data migration, or systems integration roles
  • Demonstrated experience integrating and migrating data into/out of Microsoft Dataverse and Power Platform
  • Hands-on experience with Power Automate for building integration and orchestration workflows
  • Hands-on experience with Power Apps/Platform Dataflows
  • Hands-on ETL experience with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)
  • Hands-on experience with pipeline orchestration/data movement in Azure Data Factory
  • Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting REST APIs for system-to-system integration
  • Experience configuring and maintaining the On-Premises Data Gateway
  • Strong proficiency in SQL (query optimization, relational database design)
  • Solid understanding of Dataverse data model, entity relationships, and Power Platform security model (business units, security roles, teams)
  • Experience with data mapping, transformation logic, and data quality validation techniques
  • Familiarity with authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, Azure AD/Entra ID app registrations, service principals)
  • Strong analytical/troubleshooting skills; ability to diagnose complex data/integration issues
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; technical design documentation for technical and non-technical audiences

Desired

  • Microsoft certifications such as PL-400, PL-600, DP-600, DP-203, or AZ-204
  • Azure Logic Apps and/or Azure Functions for custom integration logic experience
  • Dataverse virtual tables/entities and virtual connectors experience
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Dataverse short-term retention, or Azure Synapse Link for Dataverse
  • Experience with source control and CI/CD practices (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of message-based/event-driven integration patterns (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, webhooks)
  • Experience with API management platforms
  • Familiarity with data governance, master data management, and data retention/archival practices
  • Experience in integrating Power Platform with ERP or CRM systems
  • Working knowledge of C#/.NET or PowerShell for custom connectors, plug-ins, or automation scripting
  • Experience with Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) for Power Platform solutions (managed/unmanaged solutions, environment strategy)
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tooling (Application Insights, Azure Monitor)

Overview

About Technica:

At Technica Corporation, our goal is to provide exceptional professional services and innovative technology solutions that meet or exceed our customer’s expectations. We specialize in a wide range of advanced information technology solutions from Systems Engineering to Cyber Security, and from Software Development to Product Solutions. From our locations across the DC Metro area, Hampton, Virginia, and Huntsville, Alabama, we provide technological subject matter expertise, program management and business process knowledge as a trusted advisor in support of our Department of Defense and other Federal Agency customers.

title: Seasonal Mechanical Assembly Operator
description:
About Kinematics

Kinematics creates motion control solutions for mission-critical systems in demanding environments. Based in the U.S. with global operations, we reliably deliver on diverse customer needs and have the manufacturing expertise to deliver any volume cost effectively.

For close to three decades, we have been innovating solutions and working closely with our customers to provide the most reliable, bankable, innovative drives across multiple industries. Today, with over 2 million drives globally deployed, representing hundreds of millions of hours of operation, we are proud of our role in sustainably supporting critical applications across the industrial, satellite and solar sectors.

Kinematics was founded in 1996, has 400 employees globally, is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ, with sales offices in North America and Europe, and manufacturing operations in Jiangyin, China and Nogales, Mexico.

The Mechanical Assembly Operator is responsible for assembly, required testing, registration and packaging of the finished product. This individual will report to the Production Supervisor in the Manufacturing department.


Position Status: Temporary. Full-time, Hourly

Location: Phoenix, Arizona 85027

Work Hours:

Week 1 – Monday – Thursday 3:30 pm – 1:00 am and Friday 2:30 pm – 11:00 pm

Week 2 – Monday – Thursday 3:30 pm – 1:00 am and Friday off

Salary: $18 an hour

· Comply with the defined production standards following the production plan.

· Record data resulting from the tests carried out on the product.

· Notifies production manager or quality personnel of irregularities in the manufacturing process, product or safety hazards as they happen.

· Competency in operating handheld barcode scanners, tablets, and Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) to log data.

· Ability to quickly add, subtract, and count stock to ensure absolute inventory accuracy.

title: Real-World Cyberspace Operations (CO) Planner
description:
Responsibilities

The USFK Joint Cyberspace Center (JCC) provides and maintains a leading-edge cyberspace operations capability directly supporting Combined Forces Command (CFC), United Nations Command (UNC), and USFK Command and Control (C2) networks.

  • As a Real-World Cyberspace Operations Planner, you will develop command guidance, prioritize operational recommendations, and integrate cyberspace operations with Combatant Commands (CCMDs), Joint Task Forces, and Mission Tailored Force Packages.
  • Coordinate and establish joint operation planning objectives and Mission Essential Tasks (METs) in support of the Theater Campaign Plan (TCP), Theater Campaign Order (TCO), Armistice, competition, combat, and contingency operations.
  • Draft cyberspace appendices and annexes to major planning documents, focusing heavily on Northeast Asian threats, nation-states, and Malicious Cyberspace Actors (MAC).
  • Collaborate with USFK staff and subordinate units to consolidate cyberspace requirements, including Requests for Forces (RFF) and Requests for Support (RFS). Interface with USINDOPACOM, USCYBERCOM, and other CCMDs to ensure support requirements are appropriately captured.
  • Coordinate with the USFK staff to ensure METs and Joint Mission Essential Tasks (JMETs) are updated for monthly input into the Defense Readiness Reporting System (DRRS).
  • Develop and update Crisis Action Standard Operating Procedures (CASOPs) for the JCC and CFC Cyberspace Coordination Cell (4C), as well as general cyber operation SOPs.
  • Provide expert input to briefings, transition strategic concepts to tactical execution, and assist in coordinating joint operational planning for training and exercises.
  • Prepare for and active participate in the Command’s Tabletop Exercises, Wargames, Combined Arms Rehearsals (CARs), and Exercise Rehearsal of Concept (ROC) Drills.
  • Prepare for and host the organization's weekly Projects and Plans meeting. Coordinate planning across higher, lower, adjacent, and multinational (coalition) headquarters.
  • Work to integrate Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) tools into the Combined Joint All-Domain Tasking Order (CJADTO) framework to enhance situational awareness, predictive analysis, and decision support.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • 2 years with BS/BA; 0 years with MS/MA; 6 years with no degree.
  • Must possess an active TS/SCI security clearance.
  • U.S. citizenship required. Must possess or obtain a baseline certification in compliance with the DoD Cyber Workforce Framework (8570/8140) within six (6) months of hire.
  • Must have successfully completed or be able to successfully complete one of the following within six (6) months of hire:
    • Joint Cyberspace Operations Planners Course (JCOPC)
    • A service-specific equivalent planner course
  • Demonstrated understanding and wide application of principles, theories, and concepts within cyberspace operations
  • Preferred Qualifications:
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and delivering General Officer/Flag Officer (GO/FO) level briefings, position papers, and white papers.
  • Experience drafting official military correspondence, including executive Information Papers, White Papers, Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs), Memorandums of Agreement (MOAs), and Memorandums for Record (MFRs) for senior leadership
  • Prior experience coordinating plans with multinational coalition partners, specifically the Republic of Korea (ROK) military forces.

title: Instructional Assistant - Special Education, Pre-K Special Assignment
description:
Overview

POSITION TITLE (Oracle title)

INSTRUCTIONAL ASSISTANT-SPECIAL EDUCATION

WORKING TITLE

Special Education Instructional Assistant-General Curriculum

Special Education Instructional Assistant-Adapted Curriculum

Special Assignment Instructional Assistant (SAIA)

SCHOOL/DEPARTMENT

Elementary, Middle, or High School

LOCATION

School Site

PAY GRADE

Noncertified Grade 21

FLSA STATUS

Nonexempt

ELIGIBILITY FOR EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT

No

WORK WEEK SCHEDULE

Monday-Friday (occasional evenings and weekends/ Workday must not exceed more than 40 hours per week and begins at least 30 minutes prior to the instructional day for students.)

POSITION PURPOSE:

Provides support and assists in coordinating instructional programs relating to special education students and their Individual Education Plans (IEP). Monitors programs with students with disabilities, maintains confidentiality, and complies with all federal, state, and local laws, regulations, guidelines, and procedures as they relate to the special education program throughout the district. Maintains an environment conducive to learning.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

(See Education and Training for requirements for TITLE I schools)

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (KSAs)

  • Considerable knowledge of Microsoft Office, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point; Google Apps;

  • Working knowledge of successful instructional delivery methods;

  • Working knowledge of general classroom activities and routines;

  • Ability to protect the confidentiality of personally identifiable information in accordance with the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act of 1974 (FERPA) and other applicable federal and state laws, policies, and regulations;

  • Ability to work in a team environment and effectively collaborate with others;

  • Ability to motivate students;

  • Ability to constantly monitor and supervise the safety and well-being of students;

  • Ability to recognize and support students with a variety of backgrounds, abilities, exceptionalities, behavioral needs, and learning styles;

  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely both in oral and written form using a variety of communication techniques and tools to ensure the appropriate flow of information, collaborative efforts, and feedback;

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with school system staff, students, parents, businesses, community agencies, and the public.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE ALL SCHOOLS

  • High school diploma or GED.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE IF TITLE I SCHOOL

  • Meet the employment requirements outlined by the Every Student Succeeds Act (ESSA), Pub.L. 114-95, AND have one of the following:

    • Six documented semester hours of coursework in early childhood education, OR

    • Two years of work experience in an early childhood setting.

CERTIFICATION AND LICENSE REQUIREMENTS

  • Maintain a Crisis Prevention and Intervention (CPI) certification and maintain that certification through the proper renewal process, adhering to all timelines; CPI training will be provided through Wake County Public School System (WCPSS), if needed.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • CPR and First Aid certification;

  • Experience working with or assisting individuals with special needs (an individual with one or more difficulties such as, a physical, emotional, behavioral, or learning disability or impairment that causes an individual to require additional or specialized services or accommodations).

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides support and assistance to teachers in coordinating instructional programs for special education students, including familiarity with student’s IEP; ensures an encouraging, caring, safe, and healthful environment for all students.

  • Assists teachers with strategies related to the implementation of students’ behavioral intervention plans.

  • Aids teachers with planning and organizing, evaluating instructional activities, developing classroom procedures, and preparing necessary materials; ensures materials for students are readily available according to the needs of the lesson plan.

  • Demonstrates professional and technical skills necessary to function effectively in the classroom and to support student achievement and the school program.

  • Maintains a positive disposition, exercises good judgement, and remains calm when dealing with students at all times.

  • Provides in-class support while promoting progress towards independence and self-determination for all students.

  • Assists teachers with implementation of low- and high-tech assistive technology and augmentative communication devices in the classroom to meet both class-wide and individual student needs.

  • Compiles, maintains, and files reports, records, and other required documents, maintaining confidentiality.

  • Participates in the district staff development program and continued professional growth in the area of assignment.

  • Coordinates, assists, and facilitates student transitions between classes; assists students by providing for special health care needs, which could include:

  • Personal hygiene, restroom functions, diapering, etc.;

  • Mobility assistance including lifting, positioning or transferring student;

  • Activities related to seizure control;

  • Feeding needs;

  • Adaptive equipment needs such as wheelchairs, crutches, prosthetic devices, orthotic devices, hearing aids, braille, assistive listening devices (ADL), and augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) devices;

  • Behavioral assistance and CPI skills.

  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES-SATA Only:

  • Assigned to be a one-on-one instructional assistant to a student who has severe to profound learning disabilities.

  • Attends and successfully completes specialized training, as determined by student’s IEP.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a classroom environment and requires sitting and standing throughout the day. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, scanners, and copiers. The position, at times, must be able to come into direct contact with school system staff, staff members of external funding agencies, and the community. Work is considered medium physical work, requiring the exertion of up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 25 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. School can contact the school’s Physical Therapist for assistance, if needed, for proper lifting techniques.

EFFECTIVE DATE: 3/2025

DISCLAIMER: The above statements are intended to describe the general purpose and responsibilities assigned to this position. They are not intended to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required by the employees assigned to this position. This description may be revised by HR and approved at any time.

title: Mid-Level Exportability Engineer
description:
Opportunity

PeopleTec is currently seeking a Mid-Level Exportability Engineer to support our Huntsville, AL location.

The candidate will serve as a Mid-Level Exportability Engineer within a Project Management Office (PMO) within PAE Fires and will be responsible for providing technical support to the program's Chief Engineer and the Product Manager. The candidate will be responsible for the technical suitability, feasibility, and requirements analysis for integrating exportability features into advanced defense systems. The candidate will bridge system architecture with Technology Security and Foreign Disclosure (TSFD) policy, performing the engineering assessments required to protect U.S. technologies (Anti-Tamper) while defining viable configurations for allied partners, and will provide technical expertise to help stand up, scope, and evaluate new DEF studies for future programs entering the exportability pipeline. The candidate will prepare and present exportability engineering findings, reports, and improvement plans to senior management and stakeholders. Will work within and/or lead a multidisciplinary team to achieve program goals. Perform other tasks as assigned by the Chief Engineer and/or Product Manager.

The candidate will be required to interface with internal PMs across PAE Fires and external organizations to include HQDA, ASA(ALT), OUSD(A&S), NIPO, DASA-DEC, SAF/IA, ATEC, AMCOM, and others for coordination and synchronization of exportability engineering technical and programmatic objectives.

Duties:

  • Provide technical support and leadership in exportability engineering across the system lifecycle (design, development, acquisition, integration, testing, fielding, and sustainment).
  • Conduct comprehensive audits of baseline system architectures to identify Critical Program Information (CPI), advanced algorithms, and cutting-edge hardware susceptible to reverse engineering.
  • Assist in standing up additional DEF studies by conducting preliminary technical evaluations, defining initial engineering task scope, and estimating the technical feasibility of export modifications for new weapon systems.
  • Investigate and define high-level conceptual approaches for protecting sensitive technologies, including strategies for system modularity that allow hardware substitution or software modulation in export variants.
  • Architect conceptual export variants based on TSFD assessments, and evaluate these variants to ensure they meet required performance metrics while satisfying U.S. export security criteria.
  • Use modeling and simulation to assess how proposed DEF modifications, such as altered guidance code or added AT hardware, will impact a system's baseline kinematic performance, weight, and operational lethality.
  • Draft validated CPI and Critical Component Matrices and High-Level AT and Modularity Strategies, and support the technical drafting of formal foreign release documentation, such as Exception to the National Disclosure Policy (ENDP) Position Papers.
  • Ensure compliance with defense and industry standards by managing exportability engineering processes effectively.
  • Interface with internal teams and external organizations to coordinate exportability engineering objectives and strategies.
  • Prepare and present exportability engineering findings, reports, and improvement plans to senior management and stakeholders.
  • Conduct strategic planning and coordination to support program objectives.
  • Provide technical guidance and leadership to peer and subordinate engineers within the exportability engineering team.
  • Use digital tools and methodologies to manage cost, schedule, and performance for assigned activities.
  • Perform other tasks as assigned by the Chief Engineer and/or Product Manager.

Qualifications

Required Skills/Experience:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience. Additional education may be substituted for years of experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in exportability engineering, particularly within defense or aerospace industries.
  • Working knowledge of Anti-Tamper (AT) principles, reverse engineering mitigation, and Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA).
  • Experience with complex weapon systems, Counter-UAS (C-UAS) architectures, or advanced sensor/seeker integration.
  • Proficiency with modeling and simulation tools used to assess kinematics and system performance impacts.
  • Ability to translate complex TSFD and security requirements into actionable hardware and software engineering designs.
  • Strong knowledge of industry standards and defense requirements.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to lead and work within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Previous experience working in a U.S. Government Program Office (required).
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • An active DoD clearance: Secret, with the ability to obtain TS/SCI.

Education Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Overview

People First. Technology Always.

PeopleTec, Inc. is an employee-owned small business founded in Huntsville, AL that provides exceptional customer support by employing and retaining a highly skilled workforce.

Culture: The name "PeopleTec" was deliberately chosen to remind us of our core value system - our people. Our company's foundation was built on placing our employees and customers first. With an award-winning atmosphere, we have matured into a company that boasts the best and brightest across multiple technical fields.

Career: At PeopleTec, we value your long-term goals. Whether it's through our continuing-education opportunities, our robust training programs, or our "People First" benefits package, PeopleTec truly believes that our best investments are our people.

Come Experience It.

The position is also accountable for the quality of workers’ compensation claim services as perceived by CCMSI clients and within our corporate claim standards.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate, evaluate and adjust workers’ compensation claims in accordance with established claim handling standards and laws.
  • Establish reserves and/or provide reserve recommendations within established reserve authority levels.
  • Review, approve or provide oversight of medical, legal, damage estimates and miscellaneous invoices to determine if reasonable and related to designated workers’ compensation claims. Negotiate any disputed bills or invoices for resolution.
  • Authorize and make payments of workers’ compensation claims in accordance with claim procedures utilizing a claim payment program in accordance with industry standards and within established payment authority.
  • Negotiate settlements in accordance within Corporate Claim Standards, client specific handling instructions and state laws, when appropriate.
  • Assist in the selection, referral and supervision of designated workers’ compensation claim files sent to outside vendors. (i.e. legal, surveillance, case management, etc.)
  • Review and maintain personal diary on claim system.
  • Assess and monitor subrogation claims for resolution.
  • Compute disability rates in accordance with state laws.
  • Effective and timely coordination of communication with clients, claimants and other appropriate parties throughout the workers’ compensation claim adjustment process.
  • Provide notices of qualifying claims to excess/reinsurance carriers.
  • Compliance with Corporate Claim Handling Standards and special client handling instructions as established.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Initiative to set and achieve performance goals.
  • Good analytic and negotiation skills.
  • Knowledge of all lower level claim position responsibilities.
  • Must be detail oriented and a self-starter with strong organizational abilities.
  • Ability to coordinate and prioritize required.
  • Flexibility, accuracy, initiative and the ability to work with minimum supervision.
  • Discretion and confidentiality required.
  • Reliable, predictable attendance within client service hours for the performance of this position.
  • Responsive to internal and external client needs.
  • Ability to clearly communicate verbally and/or in writing both internally and externally.

Education and/or Experience

5-10 years workers’ compensation claim experience is required (if you do not meet this requirement but feel you have the proper background, please apply)

Computer Skills

Proficient with Microsoft Office programs.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

IL or TX Adjuster’s license is preferred.

AIC, ARM or CPCU Designation preferred.

CORE VALUES & PRINCIPLES

Responsible for upholding the CCMSI Core Values & Principles which include: performing with integrity; passionately focus on client service; embracing a client-centered vision; maintaining contagious enthusiasm for our clients; searching for the best ideas; looking upon change as an opportunity; insisting upon excellence; creating an atmosphere of excitement, informality and trust; focusing on the situation, issue, or behavior, not the person; maintaining the self-confidence and self-esteem of others; maintaining constructive relationships; taking the initiative to make things better; and leading by example.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience. Additional education may be substituted for years of experience.

  • Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering (or related technical discipline).

title: Lead Kotlin Backend Engineer – Remote-Friendly, Impactful
description:
Vacature: Lead Kotlin Backend Engineer

  • Wil jij werken aan een platform dat een groenere wereldondersteunt en waarin jouw technische keuzes én jouw begeleiding van mensendirect impact hebben?
  • Wil jij een FP/Kotlin-squad helpen groeien richting technische enprofessionele volwassenheid, terwijl je zelf actief meebouwt aan een modernebackend?
  • Werk je graag in een omgeving waar engineering persoonlijk is, teams compactzijn en jouw invloed vanaf de eerste dag zichtbaar is?

Dan past deze rol precies bij jou.

Jouw werkgever: een Europees platform met een sterkengineeringhart

Je komt terecht bij een middelgrote, techgerichteorganisatie met een platform dat actief is in meerdere Europese regio’s. Achterdit platform staat een Kotlin-first engineeringorganisatie die kiestvoor duurzame, betrouwbare en hoogwaardige backend-systemen.

Je werkt in een cultuur waar squads compact, betrokkenen communicatief sterk zijn. Engineers waarderen vakmanschap, helderheiden samenwerking. De organisatie draait serieuze productieomgevingen, maarblijft klein genoeg voor échte invloed: op hoe teams samenwerken, hoe servicesevolueren en hoe technisch leiderschap wordt ingevuld.

De organisatie start nu met een nieuwe fase. Na jarenbouwen en opschalen investeren ze in een sterkere technische leiderschapslaag,met nadruk op mensen, teamcohesie en langetermijnkwaliteit. Wanneer jijinstapt, help jij deze volgende groeifase vormgeven.

De balans is uitstekend: het bedrijf is remotefriendly, met slechts twee kantoordagen per maand.

Jouw rol: Lead Kotlin Backend Engineer Amsterdam

Vanaf het begin krijg je verantwoordelijkheid die ertoedoet. Samen met de andere leads en de VP Engineering bepaal je welke squad hetbeste aansluit bij jouw stijl van werken en begeleiden.

Sommige squads bestaan uit mid-level engineers die baathebben bij coaching, structuur en richting. Andere squads zijnsenior-zwaar en verwachten van jou vooral technische aansturing,systeemoverzicht en strategisch denken.

In je dagelijkse werk combineer je techniek enleiderschap op een natuurlijke manier.
Je bouwt Kotlin-services, ontwerpt event driven domain flows enscherpt service boundaries aan. Je helpt engineers beter nadenken over architectuur,betrouwbaarheid, domeinlogica en samenwerking. Je doet code-reviews,begeleidt technische beslissingen en brengt structuur aan in complexediscussies. Je helpt processen verbeteren en draagt actief bij aan een sterkeengineeringcultuur.

Daarnaast zorg je voor duidelijkheid en stabiliteitbinnen het team:
Je maakt refinements effectiever, helpt samen met product prioriteitenbepalen en creëert een omgeving waarin engineers zich gesteund voelen en deruimte hebben om te groeien. Je introduceert teamritmes die rust brengen,samenwerking versterken en zorgen voor consistentie.

Jouw invloed zie je terug in mensen, in cultuur en in dekwaliteit van het platform.
Je ontwikkelt engineers, versterkt teamdynamiek en realiseert duurzameverbeteringen door het hele systeem heen.

Dit is een rol voor iemand die twee werelden wilcombineren: diepe Kotlin/FP engineering en invloed op mensen en teams.

Wat je meebrengt

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaringin backend-engineering
  • Ervaring met het ontwerpen enbouwen van gedistribueerde backendsystemen
  • Sterke ervaring met Kotlin,Java of Scala en duidelijke interesse in FP
  • Ervaring met microservicesen event driven architecturen
  • Een productgerichte enpragmatische mindset
  • Ervaring met Docker,Kubernetes en cloud native omgevingen
  • Sterke communicatievevaardigheden en emotionele intelligentie
  • Ervaring met het begeleidenen mentoreren van software engineers
  • Vermogen om duidelijkheid,richting en structuur te brengen in een team
  • Ervaring met Arrow, Redis,Ktor en/of Meilisearch is een plus

Wat je krijgt

  • Salaris tussen €85.000 en€100.000, afhankelijk van ervaring
  • Tot 8 procent jaarbonus
  • Remote friendly:grotendeels werken vanuit huis, met slechts twee kantoordagen per maand
  • 25 vakantiedagen
  • Opleidings- en trainingsbudget
  • Goede pensioenregeling
  • Flexibele werktijden en ruimethuiswerkmogelijkheden
  • Reiskostenvergoeding
  • Kwalitatieve hardware,waaronder MacBook-opties
  • Ruimte voor cursussen,meetups, trainingen en seminars
  • Een warme, compacteengineeringcommunity waar jouw leiderschap echt het verschil maakt

Klaar om een Kotlin-squad te leiden waar jouw impactop mensen, cultuur en systemen vanaf dag één zichtbaar is?

description:

title: Cloud Windows Server / IIS System Administrator
description:
Responsibilities

Peraton's Department of Interior (DOI) CHS III program is leading the way for Cloud Hosting and Applications Modernization across DOI and its subordinate bureaus. CHS III is facilitating the migration of legacy on-premises applications to a modern, secure and scalable multi-cloud platform. From sensors in active volcanic regions to earthquake detection data, CHS III is DOI's central cloud processing and data solution.

Peraton is seeking an experienced Windows Server / IIS Administrator to join our team supporting a federal cloud hosting and enterprise architecture program for a major U.S. civilian agency. In this fully remote role, you will be responsible for the administration, maintenance, and security hardening of Microsoft Windows Server infrastructure and Internet Information Services (IIS) web environments that support mission-critical data and application delivery operations. You will work alongside a collaborative DevOps and cloud engineering team, contributing to a secure, high-availability cloud ecosystem built on AWS. This is an excellent opportunity for a systems administration professional who wants to make a real impact supporting Federal science and data programs from anywhere in the country.

Work Location: Remote

Day To Day Roles and Responsibilities

  • Administer, patch, and maintain Microsoft Windows Server environments (2016, 2019, and newer versions) within an AWS-hosted Federal cloud infrastructure
  • Configure, manage, and optimize Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS) web servers, including application pools, bindings, SSL/TLS certificates, and site-level configurations
  • Apply security hardening measures in accordance with Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), NIST SP 800-53 controls, and agency-specific security policies
  • Monitor Windows Server and IIS health, performance, and availability using enterprise observability tools (DataDog); triage and resolve incidents in alignment with defined Service Level Agreement (SLA) tiers
  • Coordinate with the DevOps engineering team on Windows-related infrastructure activities, including CI/CD pipeline integration, infrastructure-as-code (IaC) support, and automated deployment workflows
  • Support FISMA compliance activities, including vulnerability management, Information Assurance Vulnerability Alert (IAVA) remediation, and preparation of security documentation and audit artifacts
  • Respond to critical infrastructure incidents within established SLA response windows (12-hour acknowledgment for Critical/High-tier issues); participate in on-call rotation as needed
  • Maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and system documentation to support knowledge transfer and operational continuity
  • Contribute to planned maintenance window coordination, communicating impacts and scheduling downtime in advance with program leadership and Government stakeholders
  • Support onboarding and environment preparation activities to maintain Day 1 operational readiness at task order start

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree and 10 years professional experience or a Masters degree and 8 years professional experience or an Associates degree and 12 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 14 years’ professional experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft Windows Server environments (2016, 2019+) in a production setting
  • 3+ years of experience managing Microsoft IIS web servers, including application pool management, site configuration, SSL/TLS administration, and performance tuning
  • Demonstrated experience applying security configurations and STIGs to Windows Server environments in Federal or regulated environments
  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800-53 security controls and FISMA compliance requirements
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring tools (e.g., DataDog, SolarWinds, Splunk, or equivalent) for server health and availability monitoring
  • Working knowledge of AWS cloud services relevant to Windows workloads (e.g., EC2, Systems Manager, S3, CloudWatch)
  • Proficiency with PowerShell scripting for administration, automation, and configuration management tasks
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to document procedures clearly and communicate status to technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator (strongly preferred)
  • Experience in Federal civilian agency IT environments (DOI, USGS, or similar agency a plus)
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation
  • Experience integrating Windows Server patching and compliance into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions)
  • Knowledge of AWS Managed Services and hybrid cloud architectures combining on-premises Windows infrastructure with AWS-hosted workloads
  • Exposure to Agile project management environments (Jira, sprint-based workflows)
  • AWS Certified Security Specialty, CompTIA Security+, CompTIA Server+, or equivalent security certification
  • Prior experience supporting or contributing to ATO (Authority to Operate) package development or C&A activities
  • Familiarity with Section 508 accessibility requirements for web content served through IIS

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

title: ICAM Sustainment Analyst
description:
Responsibilities

ICAM Sustainment Analyst

The Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) Sustainment Analyst is responsible for ensuring the operational health, reliability, security, and continuous maintenance of enterprise ICAM systems and infrastructure. Operating at the intersection of operations, system engineering, and tier-3 technical support, this role oversees routine software updates, system patches, incident response, performance monitoring, and capacity management across core identity components. The ICAM Sustainment Analyst minimizes operational downtime, resolves complex escalated incidents, and implements continuous service improvements to maintain seamless, secure identity services across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily operations, maintenance, patch management, version upgrades, and health checks for production and non-production ICAM components across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Provide high-tier technical troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and issue remediation for critical service outages, identity synchronization failures, authentication disruptions, and certificate lifecycle issues.
  • Maintain operational availability for key identity services, including Directory Services (Active Directory, Entra ID, LDAP), Single Sign-On (SSO) gateways, Federated Identity providers (SAML, OIDC), Privileged Access Management (PAM) vaults, and Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platforms.
  • Manage operational Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) processes, including Smart Card/CAC/PIV authentication integrations, SSL/TLS certificate renewals, trust store updates, and Key Management infrastructure.
  • Monitor system performance, availability, latency, and resource utilization. Establish proactive alerting rules, metrics dashboards, and SLA tracking to ensure high availability and operational scalability.
  • Author, update, and validate operational runbooks, disaster recovery (DR) plans, failover procedures, and sustainment SOPs to ensure operational continuity and team standardization.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to track, analyze, and remediate technical vulnerabilities (IAVMs, CVEs, security baseline drift) across ICAM servers, databases, and application endpoints.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • 5 years with BS/BA; or 9 years of experience with a high school diploma.

  • Ability to obtain public trust with successful T3 investigation
  • CompTIA Security+ CE or IAT Level II baseline certification.
  • Exceptional technical troubleshooting, analytical problem-solving, and communication skills under high-pressure, incident-driven environments.
  • Local and onsite in San Antonio, Texas
  • US Citizen

Technical Expertise (Preferred):

  • Demonstrated experience sustaining core identity systems (e.g., SailPoint, Ping Identity, BeyondTrust, RadiantLogic RadiantOne, Microsoft Entra ID, or Active Directory/ADFS).
  • Practical understanding of identity protocols and standards: SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, LDAP, and PKI/X.509 certificates.
  • Hands-on experience with server administration (Windows Server, Red Hat Enterprise Linux) and web server operations (IIS, Apache, Nginx).
  • Familiarity with database operations (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) as they relate to identity stores and transaction logging.
  • Direct experience in Federal ICAM (FICAM) or DoD ICAM operational environments.
  • Scripting capability (PowerShell, Bash, Python) for operational automation, log parsing, and task orchestration.
  • Experience maintaining identity components in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud environments, including containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Hands-on professional experience operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise ICAM platforms or identity-focused infrastructure within government, defense, or enterprise environments (preferred).

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

title: Cloud & Data Engineer
description:
Cloud & Data Engineer | Hybride cloud, data engineering & AI-governance

Wil jij jouw kennis van cloud, data en AI inzetten voor projecten die écht maatschappelijke impact maken?

Voor een toonaangevende kennisorganisatie zoeken wij een Cloud & Data Engineer die onderzoekers helpt om data-, cloud- en AI-innovaties verantwoord naar de praktijk te brengen.

In deze rol werk je op het snijvlak van techniek, data governance en onderzoek. Je helpt teams om complexe data- en compute-vraagstukken te vertalen naar praktische, herbruikbare en beheerste oplossingen. Denk aan grootschalige datasets, geospatiale data, tijdsafhankelijke data, hybride cloudomgevingen en toepassingen waarbij AI en machine learning steeds vaker een rol spelen.

Je bent dus niet alleen technisch bezig, maar ook adviserend. Je denkt mee over architectuurkeuzes, helpt bij prototypes en proof-of-concepts en zorgt ervoor dat oplossingen uiteindelijk veilig, reproduceerbaar en goed beheersbaar kunnen doorgroeien richting productie.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • adviseren over cloud- en data-architecturen binnen een hybride/multi-cloud landschap;
  • ontwerpen en realiseren van data pipelines en API-integraties;
  • werken met Python en libraries zoals pandas, xarray en geopandas;
  • bouwen van prototypes en proof-of-concepts die kunnen doorgroeien naar productie;
  • meedenken over containerisatie, CI/CD en operationalisatie;
  • inrichten van metadata, dataclassificatie, toegang en datakwaliteit;
  • toepassen van FAIR-principes en data governance in de praktijk;
  • borgen van herleidbaarheid en reproduceerbaarheid rondom AI/ML-toepassingen;
  • samenwerken met onderzoekers, DevOps engineers, data stewards en andere specialisten.

Je hoeft niet alles al volledig te beheersen. Leervermogen, nieuwsgierigheid en het vermogen om techniek praktisch toepasbaar te maken zijn minstens zo belangrijk.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die zich prettig voelt in een rol waarin je zowel adviseert als zelf bouwt. Iemand die techniek begrijpt, maar ook goed kan schakelen met onderzoekers en stakeholders.

Daarnaast neem je bij voorkeur mee:

  • HBO+/WO werk- en denkniveau;
  • minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring in data engineering;
  • sterke Python-vaardigheden, bijvoorbeeld met pandas, xarray en geopandas;
  • ervaring met cloudplatformen, bij voorkeur in hybride of multi-cloud omgevingen;
  • kennis van data governance, metadata, FAIR-principes en datakwaliteit;
  • affiniteit met AI/ML en onderwerpen als reproduceerbaarheid, model lifecycle en monitoring.

Ervaring met Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD of deployment is mooi meegenomen. Domeinkennis rondom environmental monitoring, water, ondergrond of Earth observation is een pré, maar geen harde eis.

Waarom is dit interessant?

Dit is een rol voor iemand die graag aan complexe technische vraagstukken werkt, maar ook wil begrijpen waar de techniek uiteindelijk voor wordt ingezet. Je werkt aan oplossingen die bijdragen aan onderzoek, innovatie en maatschappelijke thema’s rondom een leefbare en klimaatbestendige omgeving.

Je komt terecht in een multidisciplinaire omgeving waar veel ruimte is om te pionieren, standaarden neer te zetten en best practices organisatie breed te delen.

Voorwaarden

  • 32 tot 40 uur per week
  • Hybride werken mogelijk
  • Salarisindicatie: vanaf circa € 4400 bruto per maand, met doorgroei tot circa € 7000 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur
  • Goede pensioenregeling, opleidingsmogelijkheden

title: Senior Software Engineer – Platform & API Integration

Peraton's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.

Peraton is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead Information for Planning and Consultation (IPaC) website application architecture updates and API integration for a federal data migration program. You will design and implement the integration between the federal consultation platform and the cloud data infrastructure, enabling new species data to flow seamlessly into existing consultation workflows.

Vol overgave bouwen we aan de toekomst van onze sector

Al meer dan een halve eeuw hebben we ervaring in de pensioensector. Met een hoge datakwaliteit, een vernieuwd IT-landschap en alle kennis & kunde die we in huis hebben, zijn we dé digitale pensioenuitvoerder die in de transitie naar het vernieuwde pensioenstelsel gerichte keuzes maakt en haar rol pakt. Met ons kantoor in Heerlen, zetten we ons met een enthousiast team iedere dag in voor onze deelnemers. Natuurlijk wordt er hard gewerkt, maar we hebben ook oog voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Daarnaast vinden we gezelligheid en verbinding belangrijk; we organiseren informele activiteiten.

Wij zoeken een Cloud platform engineer!

AZL heeft besloten een grote stap vooruit te zetten in het moderniseren van haar IT-landschap door een volledig nieuw state-of-the-art pensioenlandschap neer te zetten binnen Azure.

Om deze cloudomgeving te ontwerpen, bouwen en beheren beschikken wij over een Cloud Platform Team. Dit team bestaat momenteel uit 10 professionals die volgens Agile- en Devops- principes samenwerken. Het Cloud Platform Team levert niet alleen de onderliggende infrastructuur, maar biedt ook de platformdiensten en tooling waarmee andere DevOps-teams integraties, webportals en en BI-oplossing kunnen ontwikkelen en beheren.

Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met collega’s binnen AZL én met engineers en developers van ons moederbedrijf Nationale Nederlanden waarmee we intensief samenwerken aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons cloudplatform.

Als Cloud Platform Engineer maak je onderdeel uit van het Cloud Platform Team en werk je mee aan het ontwerpen, implementeren en beheren van een moderne Azure-cloud omgeving.

Onze infrastructuur is volledig ingericht volgens Infrastructure as Code-principes en uit een combinatie van Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), serverlessdiensten en geautomatiseerde deployment pipelines. Als financieel dienstverlener hechten wij veel waarde aan security, beschikbaarheid en compliance. Daarom integreren wij beveiliging, governance en compliance controles zoveel mogelijk in onze CI/CD-processen, zodat we aantoonbaar \"in control\" blijven.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Ontwerpen, implementeren en beheren van CI/CD-pipelines in Azure DevOps.
  • Beheren, optimaliseren en onderhouden van Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Inrichten en beheren van monitoring-, logging- en alerting-oplossingen om de prestaties en beschikbaarheid van het platform te waarborgen.
  • Configuratie en beheren van back-up en disaster recovery-oplossingen om gegevensintegriteit en -beschikbaarheid te waarborgen.
  • Ontwerpen en implementeren van Infrastructure as Code-oplossingen met Terraform.
  • Automatiseren van beheeractiviteiten en het uitrollen van nieuwe omgevingen met behulp van scripting en automation tooling.
  • Signaleren, analyseren en oplossen van security- en platformincidenten.
  • Actief bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons cloudplatform en DevOps-werkwijzen.
  • Samenwerken met ontwikkelteams om implementaties verder te standaardiseren en te automatiseren.
  • Continu verbeteren van processen op het gebied van betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, beheerbaarheid en kostenbeheersing.

Wat breng je mee

  • HBO(+) werk- en denkniveau.
  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare DevOps-, Cloud- of Platform Engineer-rol.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met Microsoft Azure en cloudinfrastructuur.
  • Ervaring met Azure Devops en CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ervaring met Ansible en AWX is een pré.
  • Ervaring met monitoring- en observability-oplossingen, bij voorkeur Azure Monitor en Splunk.
  • Kennis van back-up-, restore- en disaster recovery-processen binnen Azure.
  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en een oplossingsgerichte instelling.
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en de capaciteit om effectief samen te werken binnen multidisciplinaire teams.
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.
  • Interesse in nieuwe technologische en de drive om jezelf continu te ontwikkelingen.
  • Je neemt initiatief, bent leergierig en voelt je thuis in een Agile- en DevOps-omgeving.

We bieden de mogelijk voor een contract tussen de 32-40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw voorkeur.

We hebben een eigen CAO met uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals 30 vakantiedagen, een diversiteitsdag, een eindejaarsuitkering en pensioenopbouw bij een van de vitaalste werkgevers van Limburg. We bieden een salaris tussen 4534 - 6476 euro per maand, gebaseerd op een 40-urige werkweek, afhankelijk van ervaring.

AZL biedt jou de mogelijkheid om een opleiding te volgen en zo een bijdrage te leveren aan jouw eigen ontwikkeling. Je werkt twee/ drie dagen per week vanuit ons kantoor in Heerlen, daarnaast heb je de mogelijkheid om vanuit thuis te werken. Naast het werk organiseren we leuke (sportieve) events om ook collega’s buiten je afdeling beter te leren kennen.

Heb je er zin in?

Wij werken op een prettige manier samen met een aantal preferred suppliers. Acquisitie wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld.

AZL verwerkt persoonsgegevens van sollicitanten in het kader van de sollicitatie- en selectieprocedure. Dit doen we om een geschikte kandidaat voor de openstaande functie te vinden. Een check van referenties en social media en een verklaring omtrent het gedrag (VOG) kunnen hiervan onderdeel zijn. We verwerken alleen de persoonsgegevens die wij daarvoor nodig hebben. Na afronding van de selectieprocedure worden de persoonsgegevens verwijderd.

description:

title: Office Associate
description:

Persistent Systems is seeking a dependable, proactive Office Associate to provide company-wide administrative support from our Fort Collins, CO office.   • Greeting customers, vendors, prospective employees, and other guests to the office; ensuring compliance with security policies and procedures
  • Maintaining the office environment including monitoring inventory of office supplies and pantry items, ordering and restocking supplies as necessary; ensuring a neat and orderly office including emptying common area trash receptacles and arranging cleaning service visits

  • Managing calendars, including scheduling meetings and events, ensuring scheduling conflicts do not arise
  • Coordinating employee events
  • Preparing written correspondences to internal and external parties; arranging and distributing office-wide updates
  • Sorting and distributing mail to appropriate parties daily
  • Assisting with various other administrative and office support tasks
  • Conduct regular office walkthroughs to ensure cleanliness and readiness, including checking common areas, conference rooms, kitchen, and refrigerator; promptly address any issues such as expired food or clutter; coordinate with cleaning services as needed to maintain a tidy, safe, and welcoming environment

Job Qualifications & Experience

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 2 years of experience providing administrative/office support
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Experience with travel coordination and expense reporting
  • Must be able to lift 20lbs
  • Must be able to work from the company’s Fort Collins office location on a full-time basis
  • Must have the ability to obtain a United States Security Clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree
  • Exceptional skills in verbal and written communication, relationship management, time management, and problem solving
  • Experience providing administrative support in growing, fast-paced organization

The pay rate for this role can vary from $25 to $28 an hour based on the selected individual's education and experience. Persistent Systems, LLC offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; paid time off; flexible spending accounts; 401(k) plan with company match; fitness membership reimbursement; tuition assistance; mental health benefits; and veterinary benefits.

Company Overview

Persistent Systems is a growing business that develops Mobile Ad hoc Networking (MANET) wireless radio systems for Government and commercial applications. The radios are typically worn on the person, mounted to manned vehicles, integrated into autonomous unmanned vehicles, or installed at fixed sites. The systems provide on-the-move data, voice, video, and situational awareness capability. Located in the heart of New York City, Persistent Systems is an exciting company that is passionate about delivering cutting edge products.

title: Polysomnographic Technologist
description:
Overview

Shifts Available: Nights

Employment Type: Per Diem (PD/PRN)

Hours: 6:30pm to 7:00am

Location: St Joseph Medical Center – Kansas City, MO

We are seeking a Polysomnographic Technologist, also referred to as a Sleep Technologist or Polysomnographer for our Sleep Laboratory in our hospital. A Sleep Technologist plays an important role in diagnosing and treating sleep disorders within our hospital. A Polysomnographic Tech’s primary responsibility is to perform polysomnography, a type of sleep study that monitors various physiological parameters to assess sleep patterns, identify abnormalities, and support the diagnosis of sleep-related issues. This position is on a per diem basis, meaning PD/PRN as needed.

Responsibilities

  • Obtain the patient’s medical history, especially regarding sleep habits, disorders, and current medications that might influence sleep patterns
  • Perform overnight sleep studies by attaching sensors to patients and monitoring various physiological indicators during sleep, you may track brain activity (EEG), eye movements (EOG), heart rate (ECG), muscle activity (EMG), breathing patterns, oxygen levels and body movements
  • Prepare patients for sleep studies by explaining procedures, attaching sensors, and creat a comfortable environment for sleep, ensure that patients understand the process, helping reduce anxiety and discomfort
  • Use advanced equipment to collect data, which helps identify disruptions in sleep, such as apnea (breathing interruptions), periodic limb movements, or other abnormalities
  • Use specialized software to "score" different stages of sleep, including REM (rapid eye movement) and NREM (non-rapid eye movement), based on recorded data
  • Identify irregularities, such as obstructive sleep apnea, insomnia, restless legs syndrome, or narcolepsy, which can then be reviewed by a sleep specialist for diagnosis
  • May administer CPAP (Continuous Positive Airway Pressure) or BiPAP (Bilevel Positive Airway Pressure) during the study to determine effective pressure settings for patients who may need therapy

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent required
  • Certified Polysomnographic Technologist or Respiratory Therapist required
  • Current BCLS (AHA) Certificate upon hire and maintain current
  • Graduate of an accredited polysomnography program or respiratory therapy program preferred
  • Eligible for registry through the BRPT preferred
  • Minimum of 1 year technical experience working in a sleep lab/center preferred
  • Experience scoring sleep studies preferred

title: Product Manager
description:
Company Outline

Job Role: Product Manager

Location: Hybrid - London

Salary: Competitive (DoE)

Why do we want you?

At Wilmington plc, we're looking for a curious and commercially minded Product Manager to join us. You'll work across a portfolio of specialist brands, each with its own customers, products and commercial priorities, so you'll need to be able to quickly understand unfamiliar domains, identify where the greatest value lies and make confident, evidence-based decisions. Working closely with Engineering and business stakeholders, you'll use customer insight, data and product judgement to influence priorities, shape solutions and ensure we're investing in the initiatives that deliver the greatest value. If you're looking for a role where you can take ownership, make an impact and help drive product-led decision-making, we'd love to hear from you!

Please note: To complete your application, you will be redirected to Wilmington plc’s career site. At Wilmington plc, we celebrate individuality and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. As a Disability Confident employer, we shortlist all applicants who meet the essential role criteria and guarantee an interview for candidates with disabilities who meet these criteria. For reasonable adjustments or to apply under our interview guarantee scheme, please use the contact details provided once you have clicked “apply”!

Job purpose, tasks and responsibilities

As a Product Manager, you'll own a defined product domain, helping to identify the most valuable problems to solve for our customers and business. You'll lead discovery, shape product direction and work closely with Engineering to deliver solutions that create measurable impact.

You'll be responsible for:

  • Owning a defined product domain, identifying customer and business problems worth solving.
  • Prioritising opportunities and build evidence-based cases for inclusion in the wider product roadmap.
  • Leading discovery activities to understand user needs, validate assumptions and uncover valuable insights.
  • Partnering with Engineering to shape, deliver and continuously improve product solutions.
  • Delivering outcomes incrementally, using data, feedback and experimentation to guide decision-making.
  • Managing stakeholder expectations by clearly communicating priorities, trade-offs and roadmap decisions.
  • Measuring success and use performance insights to refine product strategy and future investment decisions.
  • Championing the effective use of AI tools to improve product delivery, research and team efficiency.

What’s the Best Thing About This Role?

This is a role where your judgement really matters and you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of a product domain from end to end, shaping not only what gets built, but why it gets built and the impact it delivers. You'll work closely with customers, stakeholders and engineering teams to solve meaningful problems, influence product direction and see your decisions translate into real business and customer outcomes.

What’s the Most Challenging Thing About This Role?

There will always be more good ideas than there is capacity to deliver them. A key part of the role is making thoughtful prioritisation decisions, building the case for your domain and sometimes accepting that other initiatives will take precedence. The challenge isn't just deciding what to do next, but being able to clearly explain why, backed by evidence, customer insight and business value.

Essential and desirable capabilities

To be successful in this role, you must have:

  • Experience owning a product, product area or product domain through the full lifecycle, from identifying customer problems through to delivery and measuring outcomes.
  • Strong product judgement, with the ability to assess opportunities, prioritise effectively and make evidence-based decisions in a resource-constrained environment.
  • Experience leading discovery activities, using customer research, data and stakeholder insights to uncover problems and validate opportunities.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with engineering teams to shape solutions, manage trade-offs and drive delivery.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to influence priorities and communicate decisions clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • The ability to quickly build understanding of unfamiliar business domains, customer needs and operational challenges.
  • Experience defining success measures and using data, feedback and outcomes to inform future product decisions.
  • Practical experience of Agile and iterative product development approaches, delivering value incrementally and learning from results.
  • Experience using AI tools to support activities such as research, analysis, prototyping or product delivery, with a clear understanding of where they add value.

To be successful in this role, it would be great if you have:

  • Experience working with business systems such as CRM, ERP, billing or e-commerce platforms.
  • Experience within regulated industries or complex, multi-brand organisations.
  • Commercial awareness, including experience interpreting business performance metrics or contributing to investment cases.
  • Experience working with distributed, remote or nearshore engineering teams.
  • Experience of operating in organisations undergoing product, technology or business transformation.

We know it’s not a skill, but the successful candidate must have permission to work in the role’s location by the start of their employment.
