We’re Wilmington plc, a group of businesses united by governance, risk and compliance. title: Psychiatrist - Onsite PT - Juvenile

title: Senior Software Engineer – AI
description:
The National Fire Protection Association’s mission is to help save lives and reduce loss with information, knowledge, and passion. Established in 1896, we are dedicated to the elimination of death, injury, and property and economic loss due to fire, electrical, and related hazards. The Association delivers information and knowledge through more than 300 consensus codes and standards, research, training, education, outreach and advocacy; and by partnering with others who share an interest in furthering the NFPA mission.


To better meet the needs of those who rely on our information and knowledge to keep people and property safe, we are amidst a transformation to expand our influence and further our safety mission. We are becoming increasingly digital and global to grow, thrive, and save more lives from fire, electrical, and other hazards. To accomplish this, we need effective leaders at all levels of the Association who understand what we are striving for, why it is important, and how to execute our vision and who passionately want to see NFPA through this important stage. It is an exciting and empowering time to work at NFPA.


To support NFPA’s growing business needs and digital transformation, the Senior Software Engineer – AI is responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing CASI, NFPA’s AI system, and other related AI systems and the applications that leverage them. This role participates throughout the software development lifecycle and collaborates with software developers, business analysts, architects, vendors, partners, and teams across the organization.


The position requires senior-level technical expertise in generative AI, Microsoft technologies, Azure cloud services, application architecture, and software engineering to deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions that support NFPA’s mission and organizational goals.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, maintain, and improve AI systems and web-based business applications.
  • Develop and support generative AI solutions, including RAG systems, agentic workflows, tool calling, agents and skills, prompt and context engineering, MCP servers, vector databases, semantic search, and large-scale document ingestion and retrieval.
  • Integrate software systems, application components, and third-party programs.
  • Collaborate with software developers, business analysts, software architects, vendors, and other stakeholders to plan, design, develop, test, and maintain applications.
  • Apply application architecture knowledge to guide technical decision-making and problem-solving.
  • Design and implement observable, high-throughput RESTful APIs and integrations.
  • Produce clean, efficient, well-designed, and testable code based on established specifications and standards.
  • Design, develop, and unit test applications in accordance with established development standards.
  • Participate in code reviews and mentor and assist other developers in applying software development best practices.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve technical and application issues.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation to support current and future software development projects.
  • Work effectively within legacy application architectures when required.
  • Collaborate across teams to meet changing priorities and deadlines while proactively identifying issues and developing long-term solutions.

title: Field Calibration Technician
description:
Overview

Who we are—

Transcat is a dynamic, innovative, growing company that has been recognized as the leading calibration and compliance services provider in North America and beyond. With over 1,000 employees—in technical, consulting, operational, sales, finance, and corporate roles—we have stood the test of time by delivering on our Trust in Every Measure promise to our customers in vital industries, including life sciences, aerospace, defense, energy, and utilities. We fulfill this promise through our employees, who live Our Values every day, the Transcat Way. Our employees are at the center of the rewarding, challenging, and life-changing work we do for our customers and those they serve. Are you ready to join a company where the work you do makes a difference, and where you can grow in your career?

Here’s what Transcat has to offer—

  • Work that matters.
  • A values-based culture where people care about each other and the work they do together.
  • Flexibility
  • Training and development to accelerate learning and career advancement.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including paid time off, health insurance, tuition reimbursement, retirement, stock purchase plan, and MORE!
  • Pay range is $21.00 - $31.00 / hour

Calibration Technician I is an entry-level position that requires either education in the electronics/calibration field or at least one (1) year of calibration experience. Calibration Technicians at this level typically can calibrate low-end process instrumentation in up to three (3) disciplines (e.g., Electrical, Dimensional or Pressure). Proficiency and expertise are determined in accordance with Transcat’s technician skills progression matrix.

Responsibilities

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Work with other technicians within the lab to learn calibration fundamentals, which can include measurement, temperature, electronics, etc.
  • Identify and utilize appropriate measurement techniques
  • Maintain calibration standards
  • Working knowledge and competency in at least three 3 disciplines (dimensional, electrical, torque, temperature, pressure, etc.)
  • Perform calibration work within a laboratory setting and/or while supervised at a customer on-site
  • Fulfill duties safely under working conditions, in keeping with Company requirements and standards
  • Other duties as assigned
  • Travel requirement: 25-50% of work schedule

Primary Objectives

  • Learn fundamental calibration skills and techniques
  • Develop skills necessary to perform calibrations independently
  • Develop skills necessary to advance to Calibration Technician II position, which includes a working knowledge and competency in at least four (4) disciplines and expert competency in one (1) discipline
  • Deliver on Transcat’s Quality Policy (QAC-F01-001)

Qualifications

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Qualifications

  • Successful completion of assigned training materials through on-the-job training, online content, LMS, and classroom led instruction
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Self-motivated learner with the ability to learn new skills related to calibration and calibration processes
  • Ability to take direction and learn from feedback
  • Ability to communicate well with supervisor, solve problems effectively, and work both independently and as part of a team
  • 3+ years driving experience with a valid driver’s license and acceptable driver history

Education and Experience

Required: Associates degree from college or technical school; or at least one (1) year related experience and/or training. or equivalent combination of education and experience

Preferred:

  • Previous experience or training in electronics or machining
  • Basic mathematical skills including algebra, geometry, and statistics
  • Familiarity with basic hand tools
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office computer software including Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Organizational and time management skills
  • Experience in PMEL, PME, TMDE, Metrology, Calibration, ASQ CCT, METCAL, GPETE, Electronics, GCAMS, or Avionics

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of the physical requirements necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. We will reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to read, write, talk, and hear. The employee is often required to sit and use their hands and fingers to handle tools and equipment. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. Occasionally will be required to lift up to 75 lbs.

Work Environment

The work environment described here is representative of what an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to risk of electrical shock. The employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; toxic or caustic chemicals; outside weather conditions; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Equal Opportunity and Non-Discrimination

Transcat is an equal-opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination based on any protected status. As required by United States law, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, disability, genetic predisposition or carrier status, national origin, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), status as a protected veteran, or as a member of any other protected group or activity under federal, state, and local law.

We will make reasonable accommodations for employees with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their position unless doing so poses an undue hardship to the company or a direct threat to health or safety.

Contingencies

All offers of employment are contingent upon successfully completing all pre-employment requirements, which include verification of identity and employment eligibility, and when applicable, a motor vehicle driving record report.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer Kubernetes/OpenShift
description:
Bij ODC-Noord werk je aan Kubernetes-platformen waarop cruciale diensten van de Nederlandse overheid draaien. Als Senior DevOps Engineer Kubernetes/OpenShift werk je aan complexe OpenShift-omgevingen en los je vraagstukken op die verder gaan dan het dagelijks beheer. Je onderzoekt bijvoorbeeld wat technologie als Hypershift voor onze platformen kan betekenen en werkt technische keuzes uit die ook op langere termijn veilig, schaalbaar en beheersbaar blijven. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om oplossingen kritisch te beoordelen en je technische kennis in te zetten bij de verdere ontwikkeling van het platform.

Als Senior DevOps Engineer Kubernetes/OpenShift ontwerp, bouw en beheer je samen met andere DevOps Engineers, architecten en software engineers de Kubernetes-platformen van ODC-Noord. Je pakt vooral de complexere platformvraagstukken op. Denk aan veranderingen die meerdere clusters raken, nieuwe platformdiensten of problemen waarbij niet direct duidelijk is waar de oorzaak ligt.

Bij zulke vraagstukken kijk je verder dan de eerste technische oplossing. Wat betekent een keuze voor de beschikbaarheid van het platform? Hoe blijft de omgeving veilig en beheersbaar als deze verder groeit? En welke onderdelen kunnen we automatiseren zodat handmatig beheer niet telkens nodig is? Je werkt mogelijke oplossingen uit, bespreekt de voor- en nadelen met engineers en architecten en helpt bepalen welke aanpak technisch het beste past.

Ook bij complexe verstoringen speel je een belangrijke rol. Met monitoring, logging en je kennis van Kubernetes, OpenShift en Linux onderzoek je wat er in clusters en nodes gebeurt. Je herstelt niet alleen wat stuk is, maar zoekt naar de oorzaak en past het platform waar nodig aan om te voorkomen dat hetzelfde probleem opnieuw ontstaat.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van Kubernetes- en OpenShift-platformen;
  • uitwerken en realiseren van oplossingen voor complexe platformvraagstukken;
  • ontwikkelen en implementeren van nieuwe platformdiensten;
  • automatiseren van beheer en deployments met CI/CD;
  • analyseren van complexe verstoringen en oplossen van de achterliggende oorzaak;
  • onderzoeken van nieuwe technologie, zoals Hypershift, en beoordelen of deze bruikbaar is binnen het platform.

Je werkt daarbij veel samen met andere engineers, architecten, de Product Owner en andere stakeholders. Bij ingewikkelde technische vraagstukken weten collega’s je te vinden. Je legt uit waarom je voor een bepaalde oplossing kiest, stelt kritische vragen bij bestaande oplossingen en helpt andere engineers verder wanneer zij vastlopen.

Nieuwe technologie hoef je niet alleen vanaf papier te beoordelen. Je kunt een technische verkenning of proof-of-concept opzetten om te onderzoeken hoe iets zich in de praktijk gedraagt. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen of het werkt, maar ook wat nodig is om een oplossing veilig, stabiel en beheersbaar in productie te gebruiken.

  • Arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd
  • Het salaris is gebaseerd op een werkweek van 36 uur.

Dit bieden we nog meer

Wij vinden het belangrijk dat je jouw werk goed met jouw privéleven kunt combineren. Diverse verlofregelingen, zoals ouderschapsverlof, en flexibele werktijden dragen bij aan een goede balans. Daarnaast bieden we je ook andere aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals:

  • een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) van 16,5% van je bruto jaarsalaris, voor bijvoorbeeld de aflossing van je studieschuld, een (elektrische) fiets inclusief accessoires, verduurzaming van je woning, extra verlof of anderefiscaalvriendelijke doelen
  • omruilen van belangrijke feestdagen zonder dat je daar een vrije dag voor hoeft op te nemen
  • volledige vergoeding van je ov-reiskosten. Reis je met de auto? Dan geldt een kilometervergoeding
  • een pensioenregeling bij ABP
  • studiemogelijkheden voor je ontwikkeling
  • de mogelijkheid om te sporten via bedrijfsfitness

Dit vragen wij

Je hebt ruime ervaring met platform- of infrastructuuromgevingen en kent Kubernetes en OpenShift goed genoeg om ook bij complexe vraagstukken zelfstandig tot de kern te komen. Je kunt technische keuzes onderbouwen en bespreekt die net zo makkelijk met een engineer als met een architect of Product Owner. Je hoeft niet iedere nieuwe technologie al te kennen, we vinden het belangrijker dat je snel begrijpt hoe iets werkt en kritisch kunt beoordelen of het binnen onze omgeving past.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • hbo-werk- en -denkniveau;
  • minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring als DevOps-, platform- of infrastructure engineer, waarvan minimaal drie jaar aantoonbare ervaring met Kubernetes en/of OpenShift;
  • goede kennis van OpenShift en Linux en ervaring met het beheren en doorontwikkelen van Kubernetes-platformen;
  • ruime ervaring met infrastructuurautomatisering en CI/CD;
  • ervaring met monitoring en troubleshooting van complexe cluster- en nodeproblemen, bijvoorbeeld met Prometheus en Grafana;
  • ervaring met programmeren of scripting, bijvoorbeeld in Python, Go of Bash.

Meer over ODC-Noord

ODC-Noord is de cloud service provider van en voor de Rijksoverheid en valt onder de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs. Vanuit Groningen leveren ruim 200 collega’s infrastructuur- en platformdiensten aan ministeries en overheidsorganisaties.

De dienstverlening varieert van housing en hosting tot IaaS- en PaaS-oplossingen voor zo’n 45 afnemers binnen elf ministeries. De organisatie combineert technische diepgang met een sterke focus op samenwerking en continuïteit.

Hoewel technologie de basis vormt, draait het in de praktijk om de kwaliteit van de mensen. Teams zijn betrokken, kennen elkaar goed en werken samen aan betrouwbare en veilige digitale dienstverlening.

SSO-Noord bundelt generieke diensten op het vlak van bedrijfsvoering, zoals inkoop-, datacenters- en IT-diensten. We verkennen continu nieuwe samenwerkingsvormen voor het Rijk. Met onze hoogkwalitatieve diensten kunnen ruim veertig rijksorganisaties hun bedrijfsvoering efficiënt en effectief uitvoeren. Samen met hen dragen wij bij aan rijksbrede duurzaamheidsdoelen en aan maatschappelijk verantwoord inkopen. SSO-Noord is gerelateerd aan de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs.

Wil je deel uitmaken van deze vernieuwende en ambitieuze werkgever in Groningen? Natuurlijk weten wij dat onze organisatie alleen succesvol kan zijn als jij als medewerker alle kansen krijgt om te leren en te groeien. Niet voor niets investeren wij in jouw vakinhoudelijke en persoonlijke ontwikkeling met interessante traineeships en opleidingen, en kun je rekenen op een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Zo zetten we gezamenlijk de schouders onder het succes en de groei van de organisatie.

SSO-Noord wil een organisatie zijn waar iedereen zich welkom en gewaardeerd voelt. We geloven dat verschillende perspectieven en achtergronden ons sterker maken en onze dienstverlening verbeteren. Alle vacatures zijn geschikt voor kandidaten uit de doelgroep Banenafspraak.

Bijzonderheden

  • We vinden gelijke kansen belangrijk. Daarom vragen we geen motivatiebrief. Alle kandidaten beantwoorden dezelfde vragen in het sollicitatieformulier. Zo beoordelen we iedereen op een eerlijke en vergelijkbare manier, op basis van CV en antwoorden.
  • We ontvangen graag je reactie uiterlijk op 27 september 2026. De gesprekken vinden plaats in week 41.
  • Na de sluitingsdatum zijn de vacaturetekst en de gegevens van de contactpersonen online niet meer zichtbaar. Om te voorkomen dat je deze moet opvragen, vragen wij je de vacaturetekst te downloaden en te bewaren.
  • Controleer regelmatig je ongewenste/spam e-mailmap. Het kan voorkomen dat mailwisseling vanuit DUO in deze map(pen) terechtkomt.
  • Ben je een intermediair? Wij werven zelf of met onze vaste partners via het Rijksinkoopstelsel. Acquisitie is niet gewenst.

Over de functiegroep Senior Medewerker Iv

Door het Functiegebouw Rijk worden medewerkers en leidinggevenden geholpen bij het maken van resultaat- en ontwikkelafspraken in functioneringsgesprekken en krijgt men inzicht in de loopbaanmogelijkheden binnen de Rijksoverheid.

Meer informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure

Het Rijk hecht waarde aan een diverse en inclusieveorganisatie. Werken in divers samengestelde teams maakt ons effectiever, innovatiever en het werkleuker.

title: Senior Network Administrator
description:
Overview

Job specifications are intended to present a descriptive list of the range of duties performed by employees. Specifications are not intended to reflect all duties performed within the job.

SUMMARY:

The Senior Network Administrator is responsible for the planning, installation, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise network systems supporting voice, video, and data communications. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

title: Recovery Worker
description:
Overview

At Change Grow Live, our commitment to making a difference in the lives of those who use our services is unwavering. We provide support, respect, and a safe environment, where we tailor our approach to each individual's needs to find the best treatment and support options.

Our core values are ‘Be open, be compassionate and be bold’ and our team members apply these daily to achieve our objective of helping people change the direction of their lives, grow as individuals, and live life to its full potential.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Recovery Worker who has the skills and experience to assess and engage with our service users, ensuring that they access the right intervention at the right time, in a way that best meets their needs.

With this role you’ll be working as part of the recovery team, based in Gravesend. The team supports people with their or their loved ones’ drug and alcohol issues.

Where: Gravesend

Hours: 37.5 per week

Contract Type: 9 Month Fixed Term Contract

Full-time hours at Change Grow Live are 37.5 hours per week. For part-time roles, the salary and payments will be pro rata based on contracted hours.

Responsibilities

About the role:

  • Supporting service users from point of entry into the service and through their treatment/recovery journey
  • Providing screening, assessment, and recovery planning and onward referral
  • Reducing drug and alcohol related harm to service users and the wider community
  • Promoting carer, service user and community involvement
  • Providing advocacy for access to partnership services
  • Working with service users to support social (re)integration, enabling them to lead meaningful and purposeful lives: promoting recovery, resilience, peer support and self-determination
  • Research, design and prepare subject matter and materials for groups / pods.
  • Deliver structured content within group settings to service users at various stages of recovery
  • Engage with debriefing and evaluations with co-facilitators after groups/pods have taken place, reviewing progress and identifying concerns with service users
  • Tailor specific workshops around the needs of the service users, such as: anger management, sleep disorders, relationships, etc

About you:

  • Have a strong understanding of substance misuse issues and experience of working within a similar field
  • Experience of working with groups/pods and managing group dynamics, such as conflict or challenging behaviour.
  • Be an excellent communicator, both verbal and written with good IT skills
  • Proactive and able to work on own initiative with excellent time management and prioritising skills
  • Have a good working knowledge of mental health interventions, services, and good practice
  • Be a supportive team player with strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work in partnership with a wide range of professionals, agencies, and internal/external stakeholders
  • Ability to manage change successfully in a way that prioritises the needs of service users
  • Understand the importance of information governance processes and commit to follow and apply all necessary safeguards
  • Seek out learning opportunities to improve and broaden your professional knowledge and skills and to contribute and oversee the learning and development of others

What we will give to you:

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. Additionally, you'll receive one extra day of annual leave for each year of service during your first five years, therefore you will enjoy 30 days of leave after five years with us.
  • Paid ‘Wellness’ hour each week along with a ‘Wellness’ hub and Employee Assist Programme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Several benefits incl. discounts for shopping, cinema, holidays, etc.
  • A friendly and supportive team
  • Training, career development & progression opportunities
  • Generous Refer-a-Friend Scheme

Please ensure that when completing your application form and supporting statement, you reflect on the details outlined in the job description. This will help us understand how your skills and experiences align with the requirements of the role.

AI can be a really helpful tool when putting together your application, and we're happy for you to use it. However, what we're most interested in is you.

We want to understand your experiences, achievements and strengths, so please make sure your application reflects your own story and clearly shows how you meet the essential criteria and the impact you've made in previous roles.

There's no need to write in a particular style. The strongest applications are those that are authentic, specific and clearly demonstrate your skills, experience and potential. We look forward to learning more about you.

Direct applications only — we will not be engaging agencies for this vacancy.

Please note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. For applicants with time-limited visas, unfortunately, we are unable to support new visa applications or extensions.

We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if we receive a high number of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: MFT Parent Partner
description:
Position Summary

The MiFamily Together (MFT) Parent Partner is an individual who has had previously opened child protective services (CPS) or foster care case with successful case closure and responsible for working with parents to promote engagement in case activities via weekly phone, video, or face-to-face contacts. This position is responsible for offering responsive, flexible services that meet families where they are. MFT fosters meaningful engagement and provides tailored support to help families thrive at any level of need. This position will serve Ottawa County.

Michigan’s Children’s Service Administration believes that children should live with their families whenever possible, and MFT will support the department’s goal to reduce the number of children who experience out-of-home care and the associated trauma of being removed from their family. MFT seeks to support the safety and wellbeing of these families such that risk to the child(ren) is reduced.

Wage: Up to $20.79/hour based on relevant life and work experience.

Are you passionate about discovering new ways to help empower people and make a difference in their lives?

If you’ve got what it takes to support us in our mission to provide help and create hope through innovative, collaborative, and diverse programs within the community, then we’ve got the right opportunity for you.

About Catholic Charities West Michigan

Catholic Charities West Michigan (CCWM) is a community-based agency providing programs in Western Michigan and offering a variety of services in family preservation, behavioral health, child welfare, and community outreach.

  • CCWM is committed to ensuring a diverse workforce and a work environment whereby all staff are treated with dignity, respect, and fairness.
  • CCWM encourages persons of diverse backgrounds and faiths to apply for employment.

Essentials Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provides services in accordance with the MFT contract requirements.
  • Works with parents to promote engagement in case activities via weekly phone, video, or face-to-face contacts.
  • Attends training as required within the program and agency.
  • Coaches parents on what to expect throughout the child welfare process.
  • Helps maintain connections between parents and children by observing and advocating for children and family rights.
  • Assists the parents in identifying and advocating for their needs.
  • Provides permanency, encouragement, outreach, and advocacy by connecting parents to resources within their communities.
  • Assists parents in building protective factors.
  • Works collaboratively with the MFT team to support the family and provide services.
  • Completes all required MDHHS and MFT documentation within established timeframes.
  • Supports families by attending Family Team Meetings or Team Decision Meetings, court hearings, treatment and recovery appointments, or other events with parents.
  • Provides a monthly one-hour voluntary support group meeting to all caregivers engaged in Parent Partner services.
  • Transports adults or children with parent(s) present utilizing personal vehicle, as needed.
  • Drives for agency business.
  • All other duties as assigned per supervisor’s request.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this position, the staff member is regularly required to talk and/or hear. The staff member is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The staff member, on occasion, may be asked to move or lift items up to 40 pounds in weight.

Work Environment:

This position is primarily office based, however, on occasion may require travel to other Agency offices as required by position responsibilities and/or agency management. This position will be routinely exposed to typical office noise levels and/or exposure to various weather conditions.

The qualifications listed above are guidelines for selection purposes; alternative qualifications may be substituted if sufficient to perform the duties of the job.

Other Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • A previously personal opened CPS or foster care case with successful case closure.
  • A stable family situation without current Children’s Protective Services (CPS) substantiation for safety issues.
  • No confirmed child abuse reported during the role of Parent Partner.
  • Flexibility to attend meetings and facilitate groups including non-standard work hours such as evenings and weekends to meet client needs.
  • Participation in mandated training(s), supervision, and team meetings.
  • A willingness to share parenting experiences as a learning tool with other parents, community partners, and referring workers.
  • This position requires reliable transportation.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and good driving record with zero work restrictions.
  • Must have personal auto insurance as required by law with minimum bodily injury coverage limits of $250,000 per person/$500,000 per incident or $500,000 combined.
  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule based on needs of the clients served. This may include working irregular hours including evenings, holidays, and weekends.
  • Participation is required in initial and ongoing training provided by MDHHS and Agency.
  • Not eligible for employment if convicted of any felony or placed on the Central Registry. If receives a new CPS complaint while employed, activities with MFT caregivers must be suspended until the investigation is complete. An investigation with confirmed abuse and neglect will result end of employment.

Recommended Employment Qualifications

Education:

None required.

Experience:

A minimum of 1 year of prior work experience working with children and/or families is preferred.

A previous personal opened CPS or foster care case with successful case closure.

Professional Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations:

none required.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.

Inspired by the Church's social teachings, Catholic Charities West Michigan fosters individuals and families to flourish by providing help and creating hope.

Our Vision

Catholic Charities West Michigan is called to create a just and compassionate community where all people can achieve their divine purpose.

Our Values

  • Sanctity of All Life
  • Compassion
  • Integrity
  • Respect
  • Equity

CCWM is an equal opportunity employer, subject to all federal and state laws as applicable to a religious Agency.

The Qualifying Party will serve as the licensed technical authority of record for the applicable classification(s) and will be officially associated with Par Western’s New Mexico electrical contractor license in accordance with state law and CID regulations.

This role may be fulfilled through employment-mentor a formal contractual engagement, provided all CID requirements are met.

CID-Compliant Relationship Statement

This position establishes a bona fide association between the Qualifying Party and Par Western Line Contractors LLC. The Qualifying Party will be actively affiliated with the company and will not serve in a nominal, passive, or license-lending capacity.

What You'll Do

· Be listed with the New Mexico Construction Industries Division (CID) as the Qualifying Party of record for EL-1 and/or EE-98

· Demonstrate and maintain technical competency for the licensed scope(s)

· Provide professional oversight and guidance to ensure work performed under the New Mexico license aligns with:

o Authorized license classifications and scopes

o Applicable electrical codes and safety standards

· Support compliance with CID licensing, renewal, and regulatory requirements

· Cooperate with:

o License applications and renewals

o CID or PSI reviews

o Regulatory inquiries or audits related to the licensed classifications

· Notify Par Western of any change that may affect QP eligibility or certification status

License Classifications & Scope

EL-1 – Electrical Distribution Systems

Applicable work includes, but is not limited to:

· Overhead and underground distribution lines

· Transmission lines

· Substation electrical work

· Utility-scale and customer-owned electrical distribution systems

· Electrical infrastructure projects performed as a subcontractor

EE-98 – Electrical (Residential & Commercial)

Applicable work includes:

· Residential, commercial, and industrial electrical installations

· Electrical systems operating at 5,000 volts or less

· NEC-based electrical wiring and systems

What You'll Bring

· Eligible to obtain, or currently holds, a New Mexico CID Qualifying Party Certificate

· Experience must be:

o Verifiable

o Within the preceding 10 years

o Utility distribution or transmission systems

o Substation construction or maintenance

o Overhead or underground power line work

EE-98 Experience Requirements (if qualifying EE-98)

· Minimum 4 years (8,000 hours) of residential and/or commercial electrical experience

· Experience with NEC-governed electrical systems

Examination & Certification

The Qualifying Party must:

· Have passed the required CID trade examination(s) for EL-1 and/or EE-98

· Completed and passed the Business & Law requirement Exam.

· Maintain QP certification in good standing for the duration of the association

Benefits include-- Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K

title: Senior Data Analyst/Data Scientist - TS/SCI with Polygraph Required
description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Senior Data Analyst/Data Scientist to support our Intelligence Community client.

This position requires an active TS/SCI with a Polygraph.

This position requires you to be on site 5 days a week at Bolling Air Force Base.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and intelligence sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

Responsible for providing advanced data analytics and predictive strategic workforce planning via on-demand, intuitive web-based capabilities and reporting.

  • Collaborate with an integrated team of data scientists, data analysts, and HR functional SMEs to understand business processes, develop analytical requirements, identify key data elements, adhere to data protection guidelines, and interpret and communicate analytic results
  • Understand and analyze complex and organization-specific datasets.
  • Define and develop techniques to integrate, consolidate, and structure data for analytical use.
  • Support the maturation of data quality
  • Support the transformation of businesses process through automation
  • Transform data and analysis into informative visualizations and interactive dashboards using open-source and commercially available visualization and dashboard tools
  • Provide regular detailed reporting to management and customers
  • Advise on the interpretation and use of data analysis products, dashboards and reports to non-technical customers
  • Assist the development of junior data scientists through technical mentoring, code review, and other assistance.
  • The data scientist will need the ability to work in teams and independently
  • Identify, propose, and assist in the development of future analytics products based on the data pipeline to assist customers in gaining value from the data products.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in science, engineering, mathematics, computer science, economics, data analytics, or other related business or quantitative discipline
  • 7+ years experience in data or business analytics
  • High level of competency with data science/analysis coding languages like SQL, Python, or R
  • Experience developing dashboards using Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, RShiny, plotly, or d3.js
  • Experience with data science methods related to data architecture, data munging, data and feature engineering, and predictive analytics.
  • Self-starter with the vision to independently identify opportunities for improvement through data analytics
  • A true team player who maintains a positive attitude in a dynamic environment
  • Excellent communication skills, written and oral
  • Proven ability to work with business customers and technical teams
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Excellent customer relationship management skills
  • Innovative problem-solving skills and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work on client site in the NCR in Washington, D.C.
  • This position requires an active security clearance at the TS/SCI level with a Polygraph.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Masters degree or higher
  • Experience using python libraries to build machine learning models like regression models and decision trees
  • Experience with version control software like Git
  • Management consulting experience desired
  • Experience working with unstructured text and natural language processing
  • Experience with deploying and maintaining models in production
  • Previous experience with people analytics

title: Program Manager, CO&P PMO
description:
Program Manager, CO&P PMO – Hybrid, Cary, North Carolina

We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence – and questions into answers.

If you’re looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you’ll find it here. We’re recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.

About the job

The Corporate Operations & Planning Program Management Organization (CO&P PMO) is looking for a Program Manager to lead high-impact, cross-divisional programs or projects that drive strategic transformation and operational excellence across SAS. The CO&P addresses four critical challenges for SAS: ensuring the right strategy, enabling better decisions, improving operational effectiveness, and strengthening our competitive advantage. The CO&P PMO accelerates SAS’s strategic vision and addresses those four challenges by transforming prioritized initiatives into measurable results through program alignment, governance, and business impact. Through disciplined execution, we ensure strategic initiatives and programs are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable value, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement that drives long-term business success. This position is a critical part of the team working to secure SAS’s future.

As a Corporate Operations & Planning Program Manager, you will:

Collaborate with the PMO, business sponsors and leaders, and cross-functional teams to deliver programs and projects that advance SAS’s strategic goals and initiatives with the following guiding areas of focus:

  • Program Leadership: Manage and support the initiation, planning, execution, and closure of programs and projects with diverse yet defined scope to ensure they align with strategic goals and the CO&P PMO charter. Serve as the primary point of contact for all program- or project-related matters, liaising with interested parties throughout the company to ensure successful outcomes. Demonstrate strong analytical abilities to assess solutions for both program and business operation needs.
    • Provide guidance and direction to program or project team to ensure alignment with established goals, objectives, and deadlines.
    • Develop detailed program or project plans to effectively track and monitor progress, ensuring scope is aligned with broader business strategies.
    • Orchestrate a consistent cadence of meetings and working sessions with colleagues and team members to manage deliverables and monitor progress.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Alignment: By cultivating and sustaining strong working relationships, you will partner with key stakeholders to define, scope, identify objectives with measurable outcomes, and lead programs or projects that align with strategic initiatives. Collaborate with partner organizations responsible for shared success to identify and track key performance metrics related to stakeholder priorities, satisfaction, and achievement of objectives, ensuring collective program or project success.
  • Governance & Reporting: Abide by the PMO methodology by developing and maintaining comprehensive program or project documentation including plans, schedules, and status updates; facilitate clear communication across teams to drive alignment, transparent reporting, and realization of intended benefits. Including preparing and delivering tailored reports for various stakeholder groups, outlining program or project status, challenges, and solutions.
  • Program or Project Delivery: Plan, prioritize, implement, and adjust delivery schedules, scope, resourcing, and quality requirements as needed. Facilitate status meetings, coordinate cross-divisional resources, and facilitate clear communication among stakeholders to keep programs or projects on track. Proactively manage action items, formulate mitigation strategies, and resolve issues in partnership with stakeholders to maintain program or project delivery within defined scope and timelines.
  • Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of innovation, agility, and adherence to program management best practices.
  • Operational Excellence: Apply rigorous operational oversight to monitor, sustain, and continuously evolve programs to secure ongoing success. Ensure continuous alignment between scope and overarching organizational goals and objectives.
  • Promote Innovation: Engage in ongoing professional development through educational opportunities, reading industry publications, networking, and actively participating in relevant organizations to ensure up-to-date expertise.
  • Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.

Work Location: Cary, NC (Hybrid)

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Program or Project Management, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in program or project management, preferably in a cross-divisional or enterprise environment.
  • Proven ability to work independently, receive minimal guidance on day-to-day work, perform effectively under pressure, manage shifting priorities, prioritize changing deadlines, and maintain performance standards.
  • Proven excellent organizational and problem-solving capabilities; excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Demonstrated excellent interpersonal, written, oral, and visual communication abilities, with experience engaging audiences including senior leaders.
  • Proven ability to lead program teams and build consensus among stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply innovative and creative thinking to design tailored solutions for complex and unique challenges.
  • Proven ability to apply change management methodologies to effectively manage people, processes, and technology transitions systematically, minimizing disruption, scope creep, timeline delays, stakeholder resistance, and misalignment.
  • Demonstrated understanding of business and technical concepts to evaluate strategic programs and their impacts.
  • Proven experience in process improvement design and support.
  • Proven experience with program management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira) and extensive knowledge of Microsoft Office 365.
  • Proven experience working in technology or at a data, analytics, or AI software/service provider.
  • An equivalent combination of related education, training and experience may be considered in place of the above qualifications

Additional competencies, knowledge and skills

  • Communication: Conveying information and ideas clearly and concisely to individuals or groups in an engaging manner that helps them understand and retain the message; listening actively to others.
  • Planning and Organizing: Establishing an action plan for self and others to complete work efficiently and on time by setting priorities, establishing timelines, and leveraging resources.
  • Driving Execution: Translating strategic priorities into operational reality; aligning communication, accountabilities, resource capabilities, internal processes, and ongoing measurement systems to ensure that strategic priorities yield measurable and sustainable results.
  • Global Perspective: Demonstrating an awareness of, and sensitivity to, the international market, cultural, technological, political, and legal factors that impact individual work group priorities and results; leveraging own understanding of the organization’s global strategy, global business trends, and regional differences to enhance individual and work group results
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Program Management Professional (PgMP) or Agile certification or equivalent, demonstrable professional development with goal of obtaining certification.
  • Experience in strategic planning, governance, or enterprise transformation.
  • Familiarity with SAS software, analytics, or cloud technologies.

Discover what’s next – right here at SAS

  • Explore Internal Career Mobility and discover your next opportunity at SAS.
  • Build and showcase your career profile in Avature, SAS’ talent management solution.
  • Visit the Career Development SharePoint site for tools, resources and guidance to support your growth.
  • Get involved in career programs like Career Circles, Career Mentoring and the Learning & Development Exchange to expand your skills and connections.

Additional Information

To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States, and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. Qualifications

title: Compensation Specialist
description:
Overview

TITLE: Compensation Specialist

DETAILS:

Department: Clinical Affairs / Human Resources

Reports To: Director of Compensation Management

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Salary Range: $60,000-$63,000/year, commensurate with experience.

Benefits: PTO; Insurance: Medical, dental, vision, basic life; Retirement: 401(k) with matching.

Format & Schedule: Hybrid with on-site support at our Harrison, NY headquarters. Must be able to work late on payroll weeks as determined necessary. Must be able to work late around holidays falling on concurrent payroll weeks. Please note that relocation support is not available. Strong preference will be given to employees already in commuting distance.

Location: Hybrid / Somnia Headquarters - 450 Mamaroneck Ave, Harrison, NY 10528.

POSITION DESCRIPTION:

The Compensation Specialist will provide support to the growing Clinical Payrolls and Clinical/Corporate Benefits functions including, but not limited to, the accurate processing of certain multi-company, multi-state bi-weekly payrolls and assist with benefits administration as it relates to the payroll system – medical, dental, vision, life, short- and long-term disability, 401(k) etc... Perform other general Payroll and Benefits duties as assigned.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Review submitted payroll documents, including timecards and spreadsheets to ascertain hours of services, time off, call services, and stipends to ensure data is accurate before payroll is processed.
  • Enter hours worked, overtime, call hours and time off into the ADP Workforce Now payroll system as needed. Retrieve payroll hours from QGenda scheduling software as needed.
  • Process assigned bi-weekly payrolls.
  • Add new hires into ADP payroll system.
  • Accurately report on new hires, terminations, headcounts, compensation, census data and related analytical information as required.
  • Provide assistance in the day-to-day Payroll and Benefits activities including responding to employees’ inquiries in an accurate, timely manner.
  • Assist with the processing of required benefits documents through insurance carriers and payroll system to ensure accurate recordkeeping and proper deductions of new enrollments, changes and terminations.
  • Assist in the processing of employment verifications and garnishments, unemployment claims.
  • Research new federal and state laws/regulations as needed.
  • Assist with Open Enrollments for Employee Benefits plans.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Qualifications

SKILLS/QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Must be proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.
  • Must be organized and detail-oriented.
  • Must be team oriented, with a "pitch in, do what it takes" attitude.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are required.
  • Strong verbal/written and interpersonal skills are required.
  • Working knowledge of Federal and multi-state wage/hour laws and multi state paid leave regulations.
  • Familiarity with COBRA, ERISA, FMLA required.
  • Ability to maintain confidential information.
  • Ability to multi-task and handle multiple projects.
  • Maintain confidentiality in all employee and company related matters.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Accounting or related field required.
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience using ADP Workforce Now payroll system required.
  • 2-5 years’ experience in the Healthcare field preferred.

title: Cloud Network Engineer
description:
Opportunity

PeopleTec is currently seeking a Cloud Network Engineer to support our Huntsville, AL location.

We are seeking a highly-skilled, full-time, on-site Cloud Network Engineer interested in joining an award-winning company and working with cutting-edge missile defense modeling and simulation technologies. The selected candidate will be a member of a dynamic Huntsville-based team designing, implementing, and operating secure, high-performance networks that span on-premise data centers, public cloud environments, software-defined networking (SDN), and container-native networking solutions for system-of-systems enterprises.

Duties Include:

  • Secure network design and deployment including inter-domain routes, network segmentation, access controls, and policy enforcement across cloud and on-premise resources
  • Cloud and multicast networking including infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.), multicast UDP and broadcast UDP traffic for high-throughput applications
  • Software-defined and hardware-defined solutions including deployment and maintenance of platforms and appliances, and integration of network services with Kubernetes using CNI plugins and container-based networking
  • Hybrid cloud integration including connection of remote cloud instances to on-premise data centers, ensuring reliable routing and latency optimization, and remote enclave connectivity
  • Automation and monitoring including network provisioning and changes using IaC tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) and robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for network health and security events
  • Collaboration and documentation working closely with security, DevSecOps, and application teams to define network access protocols and rules, and runbooks and knowledge-base articles for all network solutions

Qualifications

Required Skills/Experience:

  • Network design including proven experience setting up restricted/compliant networks and securing inter-domain/enclave communication
  • Cloud networking including hands-on experience with cloud networking services (VPC, VNets, peering, transit gateways, switches, routing tables, ABAC/RBAC rules)
  • Linux operating system experience
  • Multicast/UDP including practical knowledge of multicast UDP and broadcast UDP traffic handling
  • SDN and Hardware-Defined Networking experience
  • Secure routing across domains including ability to create and manage secure routing paths between isolated domains or enclaves
  • Network physical infrastructure practical experience including establishing and managing software-in-the-cloud infrastructure
  • 5 years of professional networking experience with focus on cloud and software-defined environments
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen
  • An active DoD Secret clearance is required to perform this work. Candidates are required to have an active Secret clearance upon hire, and the ability to maintain this level of clearance during their employment.

Education Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree from accredited college in related discipline with 5 years professional experience; or Master’s degree with 3 years professional experience; or PhD with no experience

  • Bachelor’s degree from accredited college in related discipline with 9 years professional experience; or Master’s degree with 7 years professional experience; or PhD with 4 years professional experience

  • Bachelor’s degree from accredited college in related discipline with 14 years professional experience; or Master’s degree with 12 years professional experience; or PhD with 9 years professional experience

Desired Skills:

  • Container Network Interface (CNI) expertise including experience with one or more CNIs: Cilium, Multus, or similar
  • Enterprise software hosting including background deploying and supporting enterprise-grade applications in production environments
  • Network access policy development including experience defining and governing network access protocols, firewall rules, and zero-trust policies
  • Container-mesh architectures including familiarity with container-based network meshes (e.g., Istio, Linkerd) and service-mesh concepts
  • Cloud-to-cloud routing including experience routing traffic between multiple cloud service provider instances
  • Hybrid cloud infrastructure including proven work with hybrid cloud models linking remote clouds to on-premise resources
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities including troubleshooting complex network issues
  • Excellent communication skills including ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders
  • Proactive mindset with focus on security, reliability, and scalability
  • Ability to work autonomously and as part of cross-functional team
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CCNA/CCNP, AWS Certified Advanced Networking, Certified Kubernetes Administrator)

Overview

People First. Technology Always.

PeopleTec, Inc. is an employee-owned small business founded in Huntsville, AL that provides exceptional customer support by employing and retaining a highly skilled workforce.

Culture: The name "PeopleTec" was deliberately chosen to remind us of our core value system - our people. Our company's foundation was built on placing our employees and customers first. With an award-winning atmosphere, we have matured into a company that boasts the best and brightest across multiple technical fields.

Career: At PeopleTec, we value your long-term goals. Whether it's through our continuing-education opportunities, our robust training programs, or our "People First" benefits package, PeopleTec truly believes that our best investments are our people.

Come Experience It.

title: Center Director Code Ninjas Draper & Holladay
description:
Build a Business. Develop Kids. Make an Impact.

Code Ninjas is looking for an energetic, entrepreneurial Center Director to help lead and grow our Draper and Holladay locations.

This is not just an administrative center-management position.

We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership of the business, build strong relationships with families and the community, create an amazing experience for our Ninjas, develop a high-performing team, and drive sustainable enrollment growth.

Our programs introduce kids to coding, game development, AI, robotics, STEM, and technology in a fun and engaging environment. We also operate XP League, a competitive youth esports program.

The right person will combine the energy of a community leader, the relationship skills of a great educator, and the results orientation of an entrepreneur.

What You’ll Own

Grow the Centers

Take ownership of enrollment growth across our Draper and Holladay locations.

You will:

  • Generate and convert new leads and trial visits
  • Build relationships with local schools, PTAs, community organizations, sports teams, Scout groups, and other youth organizations
  • Develop grassroots and local marketing opportunities
  • Represent Code Ninjas at school and community events
  • Create partnerships that introduce more families to our programs
  • Follow up consistently with prospective families
  • Turn tours and trial sessions into long-term memberships
  • Help grow our core Code Ninjas programs as well as AI, robotics, camps, clubs, and XP League
We want someone who enjoys getting out into the community and creating opportunities rather than waiting for leads to arrive.

Create an Exceptional Parent & Student Experience

Growth isn’t just about enrolling new families. It’s about giving families a reason to stay.

You will:

  • Build genuine relationships with students and parents
  • Understand each child’s interests, goals, and progress
  • Ensure students are engaged, learning, and having fun
  • Proactively communicate with parents
  • Identify potential concerns before they become cancellations
  • Create a welcoming, energetic, and positive dojo culture
  • Help turn Code Ninjas families into advocates and referral sources
Our goal is to create a center kids are excited to attend and parents enthusiastically recommend.

Lead and Develop the Team

You’ll lead our team of instructors/Senseis and help them become exceptional mentors for our students.

Responsibilities include:

  • Coaching, training, and developing staff
  • Establishing clear expectations and accountability
  • Ensuring high-quality student interactions
  • Scheduling and staffing the centers appropriately
  • Creating an energetic and collaborative team culture
  • Identifying and hiring additional talent as the centers grow
  • Ensuring consistent execution across both locations
Run the Business

You’ll have meaningful autonomy to operate the centers and will be accountable for results.

You’ll monitor and improve key metrics including:

  • Active enrollment
  • New memberships
  • Trial-to-membership conversion
  • Student retention and cancellations
  • Lead follow-up
  • Community partnerships
  • Camps and special programs
  • Customer satisfaction
  • Staffing and center operations
We believe in giving strong leaders room to operate. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities, create a plan, execute it, measure the results, and continuously improve.

Who We’re Looking For

You may be a great fit if you are:

  • Entrepreneurial and highly self-motivated
  • Comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for instructions
  • Naturally good at building relationships
  • Comfortable selling and asking families to enroll
  • Excited about working with children and parents
  • Comfortable developing community and school partnerships
  • Organized and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Able to lead, coach, and hold a team accountable
  • Creative about grassroots marketing and business development
  • Comfortable using technology and learning new systems
  • Driven by measurable results
Experience in education, youth programs, tutoring, STEM, coding, robotics, camps, franchising, retail/service management, sales, or business development is helpful.

You do not need to be a professional programmer.

Understanding technology is valuable, but your ability to lead people, connect with families, grow the business, and execute is much more important.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first several months, we expect you to:

  • Learn our programs, families, staff, and local markets
  • Strengthen the student and parent experience
  • Improve lead follow-up and trial conversion
  • Reduce preventable cancellations
  • Establish a consistent community outreach program
  • Develop new relationships with schools and local organizations
  • Grow active enrollment across both centers
  • Build a repeatable growth engine that continues producing results
This is an opportunity to make a visible impact rather than simply maintain an existing operation.

Compensation & Growth Opportunity

We are open to structuring compensation around the right candidate and level of commitment.

The position will include a reasonable base or hourly compensation structure with meaningful performance-based upside tied to growth and results.

We want incentives to be aligned: when you create meaningful growth for the centers, you should participate in that success.

For someone who demonstrates the ability to grow and operate the business successfully, there is significant opportunity to expand responsibilities and compensation over time.

Why Code Ninjas?

At Code Ninjas, kids learn technology by building games, solving problems, experimenting with new ideas, and creating things they’re proud of.

Our programs include:

  • Coding and game development
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Robotics
  • STEM programs
  • Camps and workshops
  • Junior programs for younger children
  • XP League competitive esports
Most importantly, we help kids develop confidence, creativity, problem-solving skills, and a lifelong interest in technology.

If you are someone who sees an opportunity and immediately starts thinking, “How can we grow this?”, we’d like to meet you.

Apply today and tell us why you would be the right person to lead the next stage of growth for Code Ninjas Draper and Holladay.

title: Patient Engagement Specialist - Mansfield Orthopaedics
description:
Overview

Mansfield Orthopaedics, located in Morrisville and Waterbury VT, offers a comprehensive range of evidence-based medicine and proven treatments and techniques that consider the patients' wishes and preferences. Many of our orthopaedic Providers and Staff are active athletes and outdoor enthusiasts, making us particularly well-suited to serve the active, 4-season lifestyle of our patients. We are sensitive to patients' desire to regain their mobility and get back to doing the things they love as soon as possible.

The Patient Engagement Specialist acts as first point of contact for our patients visiting our locations. Orients patients to the practice with directions and instructions. Assists in maintaining efficient patient workflow. Organizes and facilitates clerical administrative duties pertaining to patient registration and scheduling of appointments.

Patient Engagement Specialists are integral in arranging for the smooth flow of patients into outpatient services. Patient Engagement Specialists communicate directly with staff, patients, and providers to ensure a positive experience for patients in obtaining their desired appointments with our providers.

This position is responsible for the collection and validation of demographic, socio-economic, insurance and co-payment information at the time of service. Responsible for patient chart maintenance and communication with physicians’ offices as needed and requested. Compliance with all applicable State and Federal laws, regulations, and policies governing the provision of health care.

This is a Full-Time position (PT options available) located in the Waterbury location primarily with flex to Morrisville, as needed.

Copley Hospital has a variety of shifts available across Full-Time, Part-Time, and Per Diem needs. Please consider applying to discuss how your availability may align.

Compensation: $21.30-29.79/hour.

The posted salary range reflects base compensation for candidates with a variety of experience. An offer within this range may be presented based on experience.

Responsibilities

Registers and performs all related functions for Time of Service Patients:

  • CPSI registration according to outlined guidelines.
  • Explains and obtains all necessary patient consents in a complete and timely manner.
  • Collects provides financial paperwork as required.
  • Determines and collects patient co-payment amount and issues receipt.
  • Counts and verifies cash and payments with 100% accuracy.
  • Processes cancellation of services as required, notifying all pertinent hospital personnel as necessary.

Obtains and verifies patient information for pre-registration:

  • Obtains all relevant information from various scheduling offices.
  • Confirms appointment with patient and/or follows up with patient in a timely manner should information be found to be incorrect/incomplete.

Telephone: Courteously answers calls within 3 rings. Changes as needed.

May Schedule special diagnostic tests for clinic patients as per provider’s orders. Communicates directly with the testing service or department and confirms the appointment with patients. Obtains screening information from patients as needed for different testing and ensures that this information is communicated to the appropriate department. Informs the patient of the scheduled date and procedure to follow on day of test Ensures that patient is scheduled for a follow up provider appointment following the test.

Performs all functions associated with scheduling appointments for patients. Communicating with patients, physicians, other staff members by telephone. Proficient with electronic medical records (EMR). Collecting payments. Solving scheduling problems.

Proficient with electronic medical records (EMR)

Qualifications

Experience:

  • This position requires excellent levels of decision making, proactively and initiative, research, understanding of complexities, analytical thinking, problem solving, and leadership.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and customer service skills.
  • Computer proficiency in the Windows environment, organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and multi-task in a fast paced and sometimes stressful environment.

Nice to have:

  • Prior experience within a medical office
  • Knowledge of medical terminology

title: IT Systems Analyst
description:
Overview

IT Systems Analyst

Location: Duluth, GA

Take your career to the next level with NDCP!

Overview: National DCP, LLC (NDCP) is hiring talented and driven professionals to join our growing team. We’re a $3 billion supply chain leader supporting over 10,000 Dunkin’ restaurants across the U.S. Our team powers one of the most recognized quick-service brands through innovative logistics, reliable service, and high-quality product distribution. Known for delivering real value and operational excellence, NDCP is at the forefront of supply chain management—and we’re looking for passionate individuals to help us keep moving forward.

Position Overview:

As a System Analyst, you will analyze, study, and implement new system solutions. You will be monitoring current processes and implementing new solutions with the goal to improve overall business efficiency. You will be working with our team of engineers and developers who are proficient in IT, programming, and software development. As a System Analyst, the responsibilities include prioritizing user requirements, overseeing system upgrades, researching new tools ad provide support as required. Work during normal business hours and on-call after hours and during weekends on a rotation basis. In this role, you should be highly analytical and able to understand business needs. Excellent communication skills and problem-solving abilities are essential.

Why Work with Us? At NDCP, your work matters. We offer a collaborative, people-first environment where your ideas are heard and your growth is supported. From competitive pay and full benefits to career advancement opportunities, we invest in your success—because when you thrive, so do we. Join us and take the next step in a meaningful, rewarding career

Schedule: Full-Time, Monday through Friday

Benefits you can count on:

National DCP offers a robust benefits suite. Check out our career page for our full list of benefits

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) / Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Company paid life, AD&D, short and long-term disability
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid Time Off (vacation, sick, discretionary) & paid holidays and more!
  • Additional benefits: employee assistance programs, discount programs, tuition discount program, and more!

NDCP offers a competitive salary plus bonus potential!

Responsibilities

What you’ll do

  • The system analyst consults with end users and gathers information related to new change requests, documents the business need, analyzes the need, and determines if new software on personal computers is required or a modification to existing software is needed
  • As required the system analyst will document software functional specifications
  • The system analyst will monitor the health of the applications

  • The system analyst gathers information related to new change requests, issues, and devises solutions to address the request
  • The system analyst will consult with other system analysts and administrators to resolve issues that require extra attention or indicate a larger problem within the IT ecosystem
  • The system analyst manages the flow of incoming support requests and escalates to other IT specialists as required
  • The system analyst may escalate complex issues or problems outside of their field of expertise to IT support specialists
  • The system analyst may also retrieve the user’s computer so that IT specialists can analyze the system and enact a solution to the problem
  • The system analyst will provide support after hours and be on-call on a rotation basis

Qualifications you bring:

  • 0-3 years’ experience in a technical support position
  • Bachelor of Science Degree or equivalent preferred
  • Computer certifications are a plus
  • MS Office, Windows OS, Symantec, etc.

Critical Competencies for Success:

  • Self-motivated and task-oriented
  • A strong ethic of accountability to drive results
  • Must be able to work in a team environment
  • Desire to exceed expectations
  • Highly analytical and strong attention to detail
  • Desire to take software and service to the next level
  • Time management: must be able to work on multiple projects at any one time and balance workload
  • Develop and maintain a professional, friendly communication style with customers and company staff

title: Analytics Data Scientist
description:
Overview

BRMi is seeking a motivated, customer-experience-focused analytics professional who is passionate about solving real-world business problems through data. This role combines exploratory analysis, statistical methods, experimentation, behavioral analytics, and fit-for-purpose modeling techniques to uncover insights and drive measurable impact.

This position collaborates with cross-functional partners across product, technology, and business teams to transform complex questions into actionable insights. Areas of focus include digital experience analytics, customer feedback and sentiment analysis, digital usage forecasting, customer behavior modeling, feature adoption measurement, and operational optimization.

Benefits:• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance• Employer-Paid Life Insurance• Employer-Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance• 401(k) • Paid Time Off (PTO) that includes Vacation Leave, Sick Leave, and 11 Paid Holidays• Educational Assistance

Salary: 100k-122k

**Hybrid in Vienna, VA**

**An In Person interview will be required for this role**

Click here to learn about BRMi's culture.

Click here to see BRMi’s Glassdoor reviews

Responsibilities

  • Analyze customer digital behavior using Python and SQL.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify patterns in product adoption, engagement, and customer experience.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and product teams to identify and solve digital experience challenges.
  • Develop, automate, and maintain analytical solutions that provide actionable business insights.
  • Apply analytical and statistical methods to understand customer behavior, evaluate digital experiences, identify emerging trends, and support data-driven business decisions.
  • Apply text analytics, natural language processing (NLP), and AI-assisted techniques to summarize and classify customer feedback, identify sentiment and recurring themes, and surface customer friction points.
  • Analyze app reviews, surveys, contact center interactions, social media, and other digital feedback sources to conduct Voice of the Customer (VoC) research.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations, dashboards, presentations, and data stories for business and executive audiences.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, business analytics, statistics, applied mathematics, economics, or another quantitative or analytical field.
  • 1–5 years of experience in data science, business intelligence, analytics, statistical analysis, or related project work.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis and Python for data preparation, exploratory analysis, statistical analysis, and modeling; experience with R is beneficial.
  • Experience applying analytical and statistical methods such as exploratory data analysis (EDA), hypothesis testing, regression, forecasting, segmentation and clustering, experimentation, NLP, or sentiment analysis to real-world business problems.
  • Experience translating analytical findings into insights, recommendations, or measurable business outcomes for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in notebook-based analytical environments.
  • Strong curiosity and ability to quickly learn new analytical methods and technologies.
  • Excellent communication and data storytelling skills.
  • Master’s degree in data science, business analytics, statistics, applied mathematics, economics, or another quantitative or analytical field preferred.
  • Experience analyzing customer behavior, digital products, customer feedback, or customer experience preferred.
  • Experience presenting complex analyses to executive audiences and developing decision-support materials preferred.
  • Knowledge of financial services or digital banking products preferred.
  • Advanced SQL and Python skills preferred.

** BRMi will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.**

**This is a W2 opportunity only**

About this Role

The Field Quality Representative Intern at Crux Subsurface will be involved in a variety of shallow and deep foundation construction projects, emphasizing design-build delivery methods for electrical transmission and distribution projects. The Field Quality Representative Intern will interface with a multi-disciplinary team consisting of engineering and construction management personnel. This position will be responsible for validating the quality of the constructed work and ensuring conformance with project quality management plans, engineering design documents (drawings and specifications), project contracts, and state and local requirements.

  • Sample, characterize, and log geotechnical materials using company procedures and commonly accepted standards.
  • Develop, maintain, and submit daily construction field reports.
  • Sample, prepare, and transport grout and concrete specimens.
  • Install, operate, and troubleshoot geophysical testing and downhole imaging equipment. Review and interpret results and readings for adequacy.
  • Accurately perform and complete administrative tasks as required.

What You'll Bring

  • In-progress undergraduate degree in civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, geologic science, construction management.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Able to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and contracts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent critical thinking and planning skills.
  • Strong work ethic – able to work in a team and willing to do what it takes to get the job done.
  • Able to balance, kneel, crouch, and walk/hike through uneven and steep terrain, occasionally at high altitude.

  • Able to access remote work sites by travel on helicopter.

title: Deburr Operator
description:

The role often involves hand-finishing, use of precision tools, cleanliness, and adherence to aerospace safety and quality standards.

Responsibilities

  • Wash, clean, decrease, or otherwise prepare parts after deburring to meet cleanliness and surface condition requirements.
  • Inspect parts for dimensional accuracy and conformance to tolerance and surface finish, using measuring tools like calipers, micrometers, depth gauges, profilometers, and microscopes. & identify any non-conforming parts.
  • Maintain documentation of work: production logs, inspection records, corrective action reports, traceability where required.
  • Maintain tools, equipment, and workspace: ensure tools are sharp/appropriate, machines are cleaned, PPE used, follow safety, quality, 5S/lean, environmental standards.

Qualifications

  • Must be able to read customer provided drawings.
  • Proficient in the use of customer furnished specifications.
  • Strong manual dexterity and hand‑eye coordination; ability to handle small/complex parts and delicate finish work.
  • Familiarity with deburring and finishing tools: hand tools, power tools, pneumatic tools; knowledge of which tools and abrasives are appropriate for materials (Aluminum, Titanium, Stainless, etc.)
  • Experience with precision measuring instruments (calipers, micrometers, etc.) where needed.

Preferred Education/Experience:

High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Must have 2 + years of prior deburr experience.
