title: Director, Constituent Programs
description:
Overview

The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association (WFAA), the private fundraising and alumni relations organization for the University of Wisconsin–Madison, is seeking a Director for Constituent Programs to join the Alumni Relations & Engagement team!

In this role, you will serve the Alumni Relations and Engagement division as the strategic lead and people leader for those working with program portfolios focused on engaging key constituent segments, including diverse alumni, students, recent graduates, and other organizationally determined priority segments. This position will lead the development of data-informed strategies to build affinity and deepen relationships of constituents with the university and WFAA. This individual will lead portfolio teams to design engagement initiatives in support of divisional business area plans and will work with WFAA and campus partners to deliver initiatives that will engage key audiences. In addition, they will supervise professional and part-time staff and serve as a lead on cross-functional teams and initiatives. This is a hybrid position that requires you to work weekly in our Madison, WI office.

Who is WFAA?The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association is a private, nonprofit corporation that encourages individuals and organizations to make gifts to the university and to connect with the UW. In 2014, the UW Foundation merged with the Wisconsin Alumni Association® to better serve a growing population of UW alumni and donors. We believe that private support grows out of good relationships between campus leaders, faculty and program staff who need support, and the alumni and friends who want to invest in UW–Madison. We provide important engagement opportunities to link UW–Madison alumni to each other and to their alma mater, building a strong community of Badgers.

Diversity and Inclusion:

Just as the university community benefits from differing viewpoints, perspectives, and experiences, inclusion and diversity are imperative for the success of our mission. WFAA values people and the differences that they bring to the organization, and creates an environment in which all staff members and constituents feel respected and have opportunities to thrive.

Essential Functions

Program Leadership and Strategy

  • Supervise and lead a team of full and part-time staff on the Constituent Program Team, including leading cross-functional portfolio teams to set strategies aligned with business area plan outcomes; budgeting; and overseeing the execution of tactics in the plans.
  • Coach and support the portfolio leads team members in the management of priorities and workflow, ensuring effective planning and execution of activities.
  • Identify resource gaps and problem-solve solutions for maximum return.
  • Collaborate with the Associate Vice President for Engagement Programs and other program directors to ensure consistency across teams in approach to planning, execution, and intended outcomes.

Constituent engagement

  • Provide leadership for the design and delivery of engagement strategies that serve to establish and grow key constituent segments through engagements with UW/WFAA.
  • Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and serve as project lead at times.
  • Intentionally solicit feedback and participation from volunteers, alumni, and donors in the design and development of engagement strategy.
  • Build and cultivate relationships with members of constituent groups, ensuring regular, clear, and professional communication.

Team Leadership

  • Supervise and develop professional and part-time staff across constituent portfolio program staff to ensure consistency in approach and execution across portfolio teams and staff members.
  • Hold team members accountable to expectations, fluencies, and best practices.
  • Motivate, inspire, and coach teams that foster a shared vision and demonstrate organizational values.
  • Provide ongoing feedback and recognition as well as regular performance appraisals.
  • Guide and train the team on best practices and tools to track engagement and affinity outcomes.
  • Participate and help guide team efforts in annual divisional business area planning for affinity portfolios.

Administration

  • Demonstrate proficiency and effectively use organizational processes and technology tools, including WFAA’s CRM, 4WARD.
  • Lead the development of program portfolio budgets in alignment with organizational priorities and oversee effective stewardship of organizational resources in collaboration with the Finance department.
  • Respond promptly and positively to internal and external information inquiries.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 5 + years of experience in alumni or donor relations, educational institutions, non-profit or fundraising environment or related area.
  • Experience supervising and managing professionals and collaborating with volunteers.
  • High degree of proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) is essential.

Other Qualifications:

  • Knowledge or experience with project management tools and processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute a strategic engagement plan with a team.
  • Experience planning and executing large and small-scale events and engagement activities.
  • Familiarity with marketing and communications practices, including use of social media.
  • Excellent analytical, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Experience managing a team and advising students and/or volunteers.

At WFAA, we are dedicated to creating an inspiring, creative, and respectful work environment for our employees. We offer competitive pay and an outstanding benefits program, including a generous 10% 401k contribution after just one year of service! Join us and be part of a team that values your growth and well-being. Click here to learn more about our employee benefits!

*The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association is an Equal Opportunity Employer *The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association (advanceuw.org) is the “doing business as” name of the merged organization comprising the University of Wisconsin Foundation (supportuw.org) and the Wisconsin Alumni Association (uwalumni.com). Its legal corporate name is registered as the University of Wisconsin Foundation.

title: HR & DOT Administrative Clerk
description:
About Us

A fully owned subsidiary of Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE: PWR), Probst Electric Inc. is one of North America's premier utility construction companies. Probst Electric has offices in Heber City, Provo, and Salt Lake City, Utah; Caldwell and Rupert, Idaho. Probst Electric has successfully completed projects all over the United States and Canada.

Probst Electric specializes in high-voltage transmission line construction, design-build, and maintenance services for public and private sector utilities. Our construction specialties include transmission, distribution, drilling, underground, and renewables.

Probst Electric offers competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, and 401k. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and participate in E-Verify.

About this Role

Probst Electric is looking for a reliable and organized HR & DOT Administrative Clerk to provide day-to-day administrative support to the Human Resources and Safety/Fleet teams, with a primary focus on data entry, recordkeeping, and reporting. This role is responsible for entering and maintaining accurate new hire, employee, and driver data across HR and DOT systems; obtaining required documentation from employees, drivers, and outside vendors; coordinating travel arrangements for PFS employees; and producing routine reports for HR and Safety leadership. This is a high-volume, detail-oriented data and administrative role rather than a compliance decision-making role, questions of regulatory interpretation or driver qualification determinations are escalated to the Fleet Manager.

What You'll Do

Key Responsibilities:

  • New Hire & HR Data Entry: Enter new hire data into HR/HRIS and payroll systems (e.g., personal information, tax forms, direct deposit, I-9 details) accurately and within required timeframes.
  • Enter new driver and employee data into DOT tracking/compliance systems (e.g., J.J. Keller or similar), including license numbers, endorsements, medical certificate dates, and onboarding documents.
  • Assemble new hire and Driver Qualification (DQ) file packets; scan, upload, and file supporting documentation (licenses, certifications, background checks, MVRs) into the appropriate electronic and physical systems.
  • Obtain outstanding new hire and driver documentation by following up directly with employees, drivers, supervisors, and outside vendors (testing labs, background check providers, licensing agencies).
  • Travel Coordination: Coordinate travel arrangements for PFS (traveling) employees, including booking flights, hotels, and processing travel authorizations.
  • Serve as the point of contact for PFS employees and project managers on travel logistics questions, changes, and cancellations.
  • Ongoing Data Entry & Recordkeeping: Enter and update DOT-related data on an ongoing basis: license renewals, medical certificate expirations, drug/alcohol test scheduling and results, MVR pulls, and DVIR/inspection records.
  • Pull and compile data to generate routine, recurring reports — e.g., expiring licenses/medical cards, upcoming drug testing, new hire status, headcount, and travel spend — for distribution to HR, Safety, and Fleet leadership.
  • Maintain organized, accurate, and audit-read electronic filing systems for personnel, new hire, and driver records, following required retention schedules.
  • Track outstanding items (missing documents, pending test results, expiring credentials) in a tracking log/spreadsheet and follow up until items are resolved or escalate to the appropriate manager.
  • Respond to routine internal data requests from HR, Safety, Fleet, and Payroll (e.g., pulling a driver's file status, confirming a new hire's start date).
  • General Administrative Support: Assist with general administrative tasks — filing, scanning, mail, correspondence, and data verification/clean-up in HR and DOT systems.
  • Support onboarding logistics for new employees and drivers (scheduling orientation, coordinating paperwork, setting up files) alongside the HR and Safety teams.
  • Perform other administrative and data support duties as assigned.

What You'll Bring

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED required; Associate degree or relevant certification preferred.
  • 1–3 years of experience in an administrative, HR support, data entry, or clerical role; experience supporting HR, fleet, or DOT administration is a plus but not required — this role is trainable for a strong administrative candidate.
  • Fast, accurate data entry skills with strong attention to detail; comfortable working in multiple systems/databases at once.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook); experience with an HRIS/payroll system and/or fleet or compliance data systems (e.g., J.J. Keller, Samsara, Tenstreet) a plus.
  • Experience coordinating travel arrangements (flights, hotels, rental cars, expense/per diem tracking) preferred.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills; able to track multiple open items and deadlines to completion without losing accuracy.
  • Ability to handle sensitive personnel, medical, and travel information with strict confidentiality.
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable following up by phone/email with employees, drivers, and vendors to obtain missing information.
  • Able to work independently, prioritize a high volume of recurring tasks, and meet routine reporting deadlines.
  • Valid driver's license required. Must be able to pass a pre-employment drug screen.

What You'll Get

At Probst Electric Inc., a proud subsidiary of Quanta Services (NYSE: PWR), you’ll join a team that takes pride in delivering high‑voltage transmission construction, design‑build solutions, and maintenance services for public and private utilities. With offices across Utah and Idaho and projects spanning the nation, we bring expertise in transmission, distribution, drilling, underground work, and renewable energy—along with a commitment to quality, safety, and teamwork in everything we do.

We Offer

  • Enjoy exceptional benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and a 401(k) with a strong company match.
  • Be part of an industry‑leading safety culture, strengthened by Quanta Services’ unwavering commitment to safety and its world‑class national training network.
  • Access unlimited career growth opportunities and advance your future within the expansive Quanta family of companies.

Please Note: We are not engaging with external recruiters or agencies for this role. Kindly refrain from outreach regarding candidates.

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and/or gender identity), age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and/or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. We prohibit all types of discrimination and are committed to providing access and equal opportunity for individuals with disabilities. For additional information or if reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application, interview, or hiring processes or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact us the Company’s Human Resources department.

title: System Engineer 2
description:
Description

PLEX Solutions, A Part of Markon, is looking for an Sr. Systems Engineer to support a contract in the Annapolis Junction, MD area performing hands on Systems Engineering tasks.

Responsibilities

  • Manage system requirements and derived requirements to ensure the delivery of production systems that are compatible with the defined system architecture(s) – DoD.
  • Architecture Framework (DoDAF), Service-oriented Architecture (SOA), etc
  • Contribute to the development of sections of systems engineering documentation such as System Engineering Plans, Initial Capabilities Documents, Requirements specifications, and Interface Control Documents
  • Assist with the development of system requirements, functional requirements, and allocation of the same to individual hardware, software, facility, and personnel components
  • Coordinate the resolution of action items from Configuration Control Board (CCB) meetings, design reviews, program reviews, and test reviews that require cross-discipline coordination
  • Participate in an Integrated Product Team to design new capabilities based upon evaluation of all necessary development and operational considerations
  • Allocate real-time process budgets and error budgets to systems and subsystem components
  • Generate alternative system concepts, physical architectures, and design solutions
  • Define the methods, processes, and evaluation criteria by which the systems, subsystems and work products are verified against their requirements in a written plan
  • Develop system design solution that satisfies the system requirements and fulfills the functional analysis
  • Review and provide input to program and contract work breakdown structure (WBS), work packages and the integrated master plan (IMP)
  • Participate in the development of system engineering documentation, such as System Engineering Plans, Initial Capabilities Documents, Requirements Specifications, and Interface Control Documents
  • Participate in interface definition, design, and changes to the configuration between affected groups and individuals throughout the life cycle
  • Derive from the system requirements an understanding of stakeholder needs, functions that may be logically inferred and implied as essential to system effectiveness
  • Derive lower-level requirements from higher-level allocated requirements that describe in detail the functions that a system component must fulfill, and ensure these requirements are complete, correct, unique, unambiguous, realizable, and verifiable
  • Participate in establishing and gaining approval of the definition of a system or component under development (requirements, designs, interfaces, test procedures, etc.) that provides a common reference point for hardware and software developers
  • Develop derived requirements for Information Assurance Services (Confidentiality, Integrity, Non repudiation, and Availability); Basic Information Assurance Mechanisms (e.g., Identification, Authentication, Access Control, Accountability); and Security Mechanism Technology (Passwords, cryptography, discretionary access control, mandatory access control, hashing, key management, etc.)
  • Implement comprehensive SOA solutions
  • Implement operational view, technical standards view, and system and services view for architectures using applicable DoDAF standards
  • Review and/or approve system engineering documentation to ensure that processes and specifications meet system needs and are accurate, comprehensive, and complete
  • Capture all interface designs in a common interface control format, and store interface data in a commonly accessible repository
  • Assess each risk to the program and determine the probability of occurrence and quantified consequence of failure in accordance with an approved risk management plan
  • In conjunction with system stakeholders, plan the verification efforts of new and unproven designs early in the development life cycle to ensure compliance with established requirements
  • Prepare time-line analysis diagrams illustrating the flow of time-dependent functions
  • Establish a process to formally and proactively control and manage changes to requirements, consider impacts prior to commitment to change, gain stakeholder buy-in, eliminate ambiguity, ensure traceability to source requirements, and track and settle open actions
  • Manage and ensure the technical integrity of the system baseline over time, continually updating it as various changes are imposed on the system during the lifecycle from development through deployment and operations & maintenance
  • Support the planning and test analysis of the DoD Certification/Accreditation Process (as well as other Government Certification and Accreditation (C&A) processes)
  • Support the development and review of Joint Capability Integration Development System (JCIDS) documents (i.e., Initial Capability Document, Capabilities Description Document, IA Strategy)
  • Provide technical direction for the development, engineering, interfacing, integration, and testing of specific components of complex hardware/software systems to include requirements elicitation, analysis and functional allocation, conducting systems requirements reviews, developing concepts of operation and interface standards, developing system architectures, and performing technical/non-technical assessment and management as well as end-to-end flow analysis
  • Develop scenarios (threads) and an Operational Concept that describes the interactions between the system, the user, and the environment, that satisfies operational, support, maintenance, and disposal needs
  • Conduct quantitative analysis in non-functional system performance areas like Reliability, Maintainability, Vulnerability, Survivability, Produceability, etc.)
  • Establish and follow a formal procedure for coordinating system integration activities among multiple teams, ensuring complete coverage of all interfaces

Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI w/ Polygraph
  • Fourteen (14) years experience as a Systems Engineer in programs and contracts of similar scope, type and complexity is required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in System Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering Science, Engineering Management, or related discipline from an accredited college or university is required. Five (5) years of additional SE experience may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree.

title: Instructor-Dental Assisting
description:

Arizona College is currently seeking an Instructor for our Dental Assisting Program here at our Mesa, AZ Campus!

Arizona College is a rapidly growing institution dedicated to transforming people’s lives through education. Offering both nursing and allied health programs, Arizona College prepares students for in-demand careers in healthcare and significantly improves its community through the care its graduates provide.

title: Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Een mooie toekomst voor iedereen—dat is waar we bij Sopra Steria naartoe werken. Met meer dan 51.000 collega’s in bijna 30 landen zijn we één van de grootste leveranciers van digital solutions in Europa. We geloven dat niet enkel technologie transformatie aandrijft. Maar dat mensen de kern van verandering vormen Daarom staan mensen ook centraal in alles wat we doen en kun je bij ons zowel individueel als in een team uitblinken.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Wij zoeken een hands-on, resultaatgerichte Medior/Senior Data Scientist voor onze Data & AI-practice in Nieuwegein. Jij vertaalt complexe businessvraagstukken naar robuuste, end-to-end data-scienceoplossingen: het ontwerpen, bouwen en operationaliseren van modellen die meetbare waarde leveren in verschillende sectoren. Dit omvat zowel klantprojecten als interne productontwikkeling.

Voor een medior-profiel zoeken we doorgaans iemand met 3+ jaar relevante, praktische ervaring; voor een senior-profiel 5+ jaar. Los van deze aantallen nodigen we ook uitstekende kandidaten met sterke technische expertise, impactvolle projecten en aantoonbare kennisdiepte uit om te solliciteren, ongeacht exact aantal ervaringsjaren.

In deze rol ga je:

  • Data-scienceprojecten uitvoeren van probleemdefinitie tot en met productie-implementatie, nauw samenwerkend met Sopra-collega’s en klantenteams in een DevOps-omgeving;
  • Werken aan innovatieve projecten en producten zoals onze simulaties, digital twins of Large Language Models-as-a-service producten (voor LLM’s zie onze specifieke LLM-vacature);
  • Modellen operationaliseren met MLOps/DevOps best practices; met o.a. MLflow voor experiment-tracking, Docker/Kubernetes voor containerisatie, en CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions) voor geautomatiseerd testen en releasen;
  • Klanten adviseren over algoritmekeuze, schaalbare feature-engineering pipelines en cloud-native deployment patterns: geoptimaliseerd voor prestaties en kostenefficiëntie;
  • Junior collega’s begeleiden door code-reviews te doen, best practices te delen en een cultuur van continu leren te stimuleren;
  • Op de hoogte blijven van de laatste ontwikkelingen in reinforcement learning, causal inference, LLMs, GenAI, AutoML – en deze inzichten vertalen naar nieuwe diensten.

Functie-eisen

  • Masterdiploma (of vergelijkbaar) in Computer Science, Statistiek, Toegepaste Wiskunde, Kunstmatige Intelligentie of een verwante discipline;
  • Medior: 3+ jaar/ Senior: 5+ jaar ervaring met het leveren van productieklare data-scienceoplossingen in een commerciële of publieke omgeving;
  • Gevorderde vaardigheid in Python, inclusief pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn en minstens één deep learning framework (TensorFlow of PyTorch);
  • Een agnostische mindset. Wij bouwen producten en voeren projecten uit zonder vendor lock-in of “Cloud Only”-mentaliteit. Innovatie staat voorop, dus een combinatie van wetenschappelijke en productgerichte aanpak wordt gestimuleerd;
  • Ervaring met containerisatie en orkestratie (Docker en Kubernetes), plus infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Bicep) op Azure of on-prem;
  • Sterke kennis van MLOps-toolchains, waaronder MLflow, Airflow, Azure ML SDK en geautomatiseerde CI/CD-pipelines (Git, Azure DevOps of GitHub Actions);
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om complexe concepten uit te leggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische doelgroepen;
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het leiden van projecten, het coördineren van multidisciplinaire teams en direct contact met business stakeholders;
  • Vloeiend in Nederlands én Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op professioneel niveau;
  • Passie voor continue verbetering, kennisdeling en het vooroplopen in het snel evoluerende data-scienceveld.

Aanvullende informatie

Je wordt onderdeel van een grote naam in de techwereld, bekend om AI-diensten, consultancy en softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt samen met hoogopgeleide professionals die lef tonen in hun aanpak en zich inzetten om uitzonderlijke resultaten te leveren. Voor deze specifieke rol maak je deel uit van ons Data Science & AI-practice team binnen de grotere Data area.

Binnen de Data area creëren we langdurige waarde voor onze klanten door data centraal te stellen. We helpen bedrijven wendbaar te blijven tijdens transities door data en technologie onderdeel te maken van zowel de dagelijkse operaties als de strategische besluitvorming. Zo helpen we onze klanten voorop te blijven lopen door de kracht van data. Onze ambitie is om organisaties te laten excelleren met data.

Je werkt in een hightech omgeving die volledig gericht is op kennis en innovatie, met een open, no-nonsense cultuur waarin initiatief wordt aangemoedigd. Het domein bestaat uit vijf practices: Data Governance & Data Management, Data Visualization, Data Science & AI, Data Engineering & Data Migrations en Spatial Intelligence - elk met een duidelijke identiteit en focus op inhoud en oplossingen. Er werken ruim 170 professionals in dit domein, ieder in de practice die het beste bij hun expertise en interesses past.

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat je je werk met plezier en balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden wij een aantrekkelijk en flexibel arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket:

  • Een vast contract en een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.000 – €6.000 (op basis van 40 uur per week) + 8% winstdeling bij target (of vast OTB-bedrag) + 8% vakantiegeld;
  • Een royaal mobiliteitsbudget, met o.a. de keuze voor een elektrische leaseauto met NS Business Card, een leasefiets of andere vervoersopties die bij jouw situatie passen;
  • 27 vakantiedagen;
  • Een flexibel keuzebudget, te besteden aan o.a. extra vakantiedagen of hogere pensioenbijdrage;
  • Hybride werken: thuis of op kantoor, afhankelijk van wat het beste werkt – inclusief thuiswerkvoorziening met laptop, telefoon en maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
  • Ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden via trainingen, kennissessies en inspirerende (netwerk)events;
  • Een flexibel pensioen en de optie om deel te nemen aan een collectieve zorgverzekering.

In wat voor team kom je?

Calibration Technician I is an entry-level position that requires either education in the electronics/calibration field or at least one (1) year of calibration experience. Calibration Technicians at this level typically can calibrate low-end process instrumentation in up to three (3) disciplines (e.g., Electrical, Dimensional or Pressure). Proficiency and expertise are determined in accordance with Transcat’s technician skills progression matrix.

Responsibilities

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Work with other technicians within the lab to learn calibration fundamentals, which can include measurement, temperature, electronics, etc.

  • Maintain calibration standards
  • Working knowledge and competency in at least three 3 disciplines (dimensional, electrical, torque, temperature, pressure, etc.)
  • Perform calibration work within a laboratory setting and/or while supervised at a customer on-site
  • Fulfill duties safely under working conditions, in keeping with Company requirements and standards
  • Other duties as assigned
  • Travel requirement: Local day trips only

Primary Objectives

  • Learn fundamental calibration skills and techniques
  • Develop skills necessary to perform calibrations independently
  • Develop skills necessary to advance to Calibration Technician II position, which includes a working knowledge and competency in at least four (4) disciplines and expert competency in one (1) discipline
  • Deliver on Transcat’s Quality Policy (QAC-F01-001)

Qualifications

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Qualifications

  • Successful completion of assigned training materials through on-the-job training, online content, LMS, and classroom led instruction
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Self-motivated learner with the ability to learn new skills related to calibration and calibration processes
  • Ability to take direction and learn from feedback
  • Ability to communicate well with supervisor, solve problems effectively, and work both independently and as part of a team
  • 3+ years driving experience with a valid driver’s license and acceptable driver history

Education and Experience

Required: Associates degree from college or technical school; or at least one (1) year related experience and/or training. or equivalent combination of education and experience

Preferred:

  • Previous experience or training in electronics or machining
  • Basic mathematical skills including algebra, geometry, and statistics
  • Familiarity with basic hand tools
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office computer software including Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Organizational and time management skills
  • Experience in PMEL, PME, TMDE, Metrology, Calibration, ASQ CCT, METCAL, GPETE, Electronics, GCAMS, or Avionics

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of the physical requirements necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. We will reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to read, write, talk, and hear. The employee is often required to sit and use their hands and fingers to handle tools and equipment. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. Occasionally will be required to lift up to 75 lbs.

Work Environment

The work environment described here is representative of what an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to risk of electrical shock. The employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; toxic or caustic chemicals; outside weather conditions; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Equal Opportunity and Non-Discrimination

Transcat is an equal-opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination based on any protected status. As required by United States law, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, disability, genetic predisposition or carrier status, national origin, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), status as a protected veteran, or as a member of any other protected group or activity under federal, state, and local law.

We will make reasonable accommodations for employees with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their position unless doing so poses an undue hardship to the company or a direct threat to health or safety.

Contingencies

All offers of employment are contingent upon successfully completing all pre-employment requirements, which include verification of identity and employment eligibility, and when applicable, a motor vehicle driving record report.

title: Graphic Design Intern
description:
Overview

As a member of the design team, you'll contribute to a variety of projects and gain hands-on experience creating visual communications that align with Quartz's brand standards. Quartz values and embraces diversity and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. title: Chief Engineer
description:
Overview

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, homeland, healthcare, and intelligence sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

LMI is seeking an accomplished Chief Engineer to serve as the program's senior technical authority for enterprise IT and communications capabilities across secure facilities. The Chief Engineer will establish the engineering vision, maintain the integrated technical baseline, and align systems, network, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, applications, data, and operations around a coherent solution. This execution-oriented leadership role supports a fast-paced, milestone-driven prototype with near-term commitments. Success requires broad technical credibility, disciplined governance, executive communication, and balanced judgment across mission, security, resilience, cost, schedule, and lifecycle risk.

Primary duties include:

  • Establish the program's technical vision, engineering strategy, priorities, architecture, standards, and modernization roadmap.
  • Serve as the principal technical advisor to the Program Manager, government sponsors, executive leadership, and engineering teams.
  • Own the integrated technical baseline across systems, network, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, applications, data, facilities, and operations.
  • Lead architecture reviews, design reviews, readiness reviews, technical interchange meetings, and engineering working groups.
  • Manage technical risks, architecture gaps, interface challenges, conflicting requirements, technical debt, and lifecycle concerns.
  • Direct trade studies addressing assumptions, alternatives, cost, schedule, security, risk, and operational consequences.
  • Ensure mission requirements remain traceable through architecture, implementation, integration, verification, validation, transition, acceptance, and operations.
  • Resolve cross-domain conflicts and communicate major decisions, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Establish an integrated automation strategy spanning engineering, cybersecurity, testing, monitoring, compliance, and operations.

FOUNDATIONAL SKILLS

  • Enterprise architecture and multidisciplinary systems engineering.
  • Requirements, interfaces, integration, verification, validation, and lifecycle management.
  • Networking, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, applications, identity, data, and operations.
  • Technical governance, configuration management, change control, and decision management.
  • Reliability, availability, resilience, scalability, maintainability, and operational supportability.
  • Security architecture, zero-trust principles, risk management, and defense in depth.
  • Automation, observability, infrastructure as code, configuration management, and modern engineering practices.
  • Technical risk analysis, trade studies, investment prioritization, and lifecycle cost.
  • Executive communication, negotiation, conflict resolution, mentoring, and multidisciplinary technical leadership.

Location: This position is based in the Washington, DC metro area, with travel to program locations.

Travel: This position requires approximately 25-50% travel to support activities across multiple program locations.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of progressive experience designing, integrating, modernizing, or sustaining complex enterprise IT, including classified environments.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations or major initiatives across dispersed locations.
  • Broad technical knowledge across enterprise architecture, systems, networking, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, applications, and operations.
  • Experience leading architecture reviews, trade studies, risk assessments, integration, and major engineering decisions.
  • Experience engineering capabilities for SCIF or other accredited classified environments, including multi-enclave systems and security boundaries.
  • Working knowledge of the Risk Management Framework (NIST SP 800-37 / 800-53) and experience advising senior leaders.
  • Active Top Secret Clearance (SCI eligibility) required.
  • Excellent communication skills both verbally and in writing. Ability to develop papers, reports, and briefings targeted to senior decision makers.

Nice to Have:

  • Advanced degree or relevant senior-level systems engineering, architecture, program management, or cybersecurity certification.
  • Experience integrating cross-domain solutions (CDS) into enterprise architectures.
  • Experience supporting Special Access Program (SAP) facilities, systems, or environments.
  • Experience designing or standing up network or security operations centers (NOC/SOC), including 24x7 coverage models.

TS/SCI clearance and SAP eligibility are required for this position. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. LMI will only consider applicants with current security clearances. Please note that only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Target salary range: $125,000 - $250,000

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

Through the mission of engaging future leaders who protect, restore and enhance our nation’s lands through community-based service; Conservation Legacy works toward a world with healthy lands, air and water; thriving people and resilient communities.

Position Summary:

The Microsoft 365 System Administrator is responsible for the administration, support, security, and optimization of the organization’s Microsoft 365 environment. This role manages core Microsoft cloud services including Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Intune, and related security and compliance tools. The administrator ensures reliable service delivery, maintains secure configurations, supports end users, and collaborates with IT leadership on governance, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

This position requires strong technical knowledge of Microsoft 365 services, identity and access management, endpoint management, and security best practices, along with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues and communicate effectively with users and stakeholders.

Outcomes & Functions of Position:

Microsoft 365 Administration

  • Administer and maintain the organization’s Microsoft 365 tenant and related cloud services.
  • Manage user accounts, mailboxes, groups, shared mailboxes, resource mailboxes, and licensing.
  • Configure and support Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and related collaboration services.
  • Administer Microsoft Entra ID, including user lifecycle management, group management, and access controls.
  • Support Intune and endpoint management for Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices as applicable.
  • Maintain Microsoft 365 configuration standards, policies, and documentation.

Security and Compliance

  • Implement and support security controls across Microsoft 365, including MFA, Conditional Access, anti-phishing, anti-malware, and data protection policies.
  • Monitor security alerts and investigate suspicious activity within Microsoft 365 and related platforms.
  • Assist with the administration of Microsoft Defender, Exchange Online Protection, and other Microsoft security tools.
  • Support compliance initiatives including data retention, audit logging, sensitivity labeling, and eDiscovery as assigned.
  • Participate in security reviews, incident response, and remediation efforts.

User and Service Support

  • Serve as an escalation point on support tickets for Microsoft 365 issues affecting email, collaboration, authentication, file access, mobile devices, and endpoint compliance.
  • Troubleshoot escalated issues related to Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive sync, mobile email, and identity/authentication.
  • Coordinate with IT staff, vendors, and Microsoft support as needed to resolve incidents.
  • Assist in onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring proper provisioning and deprovisioning of access and services.
  • Support end-user adoption and training efforts for Microsoft 365 tools and best practices.

Automation, Reporting, and Improvement

  • Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and automation workflows to improve efficiency and consistency.
  • Generate reports on licensing, usage, security posture, device compliance, mail flow, or other Microsoft 365 metrics.
  • Identify opportunities to improve administration, governance, security, and operational processes.
  • Assist with Microsoft 365 migrations, service rollouts, policy changes, and platform enhancements.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge base articles.

Organizational Advocacy

title: Engineering Systems Engineer - Azure DevOps Administration & Governance
description:
Overview

The Engineering Systems Engineer, Azure DevOps is the hands-on technical owner of Azure DevOps across the Engineering organization — the project and organization structure, boards, work item process, and access model that every engineer depends on every day, including the integration points that connect Azure DevOps to our GitHub-hosted repos (our source code lives in GitHub, not Azure Repos). Pipeline authoring and CI/CD ownership sit with the engineering teams that build them; this role owns everything else about how Azure DevOps is organized, governed, and accessed. This individual contributor owns Azure DevOps administration, governance, and continuous improvement end-to-end, and is the organization's go-to expert when Azure DevOps issues need to be diagnosed and resolved with authority.

This engineer is a proactive platform operator who identifies configuration drift and fragmented workflows before they become embedded patterns, closes governance gaps before they accumulate into technical debt, and automates manual administration work before it creates toil. When a team asks for a workaround, this person diagnoses the actual problem behind the request rather than bolting on a quick fix that adds to the fragmentation.

Beyond Azure DevOps, this role also supports the broader Engineering Systems platform portfolio — including LaunchDarkly feature flag operations, Flyway database migration standards, AI-assisted development tools like Cursor and Claude Code, and other tools the team takes on as needed — working alongside teammates who own those platforms and building the working knowledge needed to contribute to cross-platform initiatives. Azure DevOps ownership is the primary responsibility in this role; the rest of the portfolio is secondary and grows with tenure, and the specific list of “other tools” is expected to change over time.

This engineer leverages AI throughout their own workflow — using it to accelerate Azure DevOps platform analysis, generate automation scripts, produce enablement documentation, and surface insights from platform data that would take hours to find manually.

Starting base pay for this role is between $100,000 and $122,000. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, training, location, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role will be eligible for a bonus as well as competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness reimbursement, life insurance, and a 401(k) with company match. We offer vacation and sick leave benefits (under a flexible time off policy in most states).

Responsibilities

  • Builds and maintains internal enablement resources — ADO configuration guides, workflow standards references, governance how-tos, and onboarding materials — that empower Engineering teams to work within established standards correctly and independently, reducing the volume of repetitive support requests.
  • Maintains accurate, current platform configuration documentation and standards repositories — ensuring governance requirements, workflow patterns, and access policies are clearly documented and accessible to the Engineering organization.
  • Coordinates the onboarding standards experience for new Engineers — maintaining environment setup guides, tooling provisioning checklists, and standards orientation materials that are current, complete, and effective enough to be executed without handholding.
  • Tracks platform health, adoption metrics, support request trends, and standards compliance across administered systems — maintaining the operational data the Engineering Systems Manager needs to report accurately to the Director of Engineering Systems and to make informed investment decisions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analysis, or a related field

Engineering Systems Engineer, Azure DevOps — Required Qualifications:

  • 2–4 years of hands-on Azure DevOps administration experience — including project configuration, access control governance, and multi-team organizational structures — with Azure DevOps as a primary, hands-on responsibility, not just usage as an end user.
  • Deep hands-on experience administering Azure DevOps — including project/org configuration, access control and permission models, and board/area path structure — at a depth sufficient to independently resolve platform configuration issues and act as an internal escalation point.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills — proficiency with PowerShell and/or REST APIs, and the ability to write reliable, maintainable automation scripts that other engineers can understand and modify.
  • Working knowledge of Git branching strategies, and familiarity with how Azure DevOps Boards and access controls connect to GitHub-hosted repositories — repository links, GitHub Apps/OAuth connections, branch policies, and status checks. Our source code lives in GitHub, not Azure Repos, so comfort bridging the two is important. Hands-on pipeline/YAML authoring is not required — pipelines are owned by the engineering teams themselves.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose the root cause behind a workflow request rather than implementing a band-aid fix — comfort proposing a better solution instead of the workaround that was asked for.
  • Experience managing access controls and user provisioning across engineering platforms with an understanding of least-privilege principles and compliance evidence requirements.
  • Strong organizational discipline and attention to detail — able to manage a high-traffic platform used by every engineer in the organization, maintain configuration hygiene, and track open items without dropping anything.
  • Clear written communication skills — able to produce platform documentation, enablement guides, and configuration records that are accurate and usable by engineering teams without requiring significant clarification.

Engineering Systems Engineer, Azure DevOps — Preferred Qualifications:

  • Exposure to, or willingness to learn, adjacent Engineering Systems platforms — feature flag management (LaunchDarkly), database migration tooling (Flyway), AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code), or whatever other tools the team administers.
  • Demonstrated use of AI development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code in day-to-day technical work.

Benefits

  • Ability to legally work in the Dominican Republic
  • Strong English reading comprehension and written communication skills are required
  • Associates degree or equivilant preferred
  • 2–4 years of experience in an Engineering Systems Administration, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Technical Operations role within a Software Engineering organization.
  • Hands-on experience administering Azure DevOps — including project configuration, pipeline management, access control, board structure, and area path management — at a depth sufficient to independently resolve platform configuration issues.
  • Experience managing feature flag platforms — LaunchDarkly strongly preferred — including flag lifecycle governance, environment management, SDK integration health, and flag hygiene practices.
  • Familiarity with database migration tooling and versioning practices — Flyway experience strongly preferred —including migration script standards, CI/CD pipeline integration, and migration execution monitoring.
  • Demonstrated active use of AI development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code in day-to-day technical work — including AI-assisted scripting, platform analysis, or documentation production.
  • Experience managing access controls and user provisioning across engineering platforms with an understanding of least-privilege principles and compliance evidence requirements.
  • Strong organizational discipline and attention to detail — able to manage multiple platform domains simultaneously, maintain configuration hygiene across all of them, and track open items without dropping anything.
  • Clear written communication skills — able to produce platform documentation, enablement guides, and configuration records that are accurate and usable by engineering teams without requiring significant clarification.

Who We Are

Origami Risk delivers single-platform SaaS solutions that help organizations best navigate the complexities of risk, insurance, compliance, and safety management.

Founded by industry veterans who recognized the need for risk management technology that was more configurable, intuitive, and scalable, Origami continues to add to its innovative product offerings for managing both insurable and uninsurable risk; facilitating compliance; improving safety; and helping insurers, MGAs, TPAs, and brokers provide enhanced services that drive results.

A singular focus on client success underlies Origami’s approach to developing, implementing, and supporting our award-winning software solutions.

And to confirm the legitimacy of any recruiting communication, feel free to email transparencycheck@origamirisk.com.

title: Summer 2027 Legal Internship, Family Defense Practice
description:
Overview

Job Title: Summer 2027 Law Intern (Current 2Ls)

Department: Family Defense Practice

Location: New York

Reports To: Staff Attorney, Family Defense Practice

Position Type: Internship

Union Status: Non-union

FLSA Status: n/a

About NDS:

Neighborhood Defender Service (NDS) is a national nonprofit public defense organization that pioneered the holistic defense model more than 30 years ago. Founded in Harlem, NDS was built to challenge the traditional public defense model by centering clients, communities, and interdisciplinary advocacy. Today, NDS operates community-based offices in Harlem; the Bronx; Detroit; and Hays County, Texas, supported by a unified national infrastructure that allows local teams to deliver high-quality, responsive representation rooted in the communities they serve.

Across all locations, NDS provides client-centered legal representation through interdisciplinary teams composed of attorneys, investigators, social workers, client advocates, and team administrators. Our approach emphasizes early and ongoing engagement with clients—before arrest where possible, throughout the life of a case, and beyond case resolution—while addressing the legal, social, and systemic challenges that impact long-term stability. NDS is committed to treating every client with dignity and respect and to advancing justice for individuals and communities that have been historically marginalized and over-policed.

Core Purpose of the Role:NDS is seeking current second-year law students for our family defense summer internship in Manhattan and the Bronx.

The Family Defense Practice at NDS represents parents in family policing cases (sometimes called “child welfare” cases) filed by the Administration for Children’s Services (ACS) as well as related family court cases, including custody, visitation, and termination of parental rights proceedings. Through our holistic approach to representation, the Family Defense Practice provides parents with the help they need—both inside and outside of court—to keep their families safe and stable. Parents are represented not only by a high-quality attorney, but also social workers, litigation assistants, and parent advocates. NDS is committed to advancing due process rights for parents by fighting unwarranted state intervention in their lives and advocating for related systemic change. Our internship program is hybrid and runs for 10 weeks, typically from the first week of June through the first week of August. Interns will either be placed in our Manhattan or Bronx office, with opportunities to observe both boroughs and work out of our court offices and our Harlem-based office. Legal interns can expect to conduct legal research, write legal motions, assist in preparing for hearings and trials, work directly with clients, and appear on the record pursuant to the student practice order.

Responsibilities

  • The goal of the internship is to provide the intern with an experience as close to the actual practice of an NDS family defense attorney as possible.
  • After a week of orientation to NDS and New York County family practice, summer interns are matched with attorneys to work with throughout the summer.
  • For the remainder of the summer, intern duties may include legal research and writing, court appearances, client interviews, precinct visits, witness interviews, investigation assistance, client visits at jails and juvenile detention facilities, and participation in any of the many other activities that NDS staff undertakes on behalf of our clients.

Qualifications

NDS is looking for law student interns with a demonstrated commitment to family defense and social justice issues. In addition, the internship requires energy, enthusiasm, and an unwavering commitment to clients.

Applying:

We are looking for current second-year law students who will embrace our philosophy of client-centered, community-based, and holistic representation.

Interested students should submit a cover letter and resume to: ndsfdpinterns@ndsny.org by October 16, 2027.

Applications without a cover letter will not be considered. You will be contacted via email if selected for an interview. Please email ndsfdpinterns@ndsny.org with any questions.

The internship is an unpaid opportunity.

The Neighborhood Defender Service is committed to creating a diverse environment that reflects the community we serve. NDS is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. NDS encourages people with incarcerated loved ones, formerly incarcerated people, people of color, women, queer, transgender, gender non-confirming, and gender fluid people to apply.

For more information about NDS, please visit our website at www.ndsny.org.

title: Data Engineer DSV
description:
3 redenen waarom dit jouw baan is

  • Krijg energie van data met impact en draag bij aan een datagedreven SVB
  • Ontwerp en bouw end-to-end datapipelines die onze organisatie elke dag slimmer maken
  • Versterk het Service Center Data (SCD) op ons hoofdkantoor in Amstelveen

Jij doet het

Je helpt onze Directie Sociale Verzekeringen (DSV) om de juiste inzichten te verkrijgen zodat zij betere beslissingen kunnen nemen.

Als Data Engineer bij het Service Center Data (SCD) ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en testen van verschillende dataverladingen. Data engineers leveren een bijdrage aan de zogeheten geborde straat. Dat wil zeggen; de data wordt verladen en getransformeerd ten behoeve van dashboarding, gestandaardiseerde analyses en self service BI.

Samen met collega’s in verschillende rollen werk je aan de ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van informatieproducten (bijvoorbeeld analytics, rapportages en dashboards). Je stuurt op herbruikbaarheid, privacy, datakwaliteit en tijdigheid en draagt actief bij aan de ambitie van de SVB om datagedreven te werken.

Je werkt op een kort cyclische manier (Agile Scrum) nauw samen met ontwikkelaars en product owners om de backlog scherp te krijgen.
Je bent inhoudelijk betrokken bij functionele en acceptatietests, voert checks uit en denkt mee over wat getest moet worden. De testcoördinator is verder verantwoordelijk voor de planning en uitvoering.

Concreet zijn de taken van de Data Engineer de volgende:

  • Ontsluiten van data uit verschillende type bronnen (API, CSV, database)
  • Toepassen van transformaties op de data met behulp van SQL en Python
  • Ontwikkelen van Synapse pipelines voor het verladen van de data
  • Testen en valideren van dataverlading
  • Monitoren en troubleshooting
  • Technisch onderhouden van Synapse pipelines
  • Samenwerken met Report engineers, Cloud Engineers, Data modelleurs en Informatieanalisten om datamodellen te valideren en de data-infrastructuur te optimaliseren
  • Technisch uitrollen van datamodellen in brons, zilver en goud.

Jij bent het

Je bent iemand die onafhankelijk en zelfstandig kan werken, maar verliest daarbij de samenwerking nooit uit het oog. Je werkt graag met focus en gestructureerd. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen business en je collega’s en weet belanghebbenden mee te nemen in je denkrichting.

Als Data Engineer heb je de volgende algemene kennis en vaardigheden:

  • Kennis van de basis architectuur principes en stijlen van Data Warehousing en Business Intelligence (Inmon, Kimball).
  • Kennis van en tenminste 5 jaar ervaring met het toepassen van SQL voor gestructureerde (tabellen, kolommen en relaties) data.
  • Kennis van en meerjarige ervaring met het toepassen van PySpark voor gestructureerde (tabellen, kolommen en relaties) data.
  • Kennis van CI/CD en versiebeheer in DevOps.
  • Duidelijk en helder kunnen communiceren over de mogelijkheden en beperkingen aan stakeholders.
  • Ervaring met ODI is een nice to have.
  • Leergierig en open om nieuwe technologieën te leren en te implementeren.
  • Goede teamgeest, je neemt collega data engineers mee in de gemaakte producten en brainstormt over innovatie op het gebied van data engineering.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Data Engineer in een complexe data omgeving
  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift
  • Ervaring met MS Azure

Welke kansen bieden we jou?

Jouw uitdaging, balans en groei: het heeft onze aandacht. Kansen en mogelijkheden om te groeien als persoon en als professional zijn er genoeg. Aan jou de taak om ze te pakken. Ook kan jij bij start als Data Engineer (op basis van een 36-urige werkweek) rekenen op:

  • elke maand maximaal € 6.395,00,- brutosalaris (fulltime is bij de SVB 36 uur per week).
  • 16,33% individueel keuzebudget. Jij kiest zelf hoe je dit inzet: wil je bijvoorbeeld meer salaris, een sabbatical, meer pensioen opbouwen of meer verlofdagen? Aan jou de keuze.
  • ruim 5 weken vakantie.

Er is nog meer. Ga voor een compleet overzicht naarwww.werkenbijdesvb.nl/vacatures/arbeidsvoorwaarden

Jouw werkomgeving

Van kinderbijslag tot AOW-pensioen: namens de overheid en samen met 4.500 collega’s maken we het mogelijk om de volksverzekeringen uit te betalen. Dat betekent dat we elk jaar 62 miljard euro overmaken aan zo’n 5,7 miljoen mensen. Op tijd, eerlijk en efficiënt.

Je werkt binnen het Service Center Data van de directie Bedrijfsvoering. Hier werk je in een domeinteam en vakgroep waar inhoud, samenwerking en kwaliteit centraal staan.

Samen bouwen jullie aan herbruikbare en toekomstbestendige dataoplossingen. Je denkt mee over standaarden, leert van collega’s en draagt actief bij aan de ambitie van de SVB om meer datagedreven te werken.

Jouw werk doet ertoe. De inzichten die jij helpt realiseren ondersteunen besluiten die impact hebben op miljoenen mensen in Nederland.

Bij de SVB werken we bewust. We kijken samen vanaf welke plek jij het beste resultaat behaalt. Is dat op kantoor in Amstelveen, vanuit huis of op een andere plek? Dat stem je af met je team en leidinggevende.

De SVB wil een diverse en inclusieve organisatie zijn, waar iedereen zich thuis voelt. Een afspiegeling van de samenleving. Onze doelgroep is immers ook divers. Teams met diversiteit waar iedereen ertoe doet maken ons effectiever, creatiever en zorgen voor betere dienstverlening.

title: Staff Engineer, Verification Automation
description:
Introduction

Werfen

Werfen is a growing, family-owned, innovative company founded in 1966 in Barcelona, Spain. title: Data Scientist
description:
Responsibilities

We are seeking a Data Scientist to build and curate the knowledge base for a generative AI/ML research effort, and to develop the data and knowledge extraction pipelines for machine learning models. The role is responsible for extracting, structuring, and validating design knowledge into knowledge graphs and ontologies; for engineering the metadata, annotation, and provenance of program datasets; and for the analysis that turns results, laboratory measurements, and simulation output into actionable findings for the research team.

The ideal candidate is a strong applied data scientist with an interest in symbolic and structured representations of knowledge. Experience with formal methods and domain-specific languages (DSLs) is desired but not required.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and populate the research team’s effort knowledge bases, and maintain it under version control with provenance tracking
  • Develop knowledge extraction pipelines (rule-based, statistical, and ML-assisted) that convert unstructured and semi-structured sources into structured, queryable knowledge; establish quality metrics and validation procedures for extracted content
  • Engineer the metadata, annotation schema, and packaging for program datasets (synthetic, simulated, and real collections) so that datasets are reproducible, well documented, and deliverable on the program data sharing schedule
  • Perform exploratory and inferential analysis on training data, simulation output, and evaluation results; build dashboards and reports that show where generated waveforms succeed or fail against objectives, and feed findings back to AI model researchers and engineers
  • Contribute data and analysis sections to design reviews, monthly status reports, and dataset documentation; coordinate with academic subcontractors on shared data and knowledge resources

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of applied data science or data engineering experience (or MS with 3+ years) with a record of delivering data pipelines and analyses that other engineers and researchers depend on
  • Strong Python proficiency including the scientific stack (NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn) and experience with at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch preferred)
  • Hands-on experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, or structured knowledge representation (RDF/OWL, property graphs such as Neo4j, or equivalent) and with querying and validating them (SPARQL, Cypher, SHACL, or similar)
  • Experience designing data schemas, metadata standards, and annotation workflows for large scientific or engineering datasets, including data versioning and provenance
  • Solid statistical foundations: experimental design, hypothesis testing, uncertainty quantification, and the ability to explain results to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience with SQL and with at least one workflow or pipeline orchestration tool (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, DVC, or equivalent)
  • Ability to produce clear documentation including data dictionaries, dataset cards, and analysis reports
  • US Citizenship

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with formal methods or formal verification, such as SMT solvers (Z3, cvc5), model checkers, property-based testing (Hypothesis), or proof assistants, particularly applied to validating generated programs or signal processing pipelines
  • Experience designing or implementing domain-specific languages: grammar design, parser generators (ANTLR, Lark, or similar), type systems, intermediate representations, or compiling DSL programs to executable code
  • Background in symbolic AI or neuro-symbolic methods: logic programming, constraint solving, rule engines, or program synthesis
  • Familiarity with digital signal processing and communications fundamentals (modulation, filtering, coding, channel effects) or with GNU Radio and software-defined radio data formats (I/Q sample handling, SigMF or similar metadata standards)
  • Prior work on IARPA, DARPA, or similar government research programs, including data sharing plans, privacy protection plans, and delivery of datasets to independent T&E teams
  • Experience building causal or probabilistic models from structured knowledge, or working alongside causal inference researchers
  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Willingness and ability to obtain Secret security clearance

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About Us

A proud member of the Quanta Services family of companies, Ampacity, LLC (Ampacity) delivers a forward-thinking approach to structural and electrical solutions for clean energy transition projects. From design, kitting, and installation to comprehensive electrical procurement, Ampacity specializes in expert-engineered, field-ready solutions that accelerate project timelines and maximize impact. Made up of more than 350 passionate professionals committed to simplifying complexity across the energy value chain, Ampacity empowers customers to build smarter, faster, and more efficiently­—with the most reliable technology in the industry. Headquartered in California, Ampacity maintains facilities in Mississippi, Kentucky, and Iowa, with offices in Florida, Georgia, and Vermont. Since 2014, Ampacity has delivered nearly eight gigawatts of fully engineered clean energy systems across North America.

About this Role

Ampacity is seeking a Supply Chain Program Manager to own the end-to-end coordination of vendor-direct (drop ship) material shipments to project sites. This role acts as the central point of communication between vendors, 3PLs, project managers, and site receiving teams to ensure drop ship materials arrive on schedule, in good condition, and with minimal handling costs. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable managing multiple moving schedules at once, and skilled at resolving logistics issues before they impact project timelines or month-end close.

Location: Remote

Time Zone Preference: Central or Eastern

Pay Range: $75k- $85k

What You'll Do

  • Coordinate project delivery schedules with Project Managers to keep material flow aligned with site needs.
  • Oversee inbound receiving, including white glove and customer-managed deliveries.
  • Partner with 3PL providers to accommodate minor schedule adjustments as they arise.
  • Lead day-to-day shipping communication with vendors.
  • Monitor and respond to schedule changes, including daily truck volume, weather delays, and trucking issues.
  • Follow up on and resolve quality and allocation issues with vendors.
  • Identify opportunities to drop ship more material directly from vendors to site, reducing costs from double handling.
  • Track open inbound shipments to support accurate, on-time month-end close.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience in supply chain, logistics, procurement, or project coordination, ideally within construction, industrial, or capital projects environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of inbound logistics, freight/trucking operations, and 3PL management.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a track record of coordinating across vendors, carriers, project teams, and site personnel — even as schedules and conditions change.
  • A detail-oriented, deadline-driven approach to closing out inbound activity each month.
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or a related field preferred, but not required with equivalent experience.

What You'll Get

  • Competitive pay and 401k — because your work should be rewarded fairly
  • Time off you'll actually use: vacation, sick days, holidays, parental, and bereavement leave
  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus extra support when you need it
  • Wellness resources to help you show up as your best self, at work and at home
  • Real room to grow — we promote from within and invest in your development

title: Full Stack Software Engineer (Product Engineering Team) (Copy)
description:
About Us


At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.

We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers. We get things done with urgency and focus, driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego, fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious—always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better.

About the Role


As a key member of our engineering team, you will have a unique opportunity to shape the core technology behind our chat-driven platform. You will work on the Félix's Product Engineering team — a sophisticated system that not only processes high volumes of transactions but also delivers conversational experiences through integrated chatbots and natural language interfaces. Your role will be crucial in designing and enhancing interactive chat services and frontend (mobile and web) experiences that enable seamless, intuitive user interactions on platforms like WhatsApp, Web, and Mobile Application. If you have experience building chatbots, mobile applications, webpages, or crafting conversational experiences, this is your chance to make a significant impact.


Technology Stack


We are technology agnostic and value candidates with diverse backgrounds. While familiarity with the following is helpful, your willingness to learn and adapt is paramount:

  • Back-end: Python, Flask/FastAPI, REST APIs, Redis, SQL, gRPC
  • Fronted: React, HTTP, HTML/DOM, JavaScript, CSS, AJAX
  • Mobile: React Native
  • Cloud: Google Cloud services (Firestore, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Google Artifact Registry, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, etc.)
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform, NewRelic, PagerDuty

Responsibilities


  • Design & Architecture: Architect and implement high-performance, scalable backend microservices, including core components of our Chat Platform.
  • User Interfaces: Build, deploy, and iterate on UI services and conversational interfaces that empower users to interact naturally with our remittance services.
  • Infrastructure: Design and manage infrastructure capable of handling millions of daily requests with real-time messaging capabilities.
  • Cloud Integration: Develop backend services using established industry standards and Google Cloud services.
  • Collaboration & Mentorship: Foster the growth of junior developers through mentorship and best practice implementation, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including product, UX/UI, and business units.
  • Continuous Improvement: Leverage customer feedback and analytics to iterate and improve our conversational experience, ensuring that our chatbots remain effective and user-friendly.
  • Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level or higher is required.

Requirements


These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

  • 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to build, ship, and iterate on software applications with an emphasis on real-world impact.
